widgets.description:
Stay in the conversation with Sidekick for Discord, an interactive XENEON EDGE widget. Keep your favorite channels, chat, and active voice call within reach while you game.

**What’s Included**
Choose which channels appear for each server instead of displaying every channel. Keep updated on DMs, groupchats, & all your favorite channels from servers.

Read chat from servers, DMs, & groupchats, view voice channel participants, and see speaking, mute, and deafen indicators. Adjust individual user volume and access mute, deafen, screen sharing, camera, soundboard, and leave-call controls where Discord permits them.

Your active call takes focus when you join. Hide the channel list to give chat and call more room.

**Customization**
Two styles to choose from, **Compact** or **Standard**. Compact is smaller, easier to read with bigger buttons, and Standard is a more familiar Discord feel.
Choose light or dark mode, adjust text size, and switch between solid and transparent backgrounds. Participant cards help keep your call readable over your wallpaper.

Choose whether call or chat takes the more prominent position. Sidekick adapts to different widget sizes, with a compact Servers and Channels menu for smaller layouts.

**Setup and Connectivity**
Requires Discord’s desktop app & our light-weight background companion app on the same Windows PC.

Guided setup checks your module and Discord connection, then walks you through entering your own Discord application’s Client ID and Client Secret and approving Discord’s permission prompts. Our setup guide explains how to create your application and configure its redirect URL.

Your connection is saved for future sessions, with credentials protected locally using Windows encryption.

**Compatibility**
Designed for XENEON EDGE on Windows with iCUE. Supports touchscreen and mouse navigation across multiple widget sizes. Discord and the Sidekick module must be running for connected features to work.

**Disclaimer**
Sidekick for Discord is independently developed by Respawn Icons and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with Discord or Corsair.

Features and availability may change if Discord modifies or restricts its services. Purchasing this widget does not grant additional Discord permissions or guarantee access to restricted features.

All names, avatars, server artwork, trademarks, logos, and related intellectual property belong to their respective owners.

widgets.description:
Bring your music to your touchscreen with Sidekick, an interactive XENEON EDGE widget. Browse your library, find your next song, and control your desktop player directly from your display.

**What's Included**

Browse your songs, playlists, albums, artists, and recently added music. Search for songs beyond your saved library and tap a result to start listening.

Add songs to your player's queue with the + button. The Queue tab displays its actual Playing Next list, with album artwork and a Remove option for upcoming tracks. Open Queue or press Refresh to update the list.

Playback controls, favorites, a progress bar, and a volume slider stay within reach while browsing. Volume changes sync with your desktop player's own slider, including while minimized.

**Customization**

Choose between Classic, Pulse, and Vinyl layouts. Classic highlights your album artwork, Pulse adds an audio visualizer, and Vinyl features a spinning record with the album cover at its center. A blurred artwork background complements the current song.

Swipe across the player to skip tracks, double tap its open surface to play or pause, and drag the record in Vinyl mode to seek. Controls can hide after inactivity, while long song titles scroll with a brief pause between loops.

Adjust background transparency, corner curvature, artwork visibility, visualizer settings, and the progress bar accent color through iCUE.

Supports horizontal and vertical layouts, and all widget sizes. Choose from English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, Russian, and Simplified Chinese.

**Data and Connectivity**

Sidekick requires our Respawn Companion app and will only work with the Apple Music Desktop app for Windows.

An Apple Music subscription is required to stream its subscription catalog. Internet access is needed for online search, streaming, and artwork downloads.

No Apple Developer account, Client ID, or API key is required. Sidekick connects locally through Respawn Companion and controls the installed desktop app. Music plays through that app on your PC.

**Compatibility**

Designed for XENEON EDGE with iCUE 5.47 or later on Windows. Supports touchscreen browsing, playback controls, swipe gestures, and adjustable widget sizes.

Desktop app support only. Some features may be unavailable depending on the content, account, or controls exposed by the installed player. Desktop app updates may affect compatibility.

**Disclaimer**

Sidekick is independently developed by Respawn Icons and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with Apple or Corsair.

Sidekick relies on the installed desktop player and its services for music information and playback. Features and availability may change if those applications or services are modified. Purchasing this widget does not include an Apple Music subscription.

All music, artwork, artist names, trademarks, logos, and related intellectual property belong to their respective owners.

Explore the skies around you with Flight Radar, an interactive XENEON EDGE widget that transforms your touchscreen into a live aircraft-tracking display. View nearby planes on a detailed map, follow their movement, and tap any aircraft for additional flight information.

**What’s Included**
The live radar map displays nearby aircraft using real-time community data.

Tap an aircraft to view available information on its flight.

Plane trails visualize recent movement while smooth touchscreen controls allow you to pan and zoom around the map.

Ghost trails visualize estimated flight paths for the aircraft depending on its destination.

Airline names are identified locally using aircraft callsign prefixes. Route information is displayed only when a reliable route is available.

Pin an aircraft and track its entire flight.

Markdown your favorite Airports to see them on the map.

If community photos for an aircraft are available, see them in the flight details.

**Customization**
Personalize Flight Radar through the iCUE configuration panel with selectable plane and trail colors, optional plane trails, adjustable refresh timing, and a configurable aircraft scan radius.

Choose between light, dark, and automatic time-based themes. The header can also be shown or hidden for a cleaner full-map layout.

Set the radar location using automatic approximate location detection or enter a city, postal code, or street address manually.

**Data and Connectivity**
Flight Radar requires an active internet connection. Aircraft positions are provided by public community services, while map tiles and location searches are supplied by third-party mapping services.

The installation of our very light-weight Flight Radar companion app is necessary for versions 1.1 and above. This can be found in the **Related Downloads** link on this product page.

**Compatibility**
Designed for XENEON EDGE and iCUE, Flight Radar supports touchscreen panning, pinch-to-zoom, aircraft selection, and configurable display options.

**Disclaimer**
Flight Radar is an independently developed community product and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with Corsair, ADSB.lol, Airplanes.live, adsb.im, OpenStreetMap, CARTO, any airline, aircraft manufacturer, airport, or aviation authority.

Flight Radar uses third party sources for **Flight Data**, **Aircraft Images**, & **Map**. While we strive for a consistent user experience, we cannot guarantee accuracy, availability, or continuity of service as these sources may change or become unavailable at any time.

All airline names, trademarks, logos, aircraft names, map data, and related intellectual property belong to their respective owners.

widgets.description:
Some nights you just want to watch the rain. Weather Window turns your XENEON EDGE into a window with your real local weather outside it. When it rains where you are, drops bead up on the glass and run down. When it snows, flakes drift past and pile up on the ledge. As the sun goes down, the view moves to dusk and then night on your own clock.

**Pick your view**

- A backyard with a wooden fence and fall trees

- A city apartment looking out at the skyline

- A mountain cabin facing the peaks

Each view has seven photo looks (dawn, day, dusk, night, snow, rainy day and rainy night) that change on their own with the weather and the hour. Frame it in painted white, warm wood or matte black.

**Touch the glass**

- Press and hold to fog it up, then draw in it with your finger. It slowly fogs back over.

- Below freezing, frost creeps in from the corners.

- A sticky note on the glass shows the temperature and conditions. Tap it for the next few hours.

**Fall asleep to it**

- Rain on the window, rain on a tin roof, or both

- Wind and thunder when a storm rolls through

- Long sounds that drift on their own, so you won’t hear an obvious loop

- A sleep timer for 30 minutes, 1 hour or 2 hours that fades out slowly

iCUE needs one tap on the widget before it can play sound.

**The details**

Your location is found automatically, or type a city or coordinates. Fahrenheit or Celsius. Works in every Edge slot size, horizontal or vertical, in 12 languages.

Made by Widgetry. AI tools helped write the code and create the photos, sounds and promo music.

Never forget to clock out: if you are still clocked in after 8, 10 or 12 hours, Punch Clock asks. Tap Clock out and pick the time you really left.

Five looks: Time Card, a vintage enamel time recorder with a paper time card that gets stamped; Night Glass, a smoked glass dial with the week in glowing vials; Flip Board, walnut and brass with split-flap numbers; and the minimal All Black and All White.

Made for you: weekly goal (1 to 80 hours), week starting on Monday or Sunday, hours as 7:30 or 7.50, 12 or 24-hour clock, Simple or Detailed view, text size and colors. Works in all 8 sizes of the XENEON EDGE, horizontal and vertical.

Good to know: your hours are saved on this PC, for this widget (nine weeks of history). Requires iCUE 5.47 or newer.

widgets.description:
**🎧 Your Discord voice calls and chat, without leaving the game.**

Flow for Discord puts your voice call, your controls and your chats on the Corsair Xeneon Edge, so you stop alt-tabbing out of a match to see who's talking or answer a ping.

✅ See who's talking at a glance, and mute or deafen in one tap.

✅ Talking while muted? The Edge tells you before your squad does.

✅ Mentions and DMs from every server pop up while you play.

✅ Reply to a DM or a channel from your keyboard while your game keeps focus.

\--

**🔊 Your Call, On Its Own Screen**

Everyone in the call sits on the Edge with their avatar, and a ring lights up while they talk. Tap a friend to turn them up to 200% or down to a whisper, just for you. A balance slider sets your game against Discord, so callouts never drown in explosions.

- Mute and Deafen in one tap, Disconnect with a short hold so it never happens by accident
- Hold Mute to talk for a moment, then let go
- A clear warning when you talk while muted
- Optional push to talk that switches on while a game is running and back off when it closes

\--

**💬 Chat Without the Alt-Tab**

Pin the text channels you care about from any server as tabs, alongside your DMs. Mentions get their own tab, and a quick preview slides in when someone tags you, reply directly from the Edge without bringing Discord to the front.

- Tap a name to see which voice channel they're in, or open their Discord profile
- GIFs, images and link previews show right in the feed
- Read a chat in Discord on this PC and it clears on the Edge too
- Reply directly from the Edge
- Streamer mode hides message text until you tap it

\--

**⭐ Your Channels, One Tap Away**

Star your regular voice channels and they become big keys showing who's already in them. Tap one to see the room, then Join Voice. Long-press to rearrange, swipe for more pages. DMs get their own Direct tab, and an incoming call slides up with Answer and Ignore.

\--

**🎨 Fits Your Edge**

Any size, either way up. Pick light or dark, a panel color and transparency so your dashboard shows through, the color of the speaking rings, and a larger text size.

\--

**📦 What You Need**

- Corsair Xeneon Edge with iCUE 5.47 or later
- Windows 10 or 11 with the Discord desktop app
- FlowKits Companion, a small background app that connects the widget to Discord on your PC. It installs in one step and keeps itself updated.
- A Discord app of your own, set up once. The companion opens a page that walks you through it in a few minutes, and it means the connection belongs to you.

Full setup guide: getflowkits.com/setup-companion/flow-for-discord

\--

**ℹ️ Worth Knowing**

Discord only lets apps see the Discord app on the same PC, so Flow for Discord works with the desktop app, not the browser or your phone. Your messages stay between the Edge and your PC: nothing is sent to me or anyone else.

Sending a message needs Discord open on another screen or behind your game. If it's minimized or in the tray, the Edge offers to open it for you. Windows won't let the widget read your keyboard while a game runs as administrator, so for those games you type in Discord as usual.

widgets.description:
The exact battery level of your Corsair wireless headset, mouse or keyboard, right on your XENEON EDGE. See the percentage at a glance, whether it’s connected or charging, and how long your current session has run.

Show one device or up to eight, each with its level, Connected, Charging or Off, a Low or Critical tag, and how long it has been on. A device that is switched off keeps its place and shows its last level and when it was last seen. Corsair wireless devices come straight from iCUE. Xbox controllers and other Bluetooth devices come from the free Atomic Controller Battery helper: if Windows Settings shows a device's battery %, the Battery widget can show it too. That includes most Bluetooth Low Energy keyboards, mice, headsets and controllers. Devices that only report four levels, like the Xbox Elite Series 2, show Full, Medium, Low or Critical with a four-part bar. Give any device your own label, like Keyboard or Controller.

Bluetooth devices from other brands (non iCUE) are supported on a best-effort basis: Battery shows exactly what each device reports to Windows, so how often the level updates and how precise it is depends on the device. Windows isn't told when a Bluetooth device is charging, so Battery shows Charging once its level starts to rise.

Star Citizen hauling on your Corsair XENEON EDGE: the best run from where you stand, every contract tracked, no helper app.

• Knows where you are and what you're flying, straight from the game

• Finds the most profitable trade run from your current station

• Tracks every contract, crate and drop while you fly

• Live UEX community prices, ship prices and where to buy

• Nothing to install besides the widget

• Help keep prices fresh: add your UEX key and every price you type in goes to UEX as your report

Extra large (XL) widget: made for the full XENEON EDGE screen, horizontal.

Known issue: tapping the XENEON EDGE can make your mouse cursor appear in Star Citizen. This happens with any widget on the Edge, even when tapping an empty spot. It isn't caused by this widget.

\--

HOME: RUN PICKER

• Six goals: Max profit, From here, Quickest, Same system, Safe space and Loop, each showing what it would earn

• Searches your whole system, sized to your ship and budget

• Your trip step by step, with fill-up suggestions for spare hold space

• Your hold as a cargo rack: contracts, unverified cargo and trade cargo in their own colours

TRADE

• Every route ranked by profit or profit per SCU, single runs or multi-leg loops

• Risk marks for contraband, lawless space and unknown demand

• Price age, auto-load, box size, system and safety filters, remembered per ship

• Type in a terminal's real stock or demand and the routes re-rank around it

• Start a run and follow it from buy to sell

MISSIONS

• Every active contract: what, how much, pickup and drop-off, aboard or still to collect

• Hauling and courier deliveries; unverified contracts and contraband marked

• Collect-first and next-drop panel

MARKET

• Where to buy cheapest and sell highest, and everything a station trades

• Every ship's price, cheapest shop, rental price and where to buy it

STATS

• Today's runs, profit and aUEC per hour, plus a 14-day history

• Set a goal (a new ship, for example) and see how many hauling hours it takes

ALWAYS IN VIEW

• Your ship, station, server region, FPS and game status

• Sale summary with your profit and the next best run

• Sell-price drop alert while you carry cargo

\--

FAIR PLAY

• Only reads Game.log, the text file Star Citizen writes on your PC

• Never reads or changes game memory, never sends input to the game

• Works offline with the last prices it fetched

SETUP

Get o7Decks - Haul here on Marketplace and open iCUE.

Add it to your XENEON EDGE as an Extra large widget.

When iCUE asks, allow access to Game.log, api.uexcorp.space (prices) and raw.githubusercontent.com (o7 Decks notices and place-name fixes).

Launch Star Citizen. The deck goes LIVE when you join a server.

Star Citizen installed somewhere unusual? Enter your Star Citizen folder (or the full path to Game.log) in the widget settings in iCUE.

\--

POWERED BY UEX

Prices, stock, terminals and ship shops come from UEX (uexcorp.space), the community's trade database, built from reports by players like you. Every price shows how old it is.

**Be one of those players\***: paste your UEX secret key in the widget settings on iCUE (optional), and everything you type in from a terminal is sent to UEX right away as your datarunner report: the price, stock or demand, and optionally the inventory level, the box sizes, or that it isn't traded there any more. UEX reviews it like any other.

\*New UEX datarunners must attach screenshots for their first 90 days, which the deck can't do: report on uexcorp.space / use their dedicated datarunner agent for Windows until the 90 day period is over.

\--

o7Decks - Haul is an unofficial fan-made tool, not affiliated with or endorsed by Cloud Imperium Games. Star Citizen® is a trademark of Cloud Imperium Rights LLC. XENEON EDGE and iCUE are trademarks of Corsair.

widgets.description:
A vintage studio lightbox that warms up like an old studio lamp when OBS goes live, reading ON AIR when you stream and RECORDING when you record. Backlit STREAM, RECORD and PAUSE buttons start and stop OBS from the screen. Connects straight to the OBS WebSocket, with no helper app. For those wanting a cleaner interface, the buttons can be switched off and just the sign remains on screen.

The sign is modelled on the old broadcast lamps that hung outside radio studios: a red acrylic panel in a dark metal housing, with tall cream lettering. When you start streaming it doesn't just snap on. It warms up like an old filament lamp, from a dull orange ember to a warm cream glow, with soft red light spilling onto the wall. Switched off, the letters stay faintly visible, like frosted glass.

It reads ON AIR while you stream and RECORDING while you record. If you do both, the stream takes priority. When the sign switches between them, the lamp dips and warms back up, as if someone had swapped the panel. Pause a recording and the sign breathes slowly until you resume.

Below the sign, three backlit buttons control OBS directly:

- STREAM starts and stops your stream
- RECORD starts and stops recording
- PAUSE pauses and resumes the recording
- The sign will also respond correctly to controls from the OBS interface directly.

Each plate glows while its output is running. Starting is a tap, and stopping is a short press-and-hold, so a stray touch never ends a live stream. Swipes across the screen are ignored. If OBS can't start an output (for example, no stream key is set), the plate blinks twice to let you know.

A small pilot lamp in the bezel shows the connection: steady green when connected, blinking while it waits for OBS, and amber if the password is wrong. The widget reconnects by itself whenever OBS starts.

Settings:

- Text when streaming: ON AIR, LIVE or STREAMING
- Lamp flicker on or off
- Show or hide the buttons (hidden, the sign fills the slot)
- Hold to stop streaming or recording, on or off
- OBS WebSocket address, port and password
- Scales cleanly to every widget slot, from Small to Extra Large.

Setup: in OBS (version 28 or later), open Tools → WebSocket Server Settings, enable the server and note the password. Enter the password in the widget's settings and allow the connection when iCUE asks. The widget connects straight to OBS, with no helper app or internet connection needed. Your settings are kept between restarts.

Build your perfect canvas with **Sensors**, an interactive XENEON EDGE widget that brings your PC’s hardware readings together. Create a compact monitoring panel or fill your display with a layout built around your setup.

This is an actively maintained project, and we'll continue to release updates over time. If you have suggestions, we'd love to hear from you.

**What’s Included**
Choose from a range of sensor displays:

- **Hardware Monitoring:** View available temperatures, usage, clock speeds, power readings, and more.
- **Cooling:** Monitor fan speeds and available coolant temperatures, with custom fan names.
- **Storage & Network:** Track drive capacity, network activity, and available transfer totals.
- **Device Batteries:** Monitor supported wireless-device battery levels and charging status.
- **System Health:** See the health status of your PC, providing flags on things that need to be checked.
- **Display Options:** Choose graphs, gauges, bars, numerical readings, and dedicated sensor tiles.

Automatically detects available hardware and combines readings from multiple sensor sources. Search by sensor name, browse hardware categories.

**Touch Controls and Layouts**
Add, move, resize, and customize tiles to create your preferred arrangement. Organize your dashboard across multiple pages and switch between them with touch controls.

Supports horizontal and vertical layouts across widget sizes, with a grid that lets you arrange tiles to fit your space.

**Customization**
Customize colors, backgrounds, fonts, text sizes, transparency, spacing, corners, and surface styles.

Apply a consistent appearance globally or override individual tiles. Rename sensors and fans, choose measurement units, and adjust how readings appear.

Works in portrait and landscape orientation.

Includes English, Spanish, French, German, Simplified Chinese, Russian, Italian, Korean, and Japanese.

**Custom Rules**
Set custom rules that change colors and appearance when readings reach your chosen limits. Make high temperatures or other important conditions stand out while the widget is running.

**Custom Pages**
Add multiple pages and use a two finger swipe gesture (swipe up/down) to go between them.

**Data and Connectivity**
Sensors requires our **Respawn Companion** app, available through the **Related Downloads** link on this product page.

The module supplies additional hardware readings. The widget automatically checks for updates and indicates when a module or widget update is available.

**Compatibility**
Designed for XENEON EDGE and iCUE on Windows.

Available readings depend on your hardware, drivers, permissions, and connected devices.

**Disclaimer**
Sensors is independently developed and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with, Microsoft, or other hardware or software manufacturers.

Compatibility may change with Windows, iCUE, driver, or third-party updates. All trademarks, logos, and related intellectual property belong to their respective owners.

**The ultimate customisable FPS, CPU and GPU performance dashboard for Corsair XENEON EDGE.**

Take control of your gaming performance with Gaming Performance Pro, a real-time monitoring widget designed specifically for the Corsair XENEON EDGE touchscreen display.

Monitor frame rates, CPU and GPU performance, hardware temperatures and system load from one easy-to-read dashboard — without constantly switching away from your game.

**REAL-TIME FPS MONITORING**

Keep track of gaming performance with a dedicated FPS counter and live performance graph.

- **Live FPS Counter** — Displays your current frames per second while gaming.
- **FPS History Graph** — Visualises frame-rate changes over time.
- **Minimum and Maximum FPS** — Tracks your lowest and highest recorded frame rates.
- **Game Identification** — Displays the detected game name above your FPS graph.
- **Adjustable FPS Graph Scale** — Customise the graph maximum to suit your gaming performance.

**CPU PERFORMANCE MONITORING**

Keep an eye on your processor with a dedicated CPU monitoring panel.

- **CPU Temperature** — Large, easy-to-read live temperature display in °C.
- **CPU Load** — Circular percentage gauge showing processor utilisation.
- **Minimum and Maximum Temperatures** — Track temperature extremes during gaming.
- **Temperature Bar** — Colourful segmented temperature scale from 0°C to 100°C.
- **CPU Identification** — Displays your selected processor's hardware name.

**GPU PERFORMANCE MONITORING**

Monitor your graphics card's performance and temperatures in real time.

- **GPU Temperature** — Large live graphics card temperature reading.
- **GPU Load** — Circular utilisation gauge showing GPU activity.
- **Minimum and Maximum Temperatures** — Monitor recorded temperature extremes.
- **Temperature Bar** — Segmented temperature indicator with labelled values.
- **GPU Identification** — Displays your selected graphics card's hardware name.

**EXTENSIVE CUSTOMISATION**

Personalise Gaming Performance Pro through Corsair iCUE.

**Appearance and Colours**

- Customise dashboard colours and visual themes.
- Adjust background appearance and transparency.
- Match your dashboard to your gaming setup.

**Text and Readability**

- Adjust font sizes for improved readability.
- Tailor the display to your preferred viewing distance.

**Monitoring and Sensors**

- Choose the CPU and GPU sensors used for monitoring.
- Select temperature and utilisation readings for your hardware.
- Adjust the FPS graph maximum to match your preferred performance range.

**DESIGNED FOR CORSAIR XENEON EDGE**

Gaming Performance Pro brings essential gaming information together on one dedicated dashboard, allowing you to keep your main monitor focused on the action.

**KEY BENEFITS**

- Monitor FPS, CPU and GPU performance together.
- Track performance fluctuations and temperature extremes.
- Customise the dashboard to suit your setup.
- View essential system information at a glance.
- Enjoy a purpose-built layout for Corsair XENEON EDGE.

**Requirements:** Windows PC, compatible Corsair iCUE software and Corsair XENEON EDGE. Sensor availability depends on your hardware and the sensors exposed through iCUE.

widgets.description:
See your ClickUp List on your XENEON EDGE, every status side by side, and open any task with a tap. Status Board Edge shows how many tasks are due today or overdue, with due dates, priority flags, checklist progress, tags and assignees on every task, in the status, tag and priority colors you already use in ClickUp.

Tap a task to see all of it: status, priority, description, checklists and who is on it. Open it in ClickUp with one more tap, move it to the next status or mark it done (each with Undo), and tick off checklist items right on the widget. Leave the List link empty to see My tasks across your Workspaces, grouped into Overdue, Today and Later. Wide layouts show up to six statuses, you can choose which statuses to show, and every size slot is supported. Text, accent and background colors and transparency are set in the widget settings.

Requirements: a ClickUp account (the Free Forever plan works). Generate your personal API token in ClickUp (Settings, Apps) and paste it into the widget settings in iCUE. Your token stays in iCUE and is sent only to api.clickup.com. Status Board Edge is an independent widget and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with ClickUp. widgets.description:
Your UniFi network on your XENEON EDGE: live internet speed, the health of every UniFi device, and up to nine UniFi Protect cameras, side by side.

The Internet section shows your download and upload as they happen, with a graph of the last 5 minutes to an hour, this month's data use, your ISP and plan speed, latency, packet loss and uptime. Run a speed test right from the widget: tap Run Test twice and your gateway tests your connection, one phase at a time.

Network Health counts the devices online and keeps an eye on your gateway, switches, Wi-Fi and security, with the changes it notices under Recent Events. Tap a row for the details: gateway load and ports, every switch port, Wi-Fi radios with channel use and client signal, and the flows your firewall blocked. Tap the month's totals for data by app, Clients for your ten busiest, and the device count for every UniFi device.

Cameras shows snapshots from up to nine UniFi Protect cameras, a doorbell's package camera included, refreshed every 10 seconds to 5 minutes, or only when you tap. Tap a camera to open it. When your UniFi doorbell rings, the camera view expands for a minute. No cameras? Turn Show Cameras off and Network Health takes the space, with more detail for every row.

Pick what each slot shows: Medium shows one section, Large two, Extra Large all three.

You need a UniFi console (a Cloud Gateway, Dream Machine or other UniFi OS console) with remote access turned on. Sign in at unifi.ui.com as the console's owner, create an API key, and paste it into the widget's settings. The key stays on your PC and is only sent to UniFi (api.ui.com). The widget only reads your network, except when you start a speed test.

Camera pictures are snapshots, not live video, and each one is about 300 KB through the UniFi cloud: nine cameras every minute use about 160 MB an hour.

Part of a matching set: Hardware Monitor, Hardware Monitor Dials, Weather and Radar, Calendar, Clock, Calculator, Battery, Now Playing, FPS, Fan Monitor, Power Cost, GIF Frame, Game Launcher, RSS Reader, Audio Control, Stocks, App Launcher, Countdown Timer and Game Deals use the same themes, palettes and edges, so put UniFi Monitor next to any other widget to make one seamless dashboard. Check out the full set by clicking Atomic at the top of this page.

Features

• Medium, Large and Extra Large

• Live download and upload, with a graph of the last 5, 10, 15 or 30 minutes or the last hour

• This month's data use, counted the way the UniFi portal counts it, and data by app for this month and last

• Your ISP and plan speed, latency, packet loss and uptime

• Speed tests on your gateway, with each phase shown as it runs

• Every UniFi device at a glance: gateway, switches, Wi-Fi and security

• Gateway, switch port, Wi-Fi radio, client and device details a tap away

• Blocked flows in the last 24 hours and your threat protection mode

• Your ten busiest clients over the last 24 hours

• Up to nine UniFi Protect cameras, a doorbell's package camera included, picked by name

• A doorbell ring opens that doorbell's camera for a minute

• Twelve themes (Default, Glass, Terminal, Cozy, Cyberpunk, Retro, Nature, Comic Book, Anime, Gaming, Minimal, Holiday) with 4 palettes each

• Theme effects: glow, scanlines, glitch and pixel shadows, a moving RGB edge, fireflies and snowfall

• Your own text, accent and background colors, or a transparent background to show your EDGE wallpaper

• Text size 90 to 135%

• A latency warning level you choose (20 to 200 ms)

Requirements

• iCUE 5.44 or later on Windows 10 or 11

• A UniFi OS console running UniFi Network, with remote access turned on (and UniFi Protect for cameras)

• A UniFi API key, created at unifi.ui.com by the console's owner

• An internet connection

\*UniFi and UniFi Protect are trademarks of Ubiquiti Inc. UniFi Monitor is made by Atomic and is not affiliated with or endorsed by Ubiquiti.

widgets.description:
Bring Managed Democracy to your XENEON EDGE with a dedicated Helldivers 2 Stratagem Companion.

Quickly deploy stratagems, organize custom loadouts, and access essential mission commands through a responsive touchscreen interface designed for fast use during combat.

**Stratagem Interface**

The main interface provides four customizable stratagem slots.

Dedicated Reinforce, Resupply, and SOS Beacon buttons remain available below the primary loadout for immediate access.

**Stratagem Library**

Choose from a comprehensive library of Helldivers 2 stratagems, organized into convenient categories:

- Support Weapons

- Orbital

- Eagle

- Emplacement

- Sentry

- Backpack

- Vehicle

- Mission

Use the global search bar to find any stratagem regardless of the currently selected category. Select a loadout slot, choose a stratagem, and save the updated configuration directly from the widget.

**Loadout Presets**

Create and save custom four-stratagem presets for different missions, enemy factions, squad roles, or playstyles.

**Fast Stratagem Deployment**

Pressing a stratagem automatically sends its configured directional sequence.

Keyboard controls, input timing, and deployment behavior can be configured through the Companion Module. The widget communicates with the local module to execute commands and keep loadouts synchronized.

**Visual Design**

The interface features a Helldivers-inspired tactical presentation with:

- High-contrast stratagem artwork

- Illuminated yellow selection indicators

- Detailed military-style panels

- Responsive button feedback

- Optimized landscape touchscreen layout

- Preloaded custom artwork for smoother navigation

- A startup loading screen with automatic update checks

**Required Download**

This widget requires the free **Respawn Companion** application.

Install Respawn Companion using the **Related Download** link, open its Game Library, and install the Helldivers 2 Module. The lightweight companion needs to be running for the keybinds to work.

The required **Respawn Companion** application and Helldivers 2 Module provide:

- Configurable stratagem keyboard controls

- Adjustable input timing

- Automatic loadout synchronization

- Persistent presets and settings

- Widget and module compatibility checks

- Update notifications

Respawn Companion can start with Windows and keep the Helldivers 2 Module running in the background without opening its configuration window.

**Disclaimer**

Helldivers 2 Stratagem Companion is an independently developed community product and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with Arrowhead Game Studios, Sony Interactive Entertainment, CORSAIR, Elgato, or their subsidiaries.

Helldivers 2 and all related names, trademarks, logos, imagery, and intellectual property belong to their respective owners.

Bring your cameras to your XENEON EDGE with Camera. View live feeds, build a custom camera wall, and control compatible cameras through a touchscreen interface.

We've created a compatibility guide for the top camera brands and show how we think they will work with this widget. Click the **Setup Guide** on this product page to view. If we're missing something, reach out and we will try our best at adding support for it.

**Camera Views**

Keep one camera in focus or combine up to nine feeds in a multi view.

- Drag and resize tiles
- Reorder cameras within a multi view
- Expand tiles for a closer look
- Focus on one feed and return to the full view

Use M, L or XL for setup and editing. Small displays your saved camera wall.

**Flexible Connections**

Choose Direct Camera, Home Assistant, or both during guided setup.

**<u>Direct Camera Connection</u>**

Connect compatible IP cameras using an RTSP/RTSPS stream or HTTP/HTTPS MJPEG address and the camera's login details.

Direct Camera runs through the Camera module in Respawn Companion- this is downloaded from the **Related Download** button on this product page, however this is optional if you are only using Home Assistant.

**<u>Home Assistant Connection</u>**

Enter your Home Assistant address and long-lived access token inside the widget.

Browse available camera entities, preview feeds, and select the cameras you want to display. Available video, audio, and controls depend on your Home Assistant integrations.

**Camera Controls**

Control supported cameras directly from the widget:

- Pan and tilt
- Optical zoom
- Recall saved camera positions
- Listen to compatible camera audio

Direct camera movement uses compatible ONVIF controls. Available controls depend on the camera's capabilities and configuration.

Directional zoom uses Zoom In and Zoom Out buttons where appropriate. Digital framing lets you crop and reposition the displayed image without moving the physical camera.

Audio starts off.

**Layout Customization**

Adjust tile names, dimensions, headers, rounded corners, and depth.

Additional support for setting the framing of each camera is included.

**Connection Recovery**

Interrupted or frozen direct feeds automatically attempt to reconnect.

Performance depends on your camera, network, computer, and active feeds.

**Privacy and Security**

Direct camera credentials are stored locally and encrypted.

Remove saved direct cameras or disconnect a connection method from the widget. Removing a saved connection does not delete footage from the physical camera.

**Compatibility**

Requires Windows, iCUE 5.52 or newer, and compatible camera streams or Home Assistant camera integrations.

Local streaming and ONVIF may need to be enabled in your camera's settings. Support varies by model and firmware. Cloud-only cameras cannot connect through Direct Camera.

**Disclaimer**

Camera is an independently developed community product and is not affiliated with or endorsed Home Assistant, or camera manufacturers.

All product names and trademarks belong to their respective owners. Again, this is in **BETA**, overtime this widget will continue to receive updates on additional camera compatibility as well as bug fixes.

widgets.description:
# Santa Tracker

Count down to Christmas and follow Santa's sleigh on Christmas Eve, right on your **CORSAIR XENEON EDGE**. Santa Tracker shows a live night-lights map of the world as Santa visits city after city, tells you when he'll reach your house, and brings messages from Santa, Mrs. Claus and the elves for each of your kids. **Free.**

## Features

**Christmas countdown**
- Days, hours, minutes and seconds to Christmas, plus sleeps to go
- Workshop news all December: toys built, the Nice List check, reindeer readiness
- On Christmas Eve morning: a sleigh launch countdown and the elves' launch checklist

**Live Santa tracking on Christmas Eve**
- Follow the sleigh city by city on NASA's Night Lights or Blue Marble map
- 425 cities, each reached around local midnight, time zone by time zone
- Your house is a real stop on the route: see how far away Santa is and when he'll arrive
- Presents delivered, distance flown and cookies eaten, counting all night
- Tap the map to switch between close-up and world view

**Weather along the route**
- Snow falls on the map where it's snowing as Santa flies through
- Conditions and temperature for each city, live on Christmas Eve
- Built-in typical Christmas Eve weather when you're offline and in the demos

**Messages for your kids**
- Add up to six kids with their name, age, one wish and Nice List status
- Santa, Mrs. Claus, the elves and Comet the reindeer send messages by name
- Messages never promise a specific gift, and every kid gets kind words, including the ones still "working on it"
- Tap a message for a new one

**Christmas morning**
- A Merry Christmas screen with the night's totals and the countdown to next year

**Fits every slot**
- Small, Medium, Large and Extra Large, horizontal or vertical
- Extra Large adds a Nice List report for your kids beside the map
- Demo modes let you try the countdown, launch, tracking and Christmas morning any day of the year
- Your own text, accent and background colors

## Requirements

- CORSAIR XENEON EDGE
- iCUE 5.46 or newer on Windows
- Internet connection for the map and live weather (without it, Santa Tracker switches to a radar-only map with built-in weather)

## Getting started

1. Add **Santa Tracker** to your XENEON EDGE. Extra Large shows the map, your kids and the messages side by side.
2. Check **Home City**. It's set automatically from your PC's time zone; search for your city if it's different.
3. Add your kids under **Kids**: name, age, a wish and Nice List or Working on it.
4. To see the tracker before Christmas Eve, set **Tracker Mode** to **Demo: Santa near your house**. Set it back to **Live** for the real night.

## Privacy

- Kids' names, wishes and settings stay on your PC. No account, no ads, no analytics.
- Map images come from NASA; the requests contain only map tile positions.
- Live weather comes from Open-Meteo on Christmas Eve, for the cities just ahead of Santa. Requests contain only those cities' locations, never your home city.

## Credits

- Map imagery courtesy of NASA's Global Imagery Browse Services (GIBS), part of NASA's Earth Science Data and Information System (ESDIS).
- Weather data by **Open-Meteo.com** ([open-meteo.com](https://open-meteo.com)), CC BY 4.0: live conditions, and the built-in Christmas Eve climate (ERA5 reanalysis, 2015-2024).

---

Made by **Nerd Powered** · [nerdpowered.tech](https://nerdpowered.tech)

*Santa Tracker is an independent, just-for-fun app. Santa's route is a simulation, not real flight data. Not affiliated with or endorsed by NASA or Open-Meteo. CORSAIR, iCUE, XENEON EDGE and Elgato are trademarks of their respective owners.*

NMS Dashboard

**No Man's Sky, live on the XENEON EDGE.** A cockpit with a big speedometer when you fly, and your survival, ship, wallet and the world around you when you don't.

> **Needs the NMS Deck bridge**, a small, open-source, read-only mod for NMS.py (MIT, on GitHub at AussieH/nms-deck-bridge), with Python 3.9 to 3.13 and the Steam version of No Man's Sky on Windows. NMS Deck for Stream Deck installs it with a press, or follow the bridge's readme. Start the game through NMS.py. Needs iCUE 5.51 or later.

In the ship: the cockpit

Climb in and the dashboard turns into a cockpit:

- **A big speedometer** in u/s, as the game's HUD shows it: 0 to 1,000 across most of the dial, then a compressed scale up to 20,000 for boost and the pulse engine.
- **Launch thruster, pulse engine and hyperdrive** as big bars with their percentages, red under a quarter.
- **Hull and shield** side by side.
- **Power**: balanced, weapons, engines or shields, the setting in use lit.
- **Your ship's name and class**, and where you are: in space, at a station, in planetary flight or landed.
- **In an exocraft** the speedometer runs to 200, beside your exosuit and the planet you are driving on.

Get out and it turns back by itself.

On foot and the pages

- **On Foot**: health and shield, life support and hazard protection as big bars, and the planet with its weather.
- **Ship**: your ship's hull, shield, charges and power, whether you are in it or not.
- **Wallet**: units, nanites and quicksilver, with what you gained this session.
- **Planet and System**: the planet in the game's own words (type, weather, flora, fauna, resources, scrap), the system's star, economy, wealth, conflict and race, and your galaxy, coordinates and portal address, shown as the portal's glyphs.
- **Dashboard**: the essentials of all of them at once.

Sizes, and more than one widget

- **Choose the size in iCUE** when you place the widget: Small, Medium, Large or Extra Large, across or upright. Every page is laid out for every size; big panels grow their type, small ones drop what has no room, never shrinking the text.
- **Show** picks what a widget shows: the whole dashboard or one page. Put one big dashboard on the Edge and smaller NMS Dashboard widgets beside it.
- **Touch**: tap the page tabs along the top of the dashboard.
- Drawn in NMS Deck's look: dark glass panels, corner brackets, amber and teal. Every shape is drawn in code.

Settings

- Show: the dashboard or one page. Page tabs and the cockpit switch, each on or off.
- Portal address: glyphs, digits, or both.
- Text, accent and background colour, and background transparency.

Private and fair

- The widget reads one folder, where the bridge writes its state file once a second. iCUE asks you once for permission. No network, no account; nothing leaves your PC, and the widget writes nothing.
- It shows what the game shows you, and the bridge only reads: no cheats, nothing changed in your game or save.

Unofficial

NMS Dashboard is an unofficial companion made by TeaTime. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by Hello Games; No Man's Sky is a trademark of Hello Games Ltd. NMS.py and pyMHF are separate open-source projects. The portal glyphs are redrawn by hand; no game files, logo, font or screenshot are used.

PC Spec shows your CPU and GPU temps and use, your game FPS and your fan or pump speed on your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE, so you know how hot your PC runs at a glance. It finds the right CPU and GPU readings on its own, turns amber and red at the alert level you choose, and works in all 8 sizes.

What makes it different: 45 styles, each with its own layout. Not just new colors: race car gauges with moving needles, glowing nixie tubes, VU meters, lab thermometers, an oscilloscope, a terminal, an aquarium and more. Pick one in the settings, or turn on the Style Button and switch with one tap on the screen.

Instruments: Race Dash · Cockpit · Nixie Tubes · Studio VU · Oscilloscope · Lab Thermometers · LCD Segments · Blueprint · Radar

Inspired by games: Souls-like (Dark Souls) · Fighting Game (Street Fighter) · Console Dark (PlayStation 5) · Pixel Arcade (8-bit arcade games) · Starship HUD (sci-fi games)

Minimal: Dark UI · All Black · All White · Liquid Glass · Swiss Poster · Native Dark

General: Cyberpunk · RPG · Retro OS · Terminal · Synthwave · Neon Signs · Tactical · Neo Brutalism · Sticky Notes · Chalkboard · Aquarium · Lava Lamp · Deep Space · Samurai · Sakura

Christmas: Christmas Lights · Snowy Night · Gingerbread

The styles are fan-made and only inspired by these games and anime: original art, colors and fonts, no logos and no characters. Not affiliated with or endorsed by their owners.

Good to know: FPS appears while iCUE has a game frame rate to show. If a reading shows a dash, pick the matching sensor in the widget settings. Requires iCUE 5.47 or newer.

Countdown shows the days until your next big moment right on your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE: a game launch, a trip, a birthday, a holiday. Add up to five events, tap the screen to flip between them, and on the day it says Today! with a little celebration. Under a day it counts hours and minutes, and birthdays and holidays can repeat every year. Works in all 8 sizes.

**What makes it different: three looks, and a picture for every event.** Pick one in the settings, or turn on the **Style Button** and switch with one tap on the screen.

**Scene:** a picture that follows the event icon · Winter Night (holidays and gifts) · Neon Horizon (game launches, movies) · Sunset Beach (vacations and trips) · Party (birthdays, parties, concerts) · Love (anniversaries) · Sunny Meadow (outdoors, pets, sports, school, work) · Aurora (any other day)

**Flip:** split-flap clock cards for days, hours and minutes, with each digit flipping as it changes

**Ring:** a glowing progress ring that runs out as the day comes and turns gold on the day, with your next events in small rings beside it

**Detailed view:** the full date, the time left down to the second, how much of the wait is behind you and, on large sizes, your next events.

**Good to know:** times follow this PC's clock and time zone. Dates are written in the iCUE settings, like 2026-12-25 (or 12-25 for every year). Requires iCUE 5.47 or newer.

Can't decide what to play tonight? Decide puts a prize wheel, real 3D dice and a gold coin on your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE. Tap the screen and the answer lands in big letters.

**Spin the wheel:** write your own question and 2 to 12 options in the settings. The wheel spins, the lights chase and the winning slice lights up.

**Roll the dice:** one to three dice tumble onto the stage and the total shows up big.

**Flip a coin:** a gold coin flies up and lands on heads or tails.

Switch between wheel, dice and coin with the big buttons on the screen. Every answer is drawn with your PC's secure random generator, so every option has the same chance. Turn on Recent Results to keep the last five answers in view.

Works in all 8 sizes of the XENEON EDGE, horizontal and vertical.

**Good to know:** your last mode and answers are saved on this PC, for this widget. Requires iCUE 5.47 or newer.

Death Counter turns your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a one-tap counter. Every time you die to that boss, wipe a raid or retake a shot, tap anywhere on the widget and the number rolls up. widgets.description:
**🫧 Flow Reset, a stretch and break reminder for the Corsair Xeneon Edge**

A free break timer that reminds you to get up, stretch, rest your eyes, then guides you through it: desk stretches and exercises for your neck, shoulders, back and wrists, a 20-20-20 style eye break, and a minute of guided breathing. Seated or standing, with length and frequency of your choosing.

✅ A soft chime and a warm glow when it's time to move
✅ One tap starts the routine, paced by the bubble
✅ Free, and it runs on its own, with no companion app or account

\--

**🧘 What it does**

Between breaks it sits idle on your Edge. Every 20-60 minutes the pool warms, a chimes is heard, and the screen notifies you it's time for a stretch.

Tap anywhere and it walks you through the break: a far look to rest your eyes, a few gentle moves for one part of your body, then a minute of slow breathing. Busy right now? Later moves it back 10 minutes.

\--

**🤸 Guided moves**

Each break works on a different area, so your posture changes through the day, rotating through neck, shoulders, upper back, lower back and hips, wrists and forearms, legs, and eyes. There are 28 moves between them, from shoulder rolls to squeeze blinks.

The bubble pulses once per rep and a ring fills as you go, so you never count or watch a clock. The words tell you when to switch sides.

Every move stays in a gentle, comfortable range. Skip anything that doesn't feel right.

\--

**🌬️ A minute to breathe**

Five slow breaths to finish. The bubble fills as you breathe in and empties as you breathe out, with soft surf underneath when the ambience is on. Pick In, pause, out, or Long exhale (in for 4, out for 6), or switch the breathing off.

\--

**👀 Eye rest**

Every break opens with 20 seconds of looking into the distance. A separate 20-second eye rest also comes up every 20 minutes, and you can turn that one off.

\--

**⚙️ Make it yours**

- Breaks every 20, 30, 45 or 60 minutes, about 1, 3 or 5 minutes long
- Standing moves: Some, More, or None for a seated-only routine
- Daylight, Dusk, or Auto, which drifts to Dusk in the evening while you're between breaks
- Chimes and ambience, chimes only, or silent, plus a volume slider
- Pause for an hour or until tomorrow from the corner menu
- Fits every Edge slot size

\--

**🚀 Setup**

1. Import the widget into iCUE and add it to a slot on your Xeneon Edge
2. Open its settings to choose how often and how long

Tips and the full list of moves: getflowkits.com/setup/flow-reset

\--

**📋 Worth knowing**

- Windows 10 or 11, and iCUE 5.47 or later
- Flow Reset is a wellness reminder and a guide for everyday movement, not medical advice. If you have an injury or a health condition, check with a professional before trying new moves

widgets.description:
RetroAmp

Bring the classic desktop music player to your **CORSAIR XENEON EDGE**. RetroAmp puts a pixel-perfect player, a working 10-band equalizer, a playlist and a big visualizer on your screen, plays internet radio and your own music, and wears thousands of classic Winamp 2 skins.

Features

**Internet radio**

- All of SomaFM built in, with live now-playing
- Search a worldwide directory of thousands of stations right from the widget settings
- Or paste any MP3 or AAC stream URL

**Your own music**

- Tap ADD on the playlist to browse the folders on your PC, right on the screen
- Add single songs, a whole folder, or a folder with its subfolders
- Keep up to 12 saved playlists; song titles come from your MP3 tags
- Seek, pause, shuffle and repeat, and pick up where you left off

**10-band equalizer**

- Preamp, ten bands and a live EQ curve
- Built-in presets, from Rock to Late Night
- Works on radio and your own music

**Visualizer**

- Spectrum bars with falling peaks, or an oscilloscope, driven by the actual audio
- A big visualizer window plus the classic mini display in the player

**Classic skins**

- An original built-in RetroAmp skin
- Load classic Winamp 2 skins (.wsz) from the Winamp Skin Museum: pick a curated one, search the museum, or paste a skin link
- The Eject button cycles through the curated skins

**PC Media**

- Show and control what Windows is playing (Spotify, browsers and other players)

**Fits any slot**

- Player, Equalizer, Playlist and Visualizer windows rearrange to fill Extra Large, Large or vertical slots
- Close any window with its X; bring it back with the EQ, PL or V buttons

Requirements

- CORSAIR XENEON EDGE
- iCUE 5.46 or newer on Windows
- Internet connection for radio, station search and skins (your own music plays offline)

Getting started

1. Add **RetroAmp** to your XENEON EDGE; Extra Large shows all four windows side by side.
2. Press Play to start SomaFM's Groove Salad, or pick a station under **Radio and Local Music → Station**.
3. For your own music, tap **ADD** on the playlist, then **FILE**, and browse to your music. Set **Music Folder** in the settings to choose where browsing starts.
4. Try a skin under **Skin**, or browse them at skins.webamp.org and paste a link into **Skin Link**.

Good to know

- The equalizer and visualizer work on radio and your own music. For PC Media, iCUE only shares the song name and controls, so the visualizer is animated and the EQ can't change PC audio.
- Some radio stations don't allow equalizer access; they still play, with an animated visualizer.
- RetroAmp only reads the folders you browse to. Playlists and settings stay on your PC; no account, no tracking.
- Like every touch-enabled iCUE widget, RetroAmp receives the touches on it, so iCUE's swipe-to-change-page gesture doesn't pass through it.

Credits

- Classic skin support builds on **Webamp** by Jordan Eldredge (webamp.org · github.com/captbaritone/webamp), used under the MIT License.
- Skins come from the **Winamp Skin Museum** (skins.webamp.org) and remain the work of their creators.
- Radio by **SomaFM** (somafm.com, listener-supported) and the community **Radio Browser** directory (radio-browser.info).

---

Made by **Nerd Powered** · nerdpowered.tech

*Not affiliated with or endorsed by Winamp, Nullsoft, Llama Group, SomaFM or Radio Browser. Winamp is a trademark of its respective owner. CORSAIR, iCUE, XENEON EDGE and Elgato are trademarks of their respective owners.*

Skycast Weather puts the real sky behind your forecast. The sun and moon sit where they actually are right now, the clouds match the cloud cover outside, and rain, snow, fog or lightning show up when they're happening where you live.

**What's on screen**

- Current temperature and conditions, high and low, feels like, wind and humidity
- An hourly temperature curve across the full width, with the chance of rain
- The next five days underneath

**Drag through the day**

Slide a finger along the hourly curve and the sky changes to that hour's weather. Let go and it comes back to now.

**Severe weather alerts**

When the National Weather Service issues a warning for your area, a banner goes up and the edges of the screen pulse red. Alerts cover US locations only.

**Made for the XENEON EDGE**

Every slot size, horizontal or vertical. Fahrenheit or Celsius, wind in mph, km/h, m/s or knots, your own text and accent colors, and a solid background if you'd rather not have the sky.

Free, with no account and no API key. Type a ZIP code or a city, or leave Location blank and it finds you.

Also from Widgetry: Tide Clock, Aquascape and Broadside, all here on the Marketplace.

**Your data**

Forecasts come from Open-Meteo and alerts from the US National Weather Service. All they get is a latitude and longitude. Auto location asks ipregistry (using the key iCUE already provides) or GeoJS for a rough position. No analytics, and nothing is stored off your PC.

Ant Empire puts a glass ant farm on your XENEON EDGE, and the colony lives on real time. Leave it for a week and you come back to a nest you didn't dig: tunnels branching deep into the soil, chambers for the queen, nursery, food and waste, and a sand mound growing on the surface. It keeps going while your PC is off.

The world is far bigger than the screen. Drag to look around and pinch or use + and - to zoom from the whole farm down to one worker carrying a seed. The minimap shows your tunnels and the rival colony's.

Every ant has a job. The queen lays eggs, nurses raise the brood and feed her, scouts find food and leave a scent trail home, foragers follow it, and diggers grow the nest. When food runs low, the colony moves workers from digging to foraging on its own.

Play along or just watch. Drop food, draw a trail for ants to follow or a tunnel for them to dig, follow an ant, or take control of one.

A rival colony lives across the farm: peaceful, raiding (your queen stays safe) or full war. Squish raiders and send a counter-raid. Weather and critters add rainstorms that flood low tunnels, a hunting spider and the odd lawn mower.

Four farm styles, three ant colors, three speeds, and a sky that follows your clock. Made for Large and Extra Large horizontal slots.

AI assisted.

widgets.description:
**Two ships. One horizon. Whoever reads the wind wins.**

It's dusk, the swell is picking up, and the other captain has your range. You drag back, watch the arc, and let go. Short, into the water. They fire back and your stern starts to smoke. Next shot you lead into the wind, and this time it lands. Fire breaks out on their deck, the hull settles, and a few turns later she slides under, stern first.

That's Broadside, a turn-based naval artillery duel for your XENEON EDGE.

**How it plays**

- **Aim like a slingshot.** Drag back from your ship and let go, or set angle and power with the buttons and tap Fire.

- **Read the wind.** It's shown in mph, blows at an angle, and shifts between turns.

- **Ride the sea.** Choppy and stormy swells lift and tilt both ships, and you can steam forward or back on a tank of fuel.

- **Watch the damage.** Smoke, then fire, then the hull sits lower in the water. Sink one and it goes down slow, with secondary explosions and a final gurgle.

**Who you're fighting**

- **The CPU at four levels,** from Deckhand to Admiral. It brackets its shots like a real gunner, and Admiral reads the wind almost perfectly.

- **A friend,** taking turns on the same screen with both names on the scoreboard.

- **Single round, best of 3 or best of 5.** A match in progress picks up where you left it.

**Make it yours**

- Calm, choppy or stormy seas

- Day, dusk, night, or a sky that follows your clock

- Sound effects for cannon fire, hits, splashes, crackling fires and the sea, plus a fanfare when you win and a sad horn when the CPU does

**Where it fits**

Play on a Large or Extra Large horizontal slot. Smaller and vertical slots run a live CPU-vs-CPU demo with your record, so the Edge never sits idle.

widgets.description:
Turn your **CORSAIR XENEON EDGE** into a full-screen starship operations console. Watch your hardware, control your music, fire Stream Deck actions and sound **Red Alert** when things run hot, all in a bold retro-futuristic sci-fi interface.

Features

**Primary Systems**

- Six sensor slots for CPU and GPU temperatures, loads, fans, pumps and more
- Give each sensor its own label, or hide it; the remaining rows grow to fill the space
- Segmented readout bars that update live

**Red & Yellow Alert**

- Tap the sidebar buttons to go to Red or Yellow Alert; tap again to cancel
- Automatic Red Alert: pick any sensor and a threshold, and the whole console goes red when it's reached
- Flashing title and status bar that show exactly which sensor tripped the alert
- Optional alarm sounds: choose from five styles (Explorer Whoop, Battleship Klaxon, Frigate Warble, Scout Pulse, Starbase Siren) with their own volume

**Command Keys (Stream Deck)**

- Eight touch keys backed by a virtual Stream Deck
- Assign any Stream Deck action; its icon and title appear right on the console
- Pick your virtual Stream Deck right in the widget settings, by the same name it has in the Stream Deck app, or create a new one with +
- Don't use Stream Deck? Turn Command Keys off and the other panels take the space

**Audio Subsystem**

- Now playing: song and artist
- Previous, play/pause and next controls

**Chronometer**

- Large local-time clock (12 or 24 hour)
- Live stardate
- The whole month at a glance, with today highlighted

**Make it yours**

- Dock the Sensors, Audio or Command panel with a tap; the others slide over to use the room
- Horizontal and vertical layouts for the Extra Large slot
- Four color palettes: Classic, Blue, Red and Yellow
- Set your own ship name and registry number
- Adjust text, accent and background colors, transparency and animations

Requirements

- CORSAIR XENEON EDGE
- iCUE 5.46 or newer on Windows (Command Keys need iCUE 5.52 or newer)
- Designed for the **Extra Large** widget slot (horizontal or vertical); smaller slots work but scale the console down
- Optional: the Elgato Stream Deck app for Command Keys

Getting started

1. Add **Starship Ops Panel** to the Extra Large slot on your XENEON EDGE.
2. In the widget settings, choose your sensors under **Sensors** and set the Red Alert sensor and threshold under **Starship Ops Panel**.
3. For Command Keys, open the Stream Deck app, choose a device under **Command Keys → Virtual Device** (or tap **+** to create one), then assign actions to that device in Stream Deck.

Good to know

- Song info comes from Windows media controls. Apps that don't report to them (for example the Pandora desktop app) won't show a track.
- Like every touch-enabled iCUE widget, the console receives the touches on it, so iCUE's swipe-to-change-page gesture doesn't pass through it.
- iCUE asks you to allow Stream Deck access and sound the first time; choose Allow.
- Runs entirely on your PC: no account, no internet connection, no data collection.

---

Made by **Nerd Powered** · nerdpowered.tech

widgets.description:
Take command of your ship with an immersive and highly customizable XENEON EDGE cockpit interface for Elite Dangerous.

Elite Dangerous Command Deck transforms your touchscreen into a dedicated control center for throttle management, cockpit panels, targeting, weapons, utility systems, power distribution, ship status, and frequently used commands.

**Command Interface**

The interface is divided into three integrated sections:

- A nine-position touch-and-swipe throttle ranging from full reverse to full forward speed, with illuminated chevrons, scroll-wheel support, a reversible layout, and dedicated Boost control.
- A central display providing access to the External, Comms, Role, and Internal cockpit panels.
- An interactive ship hologram providing access to Weapons, Utility, and Power control banks.

Each control bank supports up to twelve commands, providing **36 customizable controls**. The included layout covers targeting, hardpoints, weapon groups, landing gear, lights, Frame Shift Drive, cargo functions, flight assist, power distribution, and more.

**Live Ship Information**

The widget connects to the Respawn Companion Elite Dangerous Module to display current journal and ship-status information, including:

- Commander, location, and mission information
- Hull, fuel, shield, and cargo status
- Mass lock, landing gear, and cargo scoop indicators
- Active cockpit panel selection
- Toggle and control-state feedback
- Connection and update status

**Reactive Effects**

Optional effects respond to in-game events, including:

- A full-widget Frame Shift Drive tunnel animation
- Animated fire when your ship overheats
- Warning presentation within the central display
- Animated backgrounds, holographic elements, illuminated throttle states, and responsive button feedback

Animations can be disabled through the Companion Module for improved performance.

**Themes and Customization**

Choose from multiple built-in themes, including Elite Orange, Combat Red, Hot Pink, Imperial Violet, Holographic Blue, and additional styles. Individual customization overrides the selected theme, allowing themes to serve as flexible starting points.

Upload custom PNG images or animated GIFs for controls, toggled states, panel icons, map buttons, the ship hologram, and widget background.

Each of the 36 controls can be renamed, recolored, assigned custom artwork, converted into a toggle, rearranged, or hidden. Visible controls automatically reorganize to use the available space.

Landscape layouts are included for different XENEON EDGE mounting orientations.

**Respawn Companion Integration**

The required **Respawn Nexus** application and Elite Dangerous Module provide:

- Automatic or manual journal detection
- Configurable keyboard commands and modifiers
- Game-binding validation
- Control rearrangement
- Animation settings
- Widget and module compatibility checks
- Update notifications
- Direct module updates with visible download progress

The Companion can start with Windows and automatically reopen your most recently used game module.

**Required Download**

This widget requires the free **Respawn Nexus** application.

Install Respawn Nexus using the **Related Download** link, open its Game Library, and install the Elite Dangerous Module. Respawn Nexus, iCUE, software must remain running (runs in background) for touchscreen commands and live information to function.

Elite Dangerous Command Deck is an independently developed community product and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with Frontier Developments, CORSAIR, Elgato, or their subsidiaries.

Stay organized with Sidekick For Outlook & Teams, an interactive XENEON EDGE widget. Keep your calendar, inbox, and work conversations within reach while you work or game.

**What’s Included**
View your schedule with day, week, and month calendar views. See upcoming meetings, open event details, and accept, tentatively accept, or decline supported meeting invitations.

Read email, browse folders, filter unread messages, and change read or unread status. Follow supported Teams conversations, see contact availability, and manage your own Teams status and focus sessions.

Connect multiple Microsoft accounts and switch between them. Show or hide Calendar, Mail, and Chats to give your preferred panels more room. Reply and message actions open Outlook or Teams for composing.

**Customization**
Choose through different appearance themes and arrange your view around the information you use most. Display your calendar, inbox, and chats together, or keep only the panels you need.

**<u>Work & School Accounts</u>**
Your organization may require administrator approval before Sidekick can connect. If Microsoft displays “Need admin approval,” your IT team must approve access. Respawn cannot override your organization’s restrictions.

**Send your IT team our IT approval and permissions guide before purchasing.** This is found on the ***<u>"Setup Guide"</u>*** button in the product details page. It explains the requested permissions, where your data goes, and how to approve the app.

Personal Microsoft accounts support Outlook.com mail and calendars without organizational admin approval. Microsoft may still ask you to accept permission prompts. Teams chat features require a supported work or school account.

We are a verified Microsoft publisher and this application is approved from Microsoft. All data is local and Respawn Icons has no visibility into any user data.

**Setup and Connectivity**
Requires Respawn Companion to run. Install the module through our Companion, add the widget in iCUE, and choose Sign in with Microsoft.

Sign-in takes place on Microsoft’s own page. Review the requested permissions, then return to the widget.

The module connects directly to Microsoft. Your email, calendar, chat content, and access tokens are not sent to Respawn servers. Sign-in tokens are stored locally and protected using Windows encryption.

**Compatibility**
Designed for XENEON EDGE. Respawn Companion and the Outlook & Teams module must remain running for connected features to work.

Personal Microsoft accounts support Outlook.com mail and calendars. Work or school accounts require an Exchange Online mailbox and appropriate Teams access for chat features. Personal Teams chats are not supported.

Available features depend on your account, licensing, granted permissions, and organization policies.

Choose from a range of tiles

- **Media & Audio:** Playback controls, album artwork, speaker and microphone volume, and individual app volume controls (audio mixer).

widgets.description:
A photoreal IN-14 nixie tube clock with warm, flickering numerals, coloured underglow and an optional tubeless mode that turns the screen itself into the vacuum tube modelled on the classic Soviet IN-14 valve.

Each tube is drawn with photoreal domed glass, mica spacers, a honeycomb anode and every unlit cathode stacked behind the glowing digit, just like the real thing. The numerals glow a warm neon orange with a gentle, lifelike flicker, the old digit fades as the next one lights, and the separator lamps pulse once a second.

Underglow lights the tubes from below and spills onto the walnut base. Choose orange, red or blue to match your setup, or turn it off.

Tubeless mode hides the glass and base with a single switch, leaving only the glowing cathodes and their mesh floating on the screen. The XENEON EDGE itself becomes the vacuum tube.

Settings:

- 12 or 24-hour time
- Seconds on or off (six tubes or four)
- Underglow: orange, red, blue or off
- Tube flicker on or off
- Show or hide the tubes and base
- Scales cleanly to every widget slot, from Small to Extra Large. 
- Reads the time straight from your PC, with no helper apps or internet connection needed.

**📬 Flow for Gmail on the Corsair Xeneon Edge**

✅ A countdown to your next calendar meeting, and one press to join it on Google Meet
✅ Your week or month from Google Calendar, beside your Gmail inbox
✅ Tap an email and read it right there on the panel
✅ Customize the look, plus the order of each item in small, medium, large and extra large layouts

\--

**🗓️ What it does**

The answer to "what's next", on your desk instead of in a browser tab. The big number counts down to your next meeting, turning amber and then red as it gets close, with what it is, when it starts, and a Join that opens the Meet link.

When the meeting starts, the panel becomes that meeting: minutes left over a progress bar and who's in it. The rest dims so it reads from across the room, and a touch lifts the dim if you need your inbox mid-call.

Beside it, your calendar as Today, 7 days or Month, every account you have connected has in its own color on the calendar, shared and holiday calendars included.

\--

**📥 Your inbox**

- Newest email first, with Gmail's own labels, stars and importance markers
- Tap an email to read it on the panel, without touching the PC
- Show Primary only, everything, or everything but Promotions
- An Unread button for when you only want what's waiting

\--

**👥 More than one account**

Sign in to as many Google accounts as you use, work and personal, and they merge into one view: your next meeting is your next meeting, whichever calendar it came from. Tap an account's chip to hide it for a while.

\--

**🔒 Privacy, and where your data goes**

A panel sits where people can read it, so press the eye in the corner and every name and subject turns to a gray bar. The shape of your day stays, the detail goes.

The data goes nowhere except Google. No FlowKits server in the middle, no account to create, no telemetry.

- You sign in on Google's own page in your own browser. I never see your password
- What comes back is stored on your PC, encrypted by Windows with your own key
- It's read-only, and it can't send, delete, archive or mark anything as read
- Sign out and it's gone, or remove FlowKits from your Google account at any time

\--

**🎨 The small stuff**

- Fits all eight slot sizes, horizontal or vertical, rearranging itself rather than shrinking
- Dark, Light and Contrast themes, or pick your own background and accent color
- Focus hides the inbox for as long as you like, and tells nobody
- 12 or 24-hour time, following your Windows clock unless you say otherwise

\--

**⚙️ Setup: 2 steps**

A widget inside iCUE can't hold a Google sign-in, so a small companion app does that part.

1. Add the widget to a slot in iCUE
2. Download the companion, run it, and sign in with Google

I wrote a guide for every step: getflowkits.com/setup-companion/gmail

\--

**📋 Worth knowing before you buy**

- Windows 10 or 11, and iCUE 5.47 or later
- It uses a small companion app that runs in the background on your PC
- It reads your mail and calendar and never changes them, so marking as read and archiving stay in Gmail
- Work accounts: if your organization limits which apps can connect, your admin may need to allow FlowKits first. getflowkits.com/it-approval/gmail is written for them

\--

Disclaimer

Gmail, Google Calendar and Google Meet are trademarks of Google LLC. FlowKits is not affiliated with or endorsed by Google.

widgets.description:
CamView — Keep your camera in view.

Bring a live camera feed to your Corsair iCUE display. Watch a workshop, check a 3D print or keep an overhead camera beside your game, with a dark interface and your choice of accent colour.

YOUR CAMERA, YOUR VIEW

• USB webcams and virtual cameras, where camera access is available in the iCUE host.

• Direct HTTP/HTTPS MJPEG streams from compatible cameras and local gateways.

• Snapshot polling for cameras that provide a compatible still-image endpoint.

• Cover, Contain and Stretch framing, plus digital pan and zoom on touch displays.

MADE FOR YOUR SETUP

Use CamView on the 14.5-inch Corsair XENEON EDGE, compatible iCUE Dashboard cards, circular LCD pump caps and keyboard LCDs. Enable round display mode to keep the image inside a circular frame. Use the interactive CamView edition for EDGE/Dashboard. Install the display-only CamView LCD companion for pump and keyboard LCDs, which iCUE excludes from interactive widgets. Configure that edition through native iCUE settings; it uses the default USB camera and has no touch controls. Widget availability depends on your hardware and iCUE version.

TOUCH TO TAKE CONTROL

Tap XENEON EDGE to reveal controls, change the fit, cycle USB cameras or reconnect a network feed, and pause or resume the source. The controls fade after four seconds. The optional overlay shows source status, resolution and available frame-rate information. Digital pan and zoom adjust the displayed image; they do not move your camera.

TWELVE LANGUAGES

Settings and on-screen text support English, German, Spanish, French, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Traditional Chinese and Ukrainian. CamView follows iCUE automatically, with an optional display-language override for widget text.

QUICK SETUP

1\. Install CamView through Elgato Marketplace, or import the downloaded .icuewidget file using + in iCUE's widgets section.

2\. Add it to your compatible display and open its settings.

3\. Select USB / Virtual Webcam, or choose a network source and paste its direct stream or snapshot URL.

4\. Choose your fit, accent colour and overlay preferences.

REQUIREMENTS & COMPATIBILITY

Windows; iCUE 5.52+ and widget framework 1.9.0+; a compatible iCUE LCD; and a camera source. USB capture depends on Windows permissions, drivers and camera support in iCUE's embedded browser. If USB access is blocked, use a compatible network endpoint. Audio capture is disabled.

A camera's login page is not a stream URL. Snapshot endpoints must permit cross-origin image access; polling is capped at 20 FPS. RTSP cameras need a local gateway that supplies MJPEG or snapshots; a go2rtc example is included in the setup guide. Raw RTSP, HLS and WebRTC player pages are not direct inputs. Keep camera credentials in your gateway rather than the widget URL.

CamView displays one source per instance and does not record video or provide security alerts. Frame rate and resource use depend on your source, network, gateway and hardware. Pause stops the source; hidden pages suspend their sources and reconnect when visible. MJPEG playback rate is set by the camera or gateway.
