Capture the thought. Keep the moment.

A sudden idea. A reminder for later. Something you don’t want to forget.

**Turn your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a ready-to-record voice notebook.** Tap the big red Record button, say what’s on your mind, then tap Stop to save.

Your thoughts, within easy reach

- **Record up to 10 minutes per note**, with automatic stopping at the limit.

- **See your microphone responding** through a live waveform and input meters.

- **Check levels before recording** with switchable live monitoring.

- **Play back saved notes**, rename them and organise them into folders.

- **Set up your audio on first launch**: choose your microphone and playback output, then test the sound.

- **Choose dark or light mode**, with readable text and generous touch controls.

- **Use Medium, Large or XL layouts** on XENEON EDGE.

From tomorrow’s priorities to your next project idea, Audio Notes gives passing thoughts a place to stay.

Before you buy

Audio Notes is designed for short voice recordings. **Each note is limited to 10 minutes**, and saving requires available space in the local library. Free space by deleting recordings you no longer need.

Recordings are stored locally within the widget. Treat them as local notes rather than a permanent archive.

A working microphone and microphone permission are required. Playback-device selection depends on iCUE support. Live monitoring uses your microphone but does not save audio until you start recording.

**Tap record. Say it. Get back to your day.**

**Made by iConCity.com**

widgets.description:
**🎵 Music Pro: your Spotify, Apple, iTunes or YouTube music player, live on the Xeneon Edge, with touch controls!**

Your Edge is sitting under your monitor with the perfect canvas for what you're playing. Music Pro fills it 🎶

\--

Works with `🟢 Spotify, 🔴 Apple Music, 🎵 iTunes, ⚪ Tidal, 🟣Deezer, 🟠 SoundCloud, ▶ YouTube Music and anything that shows up in Windows' own media popup.`

✅ Every album repaints the whole panel: artwork, colors, and controls take their look from what you play.

✅ A real control surface, not a display: drag the progress bar to seek, tap the artwork to pause, swipe it to skip.

\--

**🎨 Your Music Sets the Look**

Play a track and the panel rebuilds itself around it. The album art becomes a soft color field across the whole widget, the progress bar and controls pick up an accent pulled from the sleeve, and high-resolution artwork loads in automatically. A fiery orange record gives you a fiery orange panel. Put on something moody and the panel follows.

\--

**👆 Touch Controls That Feel Right**

Grab the progress bar and the scrubber grows under your finger, with a time bubble as you drag. Tap the cover to play or pause. Swipe it to skip tracks. Shuffle and repeat show their real state, and if your player doesn't support a control, the button tells you instead of doing nothing.

\--

**🖥️ Built for Every Slot**

All eight Edge slot sizes, portrait and landscape, each with its own layout rather than a stretched version of one design. When nothing is playing, the panel shows a soft collage built from albums you've actually listened to, plus a one-tap button to reopen your music app.

\--

**🔌 One Small Companion App (Required)**

The companion app is required to be installed on your PC (setup guide explains why), but in short, this companion app reads what Windows is playing and sends your taps/input back to your music player. Download it once from our setup guide, and it quietly starts with Windows from then on. No window left open, nothing to configure.

Setup guide: getflowkits.com/setup-companion/music-pro

\--

**🎧 Works With Your Player**

Spotify, YouTube, and anything that appears in Windows' own media popup (the one your keyboard's play key brings up). If Windows can see it, Music Pro shows it and controls it. A few players never report to Windows at all, and those stay invisible to any widget.

\--

**⚙️ Make It Yours**

Eight bundled fonts, from clean Inter to poster-bold Bebas Neue. Accent color pulled from the artwork or pinned to one you choose. Backgrounds: album art at your chosen blur, your own image, a solid color, or a gradient. Subtle motion you can slow down or switch off.

\--

**🚀 Quick Install**

1. Add Music Pro to a slot on your Edge in iCUE.
2. The panel walks you to the companion download (one click from the widget options).
3. Extract, run once, press play. Done.

\--

**💻 Requirements**

- Windows 10 or 11
- iCUE 5.47 or newer with a Corsair Xeneon Edge
- The free FlowKits companion app (link above)

Questions or ideas? We read everything: getflowkits.com/contact

widgets.description:
**📅 Flow for Outlook and Teams is your email, calendar and workplace communication for the Corsair Xeneon Edge**

✅ A countdown to your next meeting on your calendar, and one press to join it
✅ Your whole day, week or month as a calendar grid, with the inbox and Teams chats beside it
✅ Set your status or start a focus block without opening a window
✅ Show 1-4 modules at one time: Meeting, Calendar, Outlook Email, Team Chats
✅ Small, Medium, Large and Extra Large widget sizes plus vertical layouts

\--

**⚠️ Work account? Check this before you buy ⚠️**

Your organization decides which apps its people may connect, and many are set to ask an admin first. If yours is, Microsoft stops the sign-in and says so, and nothing on my side changes that.

**Send your admin getflowkits.com/it-approval/outlook-teams first.** It is written for them: every permission with its reason, where the app runs, what leaves the PC, and which button to press. One approval covers this and the Stream Deck version too.

Personal accounts sign straight in with nothing to approve.

\--

**🗓️ What it does**

The answer to "what's next", on your desk instead of behind a window. The countdown is the big number: how long until the next thing, what it is, who called it, and a Join that joins that meeting and not a different one.

Beside it, your day as a grid, so you see the shape of the afternoon rather than a list. Today, 7 days or Month.

\--

**📥 Mail and chats**

- Your Microsoft Outlook inbox, newest first, unread counts per account
- Microsoft Teams chats on the next page
- Tap a message to open it, press and hold to mark it read

\--

**🟢 Your status, without the window**

Available, Busy, Do not disturb, Be right back, Appear away or Appear offline, straight from the panel. Or start a focus block, 25m to two hours, and your status hands itself back to Teams when time is up.

\--

**👥 More than one account**

Sign in to as many Microsoft accounts as you use, work and personal, and it all merges into one view: your next meeting is your next meeting, whichever calendar it came from. Each gets its own color, carried by every meeting, email and chat.

\--

**🔒 Privacy, and where your data goes**

A panel sits where people can read it, so press the eye in the corner and every name and subject turns to a grey bar. The shape of your day stays, the detail goes.

The data itself goes nowhere except Microsoft. No FlowKits server in the middle, no account to create, no telemetry.

- You sign in on Microsoft's own page in your own browser. I never see your password
- What comes back is stored on your PC, encrypted by Windows with your own key
- FlowKits is a Microsoft Verified Publisher, so the consent screen shows a verified badge, not the unverified warning
- Sign out and it is gone. You can also revoke it from your Microsoft account

What it asks for: read calendar, read mail and mark as read, read Teams chats, set your own Teams status. The calendar is read-only.

\--

**🎨 The small stuff**

- Fits all eight slot sizes, rearranging itself rather than shrinking
- Graphite, Light and Contrast themes, or custom
- In a meeting, the panel becomes that meeting, and one press hands it back
- It updates itself quietly in the background, signed

\--

**⚙️ Setup: 2 steps**

A widget inside iCUE cannot hold a Microsoft sign-in, so a small free companion does that part.

1. Add the widget to a slot in iCUE
2. Download the companion, run it, and sign in with Microsoft

I wrote a guide for every step: getflowkits.com/setup-companion/outlook-teams

\--

**📋 Worth knowing before you buy**

- Windows 10 or 11, and iCUE 5.47 or later
- The free companion has to be running. It is not optional
- Personal Microsoft accounts have no Teams, so those parts sit quiet

\--

Disclaimer

Microsoft, Microsoft Outlook, and Microsoft Teams are trademarks of the Microsoft group of companies. FlowKits is not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft.

Your music deserves more than a flat tile. Nocturne Deck turns your XENEON EDGE into a classic hi-fi LCD deck: glowing 7-segment clocks, album art, a scrolling now-playing line and a real 48-band spectrum that moves with every beat.

New in 1.1: put your cover on a spinning turntable, wrap it in a radial spectrum, watch analog VU needles swing, or let the whole display take on the colours of the album cover. Seven skins, from Gunmetal to Tube Amp, with Pumpkin Night and Frost arriving with the seasons.

It works with the player you already use: Spotify, YouTube and any browser, AIMP (including classic versions), VLC, foobar2000, Apple Music, TIDAL, Deezer and more.

What's Included

\- Widget in all four sizes: Extra large, Large, Medium and Small

\- Four layouts: Classic deck, Cover, Turntable and Radial spectrum (the last three at Extra large and Large)

\- Turntable: the record spins and the tonearm follows the song

\- Radial spectrum: 72 rays around the cover, which pulses with the bass

\- Moving background in the colours of the album cover

\- Real 48-band spectrum, VU and PPM meters, analog VU needles

\- Touch keys: Prev, Stop, Play, Pause, Next; tap-or-drag seek bar

\- Volume knob with LED ring, Mute and 100% keys

\- App volume mixer and one-tap speaker / headset switch

\- Sleep timer (15, 30 or 60 minutes)

\- Idle clock with the date and the last song when nothing plays

\- Now-playing line with format, kHz, kbps, file size and channels; elapsed, remaining and total time; system clock

\- Settings in English, German, French, Spanish and Italian

\- Nocturne Bridge: free companion app for Windows, with full source code

Customization

\- Seven skins: Midnight, Gunmetal, Carbon, Pearl White, Tube Amp, Pumpkin Night, Frost, or Seasonal (changes by itself through the year)

\- Seven LCD colours, including one taken from the album cover

\- Spectrum styles Bars, Peaks, Line, an EQ-curve view, VU or PPM meters

\- Larger song title, readable from across the room

\- Right-hand panel: keypad or app mixer

\- Media source: follow what's playing or lock it to one player

\- Visualizer listens to the whole PC or only your chosen player

\- Your own title, subtitle and label; album art, backlight, 12/24-hour clock, accent colour, transparency

\- The eject key opens any app or website you choose

\- Colours, styles and meters can also be changed on the touchscreen

Data and Connectivity

Nocturne Deck reads the song title and artist through iCUE. Everything else — player choice, album art, play state, seeking, volume, the app mixer and the real spectrum — comes from Nocturne Bridge, a free tray app from the Related Download link (https://github.com/GiannisM72/nocturne-bridge/releases/latest). The app mixer needs Nocturne Bridge 1.5 or newer.

Nocturne Bridge runs only on your PC and listens on localhost. It never connects to the internet, needs no account and collects no data. Audio is analysed live and never recorded. No admin rights, no installer; to remove it, exit the tray app and delete its folder.

Windows may show "Windows protected your PC" the first time, because the bridge is new and independently made. Click More info, then Run anyway. The full source code is included.

Setup takes about a minute: add Nocturne Deck to your Edge in iCUE, set the size to Extra large, then unzip Nocturne Bridge into a folder you keep and start NocturneBridge.exe.

Without the bridge, the widget still shows the current song and basic controls.

You're thinking about heading to the beach. Look down at your XENEON EDGE: the water there sits at the real tide height for your spot right now, a big countdown tells you how long until the next high, and the moon in the corner is tonight's actual moon.

That's Tide Clock, a live window on the water for your desk.

**What you see**

- **The live tide.** Layered waves at the real height for your beach, so you can tell if it's coming in or going out.

- **The countdown.** Time to the next high or low, with its height and time, and the clock up top.

- **Tonight's moon.** Tap it for the month ahead: every phase, the next full and new moon, the spring tides marked, and a bar for each day's tide range.

**Touch it**

- **Scrub through time.** Drag across the water and the tide follows to any hour, then eases back to now when you let go.

- **Look ahead.** Tap the arrows to see a week out.

- **Save your spots.** Keep up to three, like your home beach, a fishing pier and a vacation town, and tap the station name to switch.

**The scenery**

The sky follows the real sun, from daylight to golden hour to a starry night with moonlight on the water and the odd shooting star. A lighthouse sweeps its beam after dark, or pick a harbor scene or open water. Sailboats, tugs, ferries, kayaks and the occasional rubber duck drift by. Four themes plus Custom colors.

**Setup takes one line**

Enter a city, a ZIP code or a NOAA station ID, or leave it blank and Tide Clock finds the station nearest you. Predictions come from NOAA for about 3,500 US stations, Maine to Alaska and Hawaii.

**Where it fits**

Feet or meters, 12 or 24 hour time, every slot size in both orientations, and 12 languages.

Tides from NOAA. Not for navigation.

widgets.description:
WHAT GAME GUIDE IS

Game Guide turns the whole XENEON EDGE screen into a reader for game guides: walkthroughs, collectible checklists, interactive maps and skill trees, right beside your game. It comes with no guides for specific games. You import guide files (.ggp) and keep as many as you like. A small sample guide for a fictional game is installed on first run so you can try everything.

GETTING GUIDES IN

Tap Library, then Import guide, and choose a .ggp file (the chooser opens on the Edge). Importing a newer version of a guide updates it and keeps your progress. In the library, Open starts a guide, Hide and Show move it in and out of the quick switcher, and Delete (tap twice) removes it and its progress. Tap the guide title at the top to switch guides.

READING

The list on the left shows the contents. Pages mix text, numbered steps, callouts (tips, warnings, missables, bosses), pictures, tables and key facts, and links jump to other pages, checklists, maps or skill trees. Tap any picture to see it full screen.

CHECKLISTS

Tick items off with a tap. Groups show counts, the top bar shows overall progress, and Hide completed removes finished items. Items can carry Missable and Needs notes, and walkthrough steps can tick a checklist item. Progress is saved per guide.

MAPS

Drag to move, pinch with two fingers (or use + and -) to zoom, and Fit to see the whole map. Pins open a card and can be marked found, which also ticks the checklist item. Checklist items have a Map button that jumps to their pin. Legend and layer chips hide or show pins, Hide found clears collected ones, and routes and regions are drawn on top. Full screen gives a map the whole widget.

SKILL TREES

Tap a skill, then + or - to spend points. Skills stay locked until the ones they need have a point, and you cannot remove a point another skill depends on. Load preset builds with one tap; your points are remembered.

TWO PANES

Two panes splits the screen into two equal halves that can each show a page, checklist, table, map or skill tree. Open in Left / Right above the list decides where the next tap opens. Links open in the same half, except map and skill tree links, which open in the other half so you keep reading. Each pane has a Back button that remembers its last 10 steps, including scroll position.

YOUR LOOK

Text, accent and background colour and transparency follow your Edge page theme, or use Custom Style for your own. Only the background fades.

OFFLINE AND PRIVATE

Works fully offline with no account. Guides and progress are stored inside the widget, survive iCUE restarts, and are lost if you delete the widget. Nothing is sent anywhere. No permissions or plugins are needed.

REQUIREMENTS AND LIMITS

XENEON EDGE, iCUE 5.47 or newer, Windows, Extra Large slot only. Guide files up to 60 MB. The screen supports two touches at once. Maps show pins only where the guide author supplied coordinates.

MAKE YOUR OWN GUIDES

A guide is a .ggp file (a zip with a manifest, data and images). The open-source ggp-guide-builder skill for Claude Code, in the project repository, builds comprehensive guides from your notes, wiki text, checklists and map data: step-by-step walkthroughs, collectibles, areas and tips, validated, with credits and sources, written in its own words and never guessing map coordinates. Copy skills/ggp-guide-builder to \~/.claude/skills/ and run npm install inside it once, then ask Claude: Make a Game Guide for \[game\] from these notes.

widgets.description:
Browse, organize, launch, install, and close your games with a polished XENEON EDGE widget that transforms your touchscreen into a dedicated library interface for Steam.

Library for Steam automatically detects locally installed games, displays their cover artwork, tracks active downloads, and provides fast access to your collection without requiring you to navigate the full Steam client.

**<u>What’s Included</u>**

The widget includes two integrated library layouts:

- A responsive poster-grid layout with dedicated Favorites, Recently Played, Installed, and Uninstalled categories.
- An immersive showcase layout that keeps the selected game centered while surrounding titles can be browsed using touch gestures, mouse dragging and the scroll wheel.

Select an installed game to launch it directly through Steam. Running games display a visible status banner and can be closed from the widget. Uninstalled games can optionally be displayed and selected to open their installation page in Steam.

Add non-steam apps to the canvas as well and launch/close directly from the widget.

Download activity appears inside the widget for all of your games.

**<u>Favorites and Organization</u>**

- Create custom categories to place games in a designated header.
- Favorite games are placed in a dedicated category above the rest of the library and receive priority in showcase mode. Favorited games display a custom star indicator and can be unfavorited directly from their poster.
- Individual games can be hidden without being removed from Steam. Hidden titles can be restored at any time through the widget settings.
- A Recently Played section provides quick access to your latest games.

**<u>Steam Profile Features</u>**

An optional Steam Web API key unlocks additional features, including:

- Steam profile image and username
- Deals, Wishlist, News updates
- Launch & Exit **Big Picture Mode**
- Online, Away, Invisible, and Offline status
- Status controls directly from the widget
- Total game playtime
- Recently played games
- Friends currently playing each game
- Owned and uninstalled games

Friends currently playing a game are displayed above a games poster when active.

The Steam Web API key is optional. Installed-game detection, cover artwork, launching, closing, and local library features continue to work without it. The widget does not store the key itself.

**<u>Customization</u>**

Personalize the widget through the iCUE configuration panel with adjustable background opacity, custom background artwork, and an option to toggle the header.

Upload a custom image, or animated GIF to create a personalized library background. Background opacity can be reduced completely for use over another XENEON EDGE layout.

Responsive layouts are included for Small, Medium, Large, and XL widget sizes.

**<u>Required Download</u>**

This widget requires the free Library Companion application to detect Steam installations, retrieve local game information, proxy cover artwork, monitor downloads, launch games, and close running games.

Download Respawn Companion using the **Related Download** link on this product page. It is a lightweight app that will open on your PC's initial startup and run in the background. It allows the widget to bridge the local data from your Steam.

Your Steam profile and game details must be set to **Public** for profile metadata, playtime, recently played games, and friends-playing information to appear in the widget.

**<u>Disclaimer</u>**

Library for Steam is an independently developed third-party community product and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with Valve Corporation, Steam, CORSAIR, Elgato, or their respective subsidiaries.

Steam, the Steam logo, game names, game artwork, and all related trademarks and intellectual property belong to Valve Corporation and their respective publishers and owners.

Bring your music to life with Music, an interactive XENEON EDGE widget that combines album artwork, responsive playback controls, and an audio-reactive visualizer. Switch between three distinct layouts and control compatible media players directly from your touchscreen.

Supports any media that is played through your PC. Spotify, Apple Music, YouTube, etc.

**What’s Included**
Choose from three ways to display your music:

- **Classic:** Large album artwork alongside track information and playback controls.
- **Pulse:** A circular or horizontal audio-reactive visualizer surrounding your album artwork, with colorful accents on stronger peaks.
- **Vinyl:** A rotating record presentation with interactive scrubbing for supported players.

View available track titles, artists, album artwork, and playback progress. Artwork inspired colors and a blurred background adapt the display to your current media. When artwork is unavailable, a music-note placeholder keeps the layout clean.

Like-Favorite-Thumbs Up your favorite songs directly from the widget as long as your application supports it.

An additional application-based volume slider is available for your convenience.

Play or pause, skip tracks, and access shuffle and repeat when supported by your player. Select a specific media source or let Music choose automatically.

**Touch Controls and Gestures**
Controls appear when you interact with the widget and automatically hide after inactivity, leaving a clean, artwork focused display.

Double-tap to play or pause. Swipe left for the next track or right for the previous track. Album artwork and track information follow your finger as you swipe, allowing you to reverse direction or cancel before releasing.

Use the progress bar or drag the record in Vinyl mode to seek through a track when supported.

**Customization**
Switch between Classic, Pulse, and Vinyl directly inside the widget using the draggable glass-style layout selector.

Choose your preferred media player through the built-in source menu. Your layout selection is remembered locally, and the background automatically adapts to the available album artwork.

**Data and Connectivity**
Music requires the **Music module** in our **Respawn Companion** app, available through the **Related Downloads** link on this product page.

Track information and playback controls come from compatible Windows media sessions. Available features depend on what each player exposes.

**Compatibility**
Designed for XENEON EDGE and iCUE on Windows. Supports compatible desktop and browser-based media players that expose Windows media controls.

Artwork, track information, seeking, previous-track behavior, shuffle, and repeat support vary by application. Vinyl scrubbing changes playback position.

**🚜 Farming Simulator 25 - Farmhand (Edge), the FS25 farm manager's board for your Xeneon Edge**

✅ Every hired worker on one board: what they're doing, why they stopped, and one tap to jump into their machine
✅ Every field you own, with its crop, what it needs next and when the harvest window closes
✅ What's in your silos, what it's worth, and the best place to sell it today

\--

**🧑‍🌾 What it does**

The hardest part of FS25 (imo) is keeping track: a helper stalls two fields over, potatoes are a day from the end of their window, and wheat peaks while you're busy baling. This Xeneon Edge widget keeps the whole farm on the screen under your monitor

The Overview leads with Needs you: a stuck worker, a harvest window about to close, a pen with under a day of food. Warnings run on game time and follow your save's settings, so with seasonal growth off it won't nag you about harvest windows. Tap one to open its page, or Clear to quiet the list until something new comes up.

\--

**👷 Workers**

- State, the reason a helper stopped, diesel, condition and how long it's been on the job
- Jump In puts you in that worker's machine
- Show it on the map, or stop it from the Edge
- Your whole crew's wages per hour

\--

**🌱 Fields**

- Every field you own, with crop, state and size
- What each one needs, as icons: lime, weeds, stones, plowing, fertilizer, rolling, mulching. Anything your save switches off stays hidden
- Planting and harvest windows on a calendar strip, and the days left
- Show a field on the map, or jump to its crop's prices

\--

**💰 Market**

- What you have in storage and what it's worth
- The best sell point right now, and the top buyers' prices per 1,000 L
- The season curve, so you can tell whether this month is a high or a low
- Set a route to the buyer, or open the game's own price screen

\--

**🐄 Animals and production**

- Each pen's food, water, straw, health and productivity
- Milk, eggs and the other outputs waiting to be sold
- Production chains, flagged before an input runs dry or the output fills up

\--

**📋 Contracts**

- Yours first, with progress and a deadline in game time
- New offers sorted by reward, with field size and time left
- Accept an offer from the Edge

\--

**🕐 Always on screen**

The header carries the game clock, weather and forecast, days left in the month and your balance. Tap the clock to change game speed. Where the game has a menu for something, a button opens that page in the game.

It fits every iCUE slot, either way up, and it's at its best in Large and XL.

\--

**⚙️ Setup: 3 steps**

A widget can't read the game on its own. It uses the FlowKits companion app on your PC, plus Farmhand, a small mod that's free for anyone.

1. Add the widget to a slot in iCUE
2. Install the companion from the setup guide. It starts with Windows from then on
3. The companion installs the Farmhand mod for you. Tick it in your save's mod list, and the panel's setup check tells you if anything's left

Already using the Farmhand Stream Deck plugin? It's the same mod, and the deck and the Edge run side by side.

I wrote a guide for every step: getflowkits.com/setup-companion/fs25

\--

**📋 Worth knowing before you buy**

- Windows 10 or 11, iCUE 5.47 or later, and Farming Simulator 25 on PC
- It uses the FlowKits companion app, which runs in the background
- Tested in single player only. I can't test multiplayer here, so it's untested: it may show only part of the farm, and some buttons may be host-only. If you try it, please tell me how it goes
- Courseplay and AutoDrive drivers show on the workers board, but they aren't fully tested yet
- Your farm's data stays on your PC

\--

Disclaimer

Farming Simulator is a trademark of GIANTS Software GmbH. FlowKits is not affiliated with or endorsed by GIANTS Software.

- **Widget Personalization** contains color and media-background options.

**Requirements**
iCUE 5.52 or later on Windows. Available readings depend on your hardware and what iCUE reports.

**Privacy**

The widget makes no network requests and does not collect or transmit personal data. Hardware telemetry, FPS data, and Stream Deck communication remain within the local iCUE widget environment.

Give your ideas somewhere to live.

NOTE BOOK brings the character of a traditional notebook to your XENEON EDGE, with textured covers, custom colours and animated page turns.

Create separate notebooks for work, projects, plans or everyday thoughts. Type on the left page, then choose text or sketching on the right. Format your writing, change your paper and capture ideas with six drawing tools.

When you need something again, search a word or phrase and tap a result to open its page.

Your notebooks save automatically on your device. Built-in backup and restore lets you keep a separate copy of your collection.

**Features**

- **Multiple notebooks** — create, name and browse your own collection.

- **Flexible pages** — combine typed notes with sketches, or write on both sides.

- **Text formatting** — choose fonts, sizes, colours, bold, italic, underline, lists and alignment.

- **Custom paper** — plain, ruled, dotted and grid styles, with a choice of paper colours.

- **Six drawing tools** — fountain pen, pencil, fineliner, highlighter, marker and eraser.

- **Drawing controls** — adjustable thickness, custom ink colours, undo and clear-sketch confirmation.

- **Simple search** — find words and phrases in the selected notebook’s titles and typed notes.

- **Personal covers** — customise notebook names and cover colours.

- **Automatic local saving** — keep your collection between sessions.

- **Backup and restore** — export all your notebooks, pages, drawings and settings.

- **Animated opening and page turns** — with support for reduced-motion preferences.

**Requirements**

- CORSAIR XENEON EDGE.

- Windows PC running a compatible version of CORSAIR iCUE.

- **XL widget slot required — 2536 × 696.**

- Physical keyboard recommended for typing notes.

**What’s included**

One downloadable `.icuewidget` package for importing into iCUE. A new installation starts with one empty notebook, ready to name and personalise.

**Before you buy**

This is a digital widget; hardware is not included. NOTE BOOK saves locally and does not provide cloud sync. Search covers typed text, not automatic recognition of handwriting.

iCUE stores exported backups in its widget-managed downloads folder. Keep a separate copy of important backups before removing the widget or reinstalling iCUE.

**Created by iConCi**

**Obsidian Connect — Your Obsidian Vault on the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE**

Your notes at a glance while you work: today's note with its tasks, what's due, your bookmarks, and the days you wrote.

No sign-in, no Obsidian plugin, no keys to paste. Obsidian Connect reads your vault straight from its folder on your PC. No Stream Deck required.

**Key Features:**

**Everything In Your Vault**

- **Today:** Today's daily note, with its date, its tasks to tick and how many are done. Tap the date to open it in Obsidian, or start it from your own template if it isn't there yet.
- **Tasks:** Every open task in your vault, a folder, a tag or one note, with due dates and priorities as the Tasks plugin writes them (and Dataview's due::). Show what's overdue, due today or this week. Tap the box to tick one off.
- **Quick Capture:** Add a task, a bullet or a line to today's note or to an inbox note, under the heading you choose, and keep quick lines one tap away.
- **Pinned And Recent:** Your Obsidian bookmarks and the notes you edited last. Tap one to open it in Obsidian.
- **Note Preview:** Any note, rendered: headings, lists, tasks, quotes and callouts, scrolling inside the tile.
- **Stats:** Notes, words, your writing streak and open tasks, with a calendar of the days you wrote, a year at a glance.
- **Tags:** Your tags and how many notes carry each. Tap one to search for it in Obsidian.

**Four Designs That Fit Any Tile**

- **Paper, Cards, Focus and Strip:** A clean page, a grid of cards, one big thing with the rest beside it, or a strip where your tasks run along the Edge.
- **Every Size:** From the smallest tile to the whole Edge, horizontal or vertical. Long lists scroll inside the tile.
- **Yours To Adjust:** Text size, spacing, which parts show, how dates read, what a tap does, and your own colours.

**One Widget, Several Jobs**

- **Widget Types:** Add Obsidian Connect more than once and give each copy a job in iCUE's widget settings: today's note on one, tasks on another, your streak on a third.

**Your Notes Stay Yours**

- **Only The Line You Touch:** Ticking a task or capturing a line changes that one line and nothing else in the note. If the note changed since the widget read it, nothing is written.
- **On Your PC:** Your notes never leave your computer.

**Requires Qaem Hub (Free Companion App)**

- **Qaem Hub:** Obsidian Connect needs Qaem Hub, QaemDev's free companion app for Windows: qaemdev.com/products/qaem-hub. Its Obsidian Connect module reads your vault, and only widgets you allow can use it.
- **Just This Module:** Rather not install Qaem Hub? Get the Obsidian Connect Module, a small app with only this module inside: qaemdev.com/downloads/obsidian-connect-module-setup.exe. Qaem Hub takes it over, settings kept, if you install it later.
- **Looks After Itself:** Qaem Hub runs quietly in the tray, starts with Windows and keeps itself up to date.

**Requirements**

- CORSAIR iCUE 5.45 or newer with a XENEON EDGE, on Windows.
- Obsidian, with a vault opened at least once on this PC.

**Notes**

- **Daily notes follow your vault's own settings:** the same folder, date format and template Obsidian uses.
- On iCUE 5.51 and newer, allow the widget to reach 127.0.0.1 in iCUE Settings, Widget Access, if iCUE asks.

Obsidian Connect is not affiliated with or endorsed by Obsidian.

SETUP GUIDE: https://qaemdev.com/guides/obsidian-connect-setup

**Kickify — Your Kick Channel on the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE**

Your Kick stream at a glance while you play: live or offline, viewers and uptime, chat you can answer, and every follow, sub, gift and KICK as it happens.

Sign in once with Kick in your browser. No password to type into the widget, no keys to paste. No Stream Deck required.

**Key Features:**

**Everything On Your Channel**

- **Live Status:** LIVE or offline, viewers, uptime, your title, category and tags, with this stream's new followers, subscribers, gifted subs and KICKs.
- **Chat:** Your chat, live, with each chatter's colour and badges. Tap a line to reply, tap the send bar to write as your channel, and keep quick replies one tap away.
- **Moderation:** Hold a chat line to delete it, time the chatter out for 10 minutes or ban them. A ban always asks twice.
- **Activity:** Follows, subs and resubs, gifted subs, KICKs and channel rewards as they come in. Pick which ones show.
- **Go Live Card:** Your title and category ready to change, and a Go live button that opens Kick's stream dashboard. While you're live it shows your uptime and opens your channel.
- **KICKs Leaderboard:** Your top gifters this week, this month or all time.
- **Title And Category:** Tap the stream title to change it, and search Kick's categories right on the Edge.

**Four Designs That Fit Any Tile**

- **Studio, Pulse, Bubbles and Ticker:** A dashboard panel, one big number with the rest beside it, an overlay look with every line on its own bubble, or a strip where the newest lines run along the Edge.
- **Every Size:** From the smallest tile to the whole Edge, horizontal or vertical. Each design lays itself out for the tile it's in, and chat scrolls inside the tile, always starting at the newest message.
- **Yours To Adjust:** Text size, spacing, row pictures, badges, times, corners, which parts show, and your own colours for LIVE, follows, subs, gifts and KICKs.

**One Widget, Several Jobs**

- **Widget Types:** Add Kickify more than once and give each copy a job in iCUE's widget settings: live status on one, chat on another, alerts on a third.

**Requires Qaem Hub (Free Companion App)**

- **Qaem Hub:** Kickify needs Qaem Hub, QaemDev's free companion app for Windows: qaemdev.com/products/qaem-hub. Its Kickify module holds your sign-in, encrypted on your PC. The widget never sees it.
- **Just This Module:** Rather not install Qaem Hub? Get the Kickify Module, a small app with only this module inside: qaemdev.com/downloads/kickify-module-setup.exe. Qaem Hub takes it over, settings kept, if you install it later.
- **Chat And Alerts:** Kick delivers chat, follows, subs, gifts and KICKs only to a web address, so they reach your PC through qaemdev.com.
- **Looks After Itself:** Qaem Hub runs quietly in the tray, starts with Windows and keeps itself up to date.

**Requirements**

- CORSAIR iCUE 5.45 or newer with a XENEON EDGE, on Windows.
- A Kick account.

**Notes**

- **Kick has no way to start a stream from outside:** Go live opens Kick's stream dashboard, and your streaming app does the rest.
- Disconnect any time in the widget or in Qaem Hub.
- On iCUE 5.51 and newer, allow the widget to reach 127.0.0.1 in iCUE Settings, Widget Access, if iCUE asks.

Kickify is not affiliated with or endorsed by Kick.

**Broadlink Connect — Your Broadlink Remotes on the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE**

Your TV, air conditioner and fan remotes, on your XENEON EDGE. Broadlink Connect learns the buttons of the remotes you already have through a Broadlink device, lays them out as a remote pad, chains them into macros and switches your Broadlink smart plugs. Everything stays on your own network. No Stream Deck required.

**Key Features:**

**Your Remotes, Learned**

- **Learn Any Button:** Press Learn, point your remote at the Broadlink and press the button. Infrared for TVs, air conditioners, fans, soundbars and projectors, and 433 MHz radio on the RM pro models for blinds, fans and doorbells.
- **Try Before You Save:** Send the learned code once to check it, then name it.
- **Your Layout:** Pick the buttons for each copy and their order, leave gaps where you want them, and set the columns. Rounded, round or pill keys.
- **Names, Icons and Colours:** Give each button a name, one of more than 30 icons (or let it guess from the name) and its own colour.
- **Rooms:** Group buttons by room and give each copy one room: the living room's TV on one tile, the bedroom's air conditioner on another.

**Macros**

- **Several Buttons in a Row:** "Movie night" turns the TV on, switches to HDMI and turns the lamp off, with the waits you choose between steps.

**Plugs and Sensors**

- **Smart Plugs:** Switch Broadlink SP plugs on and off, with live power use on the models that measure it. The MP1 strip's four sockets each get their own switch.
- **Temperature and Humidity:** From an RM4 with its sensor cable, an RM pro or an e-Sensor, which also shows air quality, light and noise.

**One Widget, Several Jobs**

- **Four Layouts:** Remote (a pad of buttons), Devices (plugs, sensors and remotes as cards), Big button (one button, macro or plug, as large as the tile) and Sensor. Each fits any tile size, landscape or portrait.
- **Make It Yours:** Density, key shape, icons, names, states, text size and colours, in iCUE's widget settings or in the widget.

**Private and Local**

- **No Account, No Cloud:** Broadlink Connect finds your Broadlink devices on your network and talks to them directly. Nothing goes through Broadlink's or QaemDev's servers.
- **Your Codes Stay on Your PC:** Learned codes are kept by Qaem Hub on this PC and never leave it.

**Requires Qaem Hub (Free Companion App)**

- **Qaem Hub:** Broadlink Connect needs Qaem Hub, QaemDev's free companion app for Windows: qaemdev.com/products/qaem-hub. Its Broadlink module finds your devices and asks you once to allow the widget.
- **Just This Module:** Rather not install Qaem Hub? Get the Broadlink Module, a small app with only this module inside: qaemdev.com/downloads/broadlink-module-setup.exe. Qaem Hub takes it over, settings kept, if you install it later.
- **Looks After Itself:** Qaem Hub runs quietly in the tray, starts with Windows and keeps itself up to date.

**Requirements**

- CORSAIR iCUE 5.45 or newer with a XENEON EDGE, on Windows.
- A Broadlink RM mini, RM4 or RM pro (for remotes) or a Broadlink SP plug, set up on your Wi-Fi with the Broadlink app, on the same network as your PC.

**Notes**

- If the Broadlink app has the device locked, turn Lock device off in its settings; Broadlink Connect says when that's needed.
- On iCUE 5.51 and newer, allow the widget to reach 127.0.0.1 in iCUE Settings, Widget Access, if iCUE asks.

Broadlink Connect is not affiliated with or endorsed by Broadlink (Hangzhou BroadLink Technology Co., Ltd.).

**SETUP TAKES TWO MINUTES**

Install Qaem Hub, add its Broadlink module, import the widget in iCUE and learn your first button.

SETUP GUIDE: https://qaemdev.com/guides/broadlink-connect-setup

**Home Assistance — Your Smart Home on the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE**

Your Home Assistant on your XENEON EDGE, live. Lights, thermostats, blinds, media, scenes, locks, sensors and cameras, with the controls for each, a tap away. Works with any device your Home Assistant already controls, Tapo, Hue, Alexa-connected devices and more included. No Stream Deck required.

**Key Features:**

**Control Your Home**

- **Lights:** On and off with a tap, brightness with a slider, and six colours for colour bulbs.
- **Climate:** The target temperature with − and +, the mode, and what it's doing now.
- **Blinds and Covers:** Position slider, open, stop and close.
- **Media:** What's playing with its artwork, play and pause, skip, and volume.
- **Scenes and Scripts:** Run them with one tap.
- **Locks, Alarms and Garage Doors:** Lock and arm in one tap. Unlocking, disarming and opening work only for the ones you allow, and always ask for a second tap.

**See Your Home**

- **Sensors:** Temperature, humidity, power, energy, air quality and battery, each with its last 24 hours as a graph.
- **Cameras:** A fresh still every 10 seconds; tap for a new one now.
- **Live:** Every change in your home shows the moment it happens.

**One Widget, Several Jobs**

- **Six Layouts:** Tiles, Control (one device, big), Room, Sensors, Scenes and Camera. Each fits any tile size, landscape or portrait.
- **Your Entities:** Pick which devices each copy shows, by room or kind, in the order you like. Or let it choose: lights for Tiles, sensors for Sensors, your scenes for Scenes.
- **Make It Yours:** Density, tile style, names, states, levels, text size and colours, in iCUE's widget settings or in the widget.

**Easy, Secure Sign-In**

- **Finds Your Home Assistant:** It looks for Home Assistant on your network. Pick it and approve with your own Home Assistant login, in your browser.
- **Or a Token:** Prefer a long-lived access token? Paste it in, with a three-step guide.
- **Private:** The sign-in stays encrypted on your PC, in Qaem Hub. Nothing goes through QaemDev's servers.

- **Qaem Hub:** Home Assistance needs Qaem Hub, QaemDev's free companion app for Windows: qaemdev.com/products/qaem-hub. Its Home Assistant module keeps the connection to your Home Assistant and asks you once to allow the widget.

- **Looks After Itself:** Qaem Hub runs quietly in the tray, starts with Windows and keeps itself up to date.

**Requirements**

- CORSAIR iCUE 5.45 or newer with a XENEON EDGE, on Windows.

Home Assistance is not affiliated with or endorsed by the Home Assistant project, Nabu Casa, TP-Link or Amazon.

**SETUP TAKES TWO MINUTES**

Install Qaem Hub, add its Home Assistant module, import the widget in iCUE and tap Connect.

**Wave Link Connect — Your Wave Link Mixer on the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE**

Mix your audio from the touchscreen next to your keyboard. Wave Link Connect puts Elgato Wave Link's mixer on your XENEON EDGE: a fader, mute and live meter for every channel, both mixes, the output you listen on and your microphone.

No alt-tabbing, no covering your game. Wave Link Connect is laid out for the tile you give it, from the smallest to full width, landscape or portrait: what doesn't fit is left out, so nothing is ever squashed or cut off.

**Key Features:**

**Four Designs**

- **Console:** A strip per channel, side by side: picture, name, a tall fader with its live meter, the level and a mute button.
- **Rows:** A line per channel with a long fader. Wide tiles get columns; tall tiles get roomier rows.
- **Pads:** A big square per channel. Tap to mute (the pad turns red), slide its fader along the bottom to set the level, and watch the level ring.
- **Monitor:** The Personal and Stream mixes as wide faders, the output you listen on (Headphones, Speakers, …) and your microphone's mute.

**Your Mix, Your Way**

- **Pick The Mix:** The faders set the Personal Mix or the Stream Mix.
- **Pick The Channels:** Choose which channels show and in what order, or show them all. Add the mix's own fader first or last.
- **Live Meters:** Beside the fader or inside it, updated live.
- **Safe By Design:** A fader moves only when you slide it, never on a tap. "Show only" keeps a stray touch from changing a level at all.

**One Widget, Several Jobs**

- Add Wave Link Connect more than once and give each copy its own design, mix and channels: a Console for your apps, Pads for quick mutes, Monitor for where you listen.
- **Make It Yours:** Filled, thin or segmented faders, density, corners, text sizes and colours, in iCUE's widget settings or on the touchscreen. Follow iCUE's screen colours if you like.
- **Clear States:** Wave Link closed or not installed, or Qaem Hub not running: each one shows the fix, with a button for it.

**Qaem Hub (Free Companion App, Required)**

- Wave Link only talks to Elgato's own software, so Wave Link Connect reaches it through Qaem Hub, QaemDev's free companion app for Windows: qaemdev.com/products/qaem-hub. Switch on Wave Link in Qaem Hub and Wave Link Connect connects. No account, nothing to copy.

How your store is doing, at a glance: today's revenue against yesterday's, every new sale as it comes in, your MRR and your next payout.

**Your Store At A Glance**

- **Revenue:** Today, this week or this month, gross or net after Stripe's fees and refunds, with the change against the period before. Switch the period with the tabs on the tile.
- **Live Sales Feed:** Sales, refunds, disputes, failed payments and payouts, newest first, with who bought what and the card. Tap one for its details right in the tile, or hold it to open it in Stripe.
- **Sale Alerts:** The tile flashes when a sale comes in, with a soft chime if you like.
- **The Figures That Matter:** MRR and active subscriptions, new customers, your balance and next payout, refunds, failed payments and open disputes.
- **Daily Chart:** Revenue per day for the last two weeks or the last month, today in your accent colour. Tap a day to see its total.

**Four Designs That Fit Any Tile**

- **Ledger, Feed, Figure and Strip:** The full picture, a live list of sales, one big number you can tap through, or a strip along the whole Edge.

Use your personal Outlook calendar to your XENEON EDGE with Calendar for Outlook.

View upcoming events, manage your schedule, respond to invitations, and open meeting links through a clean touchscreen interface designed for quick access throughout the day.

**Calendar Views**

Navigate your schedule using four familiar calendar layouts:

- Day
- Week
- Month
- Year

Smaller widget sizes use streamlined layouts that keep your next events visible without unnecessary controls.


**<u>Work & School Accounts</u>**
Your organization may require IT approval before your email can connect. If Microsoft displays “Need admin approval,” your IT team must approve access. Respawn cannot override your organization’s restrictions.

**Send your IT team our IT approval and permissions guide before purchasing.** This is found on the ***<u>"Setup Guide"</u>*** button in the product details page. It explains the requested permissions, where your data goes, and how to approve the app.

Personal Microsoft accounts support Outlook.com mail and calendars without organizational admin approval. Microsoft may still ask you to accept permission prompts. Teams features require a supported work or school account.

We are a verified Microsoft publisher and this application is approved from Microsoft. All data is local and Respawn Icons has no visibility into any user data.

**Microsoft Account Connection**

Select **Add Account**, sign in with Microsoft through your default browser, and approve the requested permissions.

This release supports personal Microsoft accounts with Outlook calendars, including Outlook.com, Hotmail, Live, and MSN addresses. Addresses from competing consumer email providers are not supported.

Multiple supported accounts can be connected and managed independently. Saved connections are designed to persist across restarts and compatible widget updates, although Microsoft may occasionally require you to sign in again.

**Create and Manage Events**

Create events directly from your XENEON EDGE.

Supported event controls include:

- Event titles and descriptions
- Start and end times
- Calendar selection
- Locations
- Guest invitations
- Deletion of eligible events
- Drag-and-drop rescheduling of eligible events

Existing editable events can be moved to another time by pressing and dragging them across the Day or Week calendar.

**Invitations and Meetings**

Invitations display their current response status using distinct visual treatments.

Open an invitation to:

- Accept
- Respond Maybe
- Decline
- Review event details
- Open supported meeting links
- Continue managing the event in Outlook

Successfully declining an invitation removes it from the widget’s calendar view. Supported meeting links open in your computer’s default browser.

**Calendar Customization**

Choose individual colors for connected calendars and control which calendars appear.

Light and dark appearance modes are available.

**Event Reminders**

Optional reminders display approximately 15 minutes before eligible scheduled events, showing the event name, starting time, and available actions.

**Privacy and Security**

Users sign in directly on Microsoft’s website. The widget never receives or stores Microsoft passwords.

Saved authorization tokens are encrypted on your device. Our sign-in service processes tokens during connection and renewal and temporarily stores encrypted sign-in handoffs.

Connected accounts can be removed from the widget at any time. 

**Disclaimer**

Calendar for Outlook is independently developed and distributed under Respawn Icons. It is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with Microsoft or CORSAIR.

Microsoft, Outlook, Hotmail, MSN, Microsoft To Do, Teams, CORSAIR, and XENEON EDGE are trademarks of their respective owners.

This is a **BETA** product. While thoroughly tested, it may contain undiscovered issues.

widgets.description:
**Launchify — Your Apps, One Tap Away on the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE**

**Turn your XENEON EDGE into a launcher that actually knows what your PC is doing. Every app you pin is a live tile: dim when it's closed, lit when it's running, ringed when it's the window you're looking at right now. Tap it to launch it. Tap it again to bring it forward.**

No alt-tabbing, no hunting through the taskbar, no Stream Deck required. Pin your game, your browser, your chat app and your capture software once; then run your whole desk from the touchscreen beside it.

**Key Features:**

Live App Tiles

- Real State, Not Guesses: Closed, running, minimized, sitting in the tray, or in front; read straight from the desktop's windows, several times a second.

- Window Counts: "Running · 3" tells you how many windows an app has open, and a ×2 chip appears when it's running more than once.

- Tray Apps Counted Too: Lightshot, Steam, a chat app you closed to the tray; no window to find, but Launchify still shows it as running.

- Real Icons: Pulled from the exe itself at up to 128px and cached, so your tiles look like your apps.

One Tap Does The Obvious Thing

- Closed → Launches It: Straight from the exe, with your own command-line arguments if you set any.

- Running → Brings It Forward: Restores it from minimized and puts it in front, wherever it was.

- In Front → Your Call: Minimize it (the default), open another window, close it, or do nothing.

Every Gesture Is Yours To Assign

- Three Taps, Not One: A tap gets its own action for a closed app, a running app, and the app already in front.

- Double Tap & Long Press: One action each — launch, focus, new window, minimize, close, force close, move to the next monitor, open the app menu, or nothing at all.

- App Menu: Focus, New window, Minimize, Close app and Force close, plus rename the tile, add arguments, reorder, and remove.

Closing, With A Confirm You Can See

- Two Taps, Clearly: The app turns red, says Close? and drains a bar for the couple of seconds it stays armed — a half-noticed tap can never take a window with it.

- Force Close: Task Manager's End task, for the app that stopped answering. Its own confirm, its own colour, and both confirms can be switched off.

Built For More Than One Monitor

- Where Everything Is: Each running app carries the number of the screen it's on — numbered the way Windows numbers them, so it matches your display settings.

- Send It There: Tap another number in the app menu to move the app's windows to that screen. Maximized windows are restored, moved and maximized again on the new one.

- Opens On: Pin where an app should start. Windows gives no say in that, so Launchify watches for the window and places it as it appears.

- Next Monitor: Available as a gesture, so a double tap can walk an app across your screens.

Pin Anything In Two Taps

- Running Now: Everything with a window this second, ready to pin.

- Installed: Your whole Start Menu and Desktop, resolved to the real exe behind each shortcut.

- Browse: Opens a real file picker on your PC for anything else.

- Stays Open While You Work: Each row marks itself ✓ Added as you go, with an ✕ to take it back off — no trips back and forth.

**Requires Qaem Hub (Free Companion App)**

- **Qaem Hub:** Launchify needs Qaem Hub, QaemDev's free companion app for Windows: qaemdev.com/products/qaem-hub. It runs Launchify's helper, which does the launching, focusing and moving that a widget can't do on its own.
- **Looks After Itself:** Qaem Hub runs quietly in the tray, starts with Windows and keeps itself up to date. Already have the old Launchify Helper? Qaem Hub replaces it by itself and keeps your settings.

**SETUP GUIDE:**

https://qaemdev.com/guides/launchify-setup

**Audio mixing, microphone control, playback-device switching, and now-playing media controls for XENEON EDGE.**

**BIO-GRID Audio Module** is part of the BIO-GRID series from Opulent Hardware—a collection of coordinated XENEON EDGE widgets designed to bring advanced controls and a cohesive interface to your Xeneon Edge.

Pair Audio Module with other BIO-GRID widgets, including BIO-GRID Command Array, to create a visually unified control surface for audio, shortcuts, system functions, and complex workflows. Each BIO-GRID widget works independently, so Command Array and other modules are not required to use Audio Module.

**BIO-GRID Audio Module** combines per-application volume control, microphone management, playback-device switching, app organization, and now-playing media controls in one cohesive interface.

Pin and reorder the applications you use most, adjust master or individual application volume without leaving your current task, switch between speakers and headphones, and manage your default microphone. The MEDIA view adds album artwork, track information, live progress, play/pause, previous/next, and supported press-and-hold seeking.

The interface adapts across every horizontal XENEON EDGE widget size. Extensive personalization options let you coordinate Audio Module with other BIO-GRID widgets or create your own look using custom text, accent, canvas, and card colors; background media; transparency; brightness; glass blur; and album-art blur.

**Key features**

- Master and per-application Windows volume control

- Speaker, headphone, and headset switching from the widget

- Default microphone switching, gain, mute, live input level, and privacy activity

- Album artwork, title, artist, album, source, and live track progress

- Play/pause and previous/next media controls

- Tap to skip; hold Previous or Next to seek when supported by the media application

**Required companion software**

BIO-GRID Audio Module requires the separately installed Opulent Hardware Module Runtime for Windows audio mixing, microphone control, device switching, album artwork, track progress, and supported seeking.

The Runtime uses Windows audio and media APIs and exposes a local-only service at `127.0.0.1:17652`. It does not listen on your local network, require an account, connect to a cloud service, record audio, or transmit audio or personal data off your PC.

The widget requests access only to this local loopback address. Basic now-playing metadata and transport controls can fall back to iCUE’s bundled Media provider.

**Quick Setup**

- Install **BIO-GRID Audio Module** from the iCUE Marketplace.

- Download and launch the **Opulent Hardware Module Runtime** companion app.

- Find the Opulent Hardware icon in the Windows notification area.

- Right-click the icon and enable **Start with Windows** for seamless automatic startup.

- In iCUE, add BIO-GRID Audio Module to a horizontal XENEON EDGE widget slot.

**Troubleshooting**

If BIO-GRID Audio Module cannot connect, confirm that the Opulent Hardware Module companion is installed and running. Then open **iCUE Settings → Widget Access → BIO-GRID Audio Module** and ensure URL access to `localhost:17652` is enabled.

**Related keywords**

Audio, volume mixer, microphone, media controls, now playing, Spotify, Apple Music, Windows audio, XENEON EDGE, BIO-GRID, BIO-GRID Command Array, Opulent Hardware, touch controls, desktop control

**Privacy summary**

No account is required. Neither the widget nor the Runtime uses a cloud connection. Audio remains on your PC, and the local Runtime accepts requests only from the same computer through `127.0.0.1:17652`.

Cave Nexus Edge turns your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a calm, creator-focused studio dashboard: your tasks, your work time, what is playing and quick controls for your PC, all on one 2560x720 touch screen. It sits under your main monitor all day without shouting for attention.

TASKS

Add tasks with a due date, duration and priority. Start typing and your past tasks are suggested, so repeat jobs take one tap. Pick a duration from presets (15 min to 16h) or type your own. A calendar marks the days that have tasks and opens that day's list when you tap it. Deleting asks first, then offers Undo.

WORK SESSIONS

Press play on any task to start its timer. The task's duration becomes your goal and its name shows under the timer. When time is up the timer flashes for a minute, then keeps counting until you stop. Pause, take timed breaks with optional reminders, and COMPLETE (or tick the task off) to save it. Press play again later and it picks up where it left off. It keeps time through restarts, sleep and iCUE reloads.

TASKS WINDOW

One list for what you have lined up and what you have done. Tasks you have not started yet sit at the top, soonest due first, each with START to put it on the timer; below them every task you have ticked off and every saved session, with its date, start and end time, time worked and breaks, and CONTINUE to pick one back up. Above it, your current session and your hours worked. One tap copies the whole table for Excel, Google Sheets or Notepad.

MEDIA

Title, artist, app and artwork, a progress bar you can drag, previous, play/pause, next and volume, and 28 bars that move with whatever your PC is playing, in a colour of their own.

QUICK CONTROLS

Mute, mic mute, Switch Sound (tap for the next output, hold for the full list), Lock, Restart, Shutdown and Task Manager (Lock is one tap; Restart and Shutdown are press-and-hold, so a stray touch cannot end your session), up to twelve shortcuts of your own to launch programs, folders or web addresses, six to a page, in any order, a kitchen timer that remembers the timers you set and rings until you stop or postpone it, Movie Mode (dims the whole dashboard for film night, tap to restore), and swiping left or right to change iCUE pages using the shortcuts you set in iCUE Screen Setup.

MAKE IT YOURS

Colours are set in iCUE. Pick any accent colour and the whole dashboard is tuned to match, or set your own text, background, button and visualizer colours, in iCUE's Widgets settings; every change shows straight away. Background transparency fades the background and panels, never the text. The writing and icons on a button are worked out from the colour behind them, so a label stays readable whatever fill you pick, while the fill itself is used exactly as you chose it. In the dashboard's own Options: 12 or 24-hour clock, Movie Mode brightness, the timer's alarm volume, work goal and break settings, your Tasks list, Open iCUE, the Tom's Cave shop, and Reset all data with a second confirmation.

SETUP (ABOUT 2 MINUTES)

Control your smart home directly from your touchscreen with Home Assistant Companion, a customizable XENEON EDGE widget that provides quick access to your Home Assistant devices, entities, sensors, lighting, climate controls, locks, and custom actions.

While quality-of-life improvements and fixes are ongoing, the wide variety of smart-home products, integrations, and individual setups means compatibility and behavior may vary between users. Feel free to report or suggest things you'd like on our Discord.

Some Home Assistant devices or custom integrations may require manual configuration. With more testing, the experience will improve, be sure to report any feedback to our discord.

**What’s Included**
Home Assistant Companion automatically detects supported entities from your Home Assistant installation and organizes them into a responsive, customizable dashboard.

Control lights, switches, smart locks, thermostats, fans, air purifiers, scenes, media devices, and other connected equipment. Compatible devices can display additional controls such as brightness sliders, color selection, temperature adjustment, HVAC modes, percentage values, status information, and multi-step options.

Cards can be resized, repositioned, and arranged freely across the dashboard. Different card sizes reveal additional information and controls while adapting their layout to the available space.

When automatic detection does not produce the desired result, programmable buttons, percentage sliders, and stepped sliders can be added manually using Home Assistant entity IDs and services.

Home Assistant Companion connects directly to your Home Assistant server using the local address and Long-Lived Access Token you provide.

**Customization**
Personalize the dashboard through the iCUE configuration panel with custom backgrounds, transparency settings, header visibility, theme colors, refresh frequency, and typography controls.

Individual cards support customizable names, icons, artwork, primary and secondary colors, font colors, active-state colors, font sizes, control types, state wording, and advanced Home Assistant actions.

Cards can be dragged into custom positions and resized for compact, medium, large, horizontal, or vertical layouts. Your dashboard configuration is stored locally so your preferred layout and card settings can be restored between widget sessions.

**Configuration Notice**
Home Assistant Companion is currently new. Home Assistant supports an extensive range of devices, integrations, entity types, and custom services, so automatic detection may not handle every configuration perfectly.

Users can manually configure card behavior when an entity is not detected correctly. Features, compatibility, interface behavior, and configuration options may change as development continues.

**Disclaimer**
Home Assistant Companion is an independently developed product and is not endorsed by, sponsored by, or affiliated with Home Assistant, Nabu Casa, Corsair, or their respective subsidiaries.

Home Assistant, Corsair, XENEON EDGE, iCUE, and all related names, trademarks, logos, and intellectual property belong to their respective owners.

Users are responsible for maintaining lawful access to their Home Assistant installation, protecting their server credentials and access tokens, and securely configuring any devices or services connected to the widget. No copyright or trademark infringement is intended.

HWiNFO Sensor Dashboard turns CORSAIR XENEON Edge into a customizable live hardware telemetry display powered by the HWiNFO sensors already available on your Windows PC.

Pick essentially any numeric sensor HWiNFO exposes: CPU temperatures, utilization, clocks and power; GPU temperature, hotspot, load, power, VRAM and fans; RAM usage; motherboard, VRM and chipset sensors; storage temperatures and activity; network readings; fans and pumps; voltages; currents; and other readings exposed through Shared Memory.

Each selected sensor shows its current value in the exact unit reported by HWiNFO, bounded rolling history, and local dashboard-session minimum, average and maximum. Configure warning and critical thresholds per sensor, favorite readings you use often, search large sensor lists, and apply quick CPU/GPU, thermal, fan or storage presets.

The dashboard is deliberately tuned for all eight XENEON Edge size/orientation combinations. Small layouts prioritize one or two readable values with sparklines. Medium layouts support up to four sensors. Large and Extra Large layouts expand into multi-card hardware dashboards with richer history and statistics.

RECOMMENDED SETUP — FREE STREAM DECK PLUGIN

Install HWiNFO Deck Bridge through Elgato Marketplace in Stream Deck 7.3+ on Windows. The plugin bundles the necessary local Windows bridge, so no separate executable installer is needed. XENEON Edge can unlock Virtual Stream Deck, so a separate physical Stream Deck is not required: connect XENEON Edge, choose Add Virtual Device in Stream Deck, and place Bridge Status on a virtual key. Keep Stream Deck running, open Bridge Status for the local pairing key, and paste it into the iCUE Connection settings. The plugin bundles and supervises the Windows bridge automatically.

HWiNFO must be installed separately and Shared Memory Support must be enabled. HWiNFO64 free editions may disable Shared Memory after 12 hours of continuous runtime; the dashboard reports that condition honestly and does not attempt to circumvent the limit. HWiNFO licensing remains between the customer and HWiNFO for the customer's use case.

**Redline Dashboard** is a live race dash for Forza Horizon 6 on the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE: the gear, shift lights, speed, revs and tires beside your main screen, ten times a second while you drive.

**The pages**

- **Dash**: the gear big, ten shift lights that fill green, yellow and red and flash at your shift point, speed, a rev bar with the shift point marked, boost, fuel, power, and the four tires coloured by temperature
- **Race**: position, lap, laps done, the current, last and best lap, race time, and the delta to your best lap, worked out by the widget as you drive
- **Tires**: a car drawn from above with each tire's temperature, grip and spring travel
- **G-Force**: the load as a dot inside rings at 1 g and 2 g, with a fading trail of the last 3 seconds and this session's peaks
- **Inputs**: throttle and brake over the last 10 seconds, with clutch, handbrake and steering
- **Track**: the road you drove this session, drawn from your position, with the car on it. No map: only where you have been. Tap to clear it.
- **Session**: top speed, peak G, best lap, distance driven, and your car's class, PI, drivetrain and engine

**On the Edge**

- Choose any size in iCUE, across or upright. Small sizes leave out the least needed panels instead of shrinking the type.
- Show every page with touch tabs, or one page per widget, and place several.
- With tabs, the widget turns to Race when a race starts and back when it ends; a tab you tap stays put. A setting turns this off.
- Units follow your choice in Redline Link or Redline Deck, or pick speed, tire temperature, boost and power units here. Set your shift point (85 to 98% of the rev limit) and your own text, accent and background colours.
- When you pause or sit in a menu, it says so and keeps your session's figures; when nothing is writing the file, it says what to start.

**What you need**

- **Redline Link**, a small Windows program from teatimeservers.ca (https://teatimeservers.ca/plugins/redline-deck#redline-link), or **Redline Deck** for Stream Deck, from the Elgato Marketplace. Either one receives the game's Data Out telemetry and writes it to one file on your PC; the widget reads that file. With Redline Link running, the widget can also take its live stream on your PC for the smoothest updates.
- Forza Horizon 6 with Data Out on: Settings, HUD and Gameplay, Data Out On, IP address 127.0.0.1, port 5605 (or the port you set in Redline Link or Redline Deck).
- iCUE 5.51 or later and a CORSAIR XENEON EDGE, on Windows.
- Start Redline Link or Redline Deck once before you place the widget: it makes the folder the widget reads. If you placed the widget first, remove it and add it again, or restart iCUE.

**What it does and does not do**

- It reads one folder that Redline Link or Redline Deck writes to, and Redline Link's stream on this PC. It sends nothing, stores nothing and changes nothing in the game.
- Nothing you drive leaves your PC.

Everything is drawn in code: panels, bars, lights, the car outline and the traces. No game art, logo or font is used.

Unofficial: Redline Dashboard is not affiliated with or endorsed by Playground Games, Microsoft or Xbox Game Studios. Forza Horizon is a trademark of Microsoft Corporation.

**Edge News — the world's headlines on your XENEON EDGE**

Edge News turns your XENEON EDGE into a live, touch-friendly news desk. It gathers the latest headlines from 232 publishers and 104 Google News editions across 87 countries, groups the same story from different outlets, and ranks it by how widely it is being covered — so the stories that matter most rise to the top, without one country drowning out the rest.

**WORLD COVERAGE, BALANCED**

• Local news from everywhere: major international outlets plus regional papers such as Khaleej Times, Gulf News, The National, Dawn, The Hindu, Daily Maverick, Kyiv Independent, Bangkok Post and many more.

• English local news for countries whose Google edition isn't in English — including the UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar, Egypt, Türkiye, Thailand, Vietnam, Indonesia and Bangladesh — plus every country's own-language edition.

• World balance mixes countries so no single one fills your screen, while your own regions always come first.

• Global tab: the stories leading front pages around the world, ranked by how many countries are carrying them.

**FILTER BY COUNTRY AND TOPIC**

• Pick a country next to the tabs and every tab narrows to stories about that place — combine it with any topic, such as UAE + Finance or India + Sports.

• Stories are matched by what they're actually about (place names, cities, leaders and institutions, in English and Arabic), not just where they were published.

• Topics: Headlines, Global, World, Finance, Business, Technology, Science, Health, Sports, Entertainment, Gaming, Politics and Climate.

• Finance follows markets, stocks, currencies, gold and crypto from sources such as FT Markets, Investing.com, CNBC, MarketWatch, Economic Times Markets and more.

**SEARCH THE NEWS**

• Tap search and type with the built-in on-screen keyboard.

• Matching stories from your feed appear instantly as you type, with your words highlighted.

• Search all news from the past 24 hours, week or month — worldwide, or only news about one country.

• Recent searches are kept, and any search can be followed with one tap.

**MAKE IT YOURS**

• Choose your regions and topics, switch individual sources on or off, or turn on every region or every source with one tap.

• Add any source: search an outlet by name, or paste a website and Edge News finds its news feeds — or reads it through Google News if the site has none. Paste a feed link to add it directly.

• Follow people, teams, companies or subjects to get a Following tab and lift those stories higher.

• Mute words you never want to see, and hide individual outlets.

• Save stories for later, and stories you've read are dimmed.

**BUILT FOR THE EDGE**

• Layouts adapt to the widget size: a full dashboard with a rotating featured story and a scrolling headline bar, a headline list, a card strip, or one story at a time for small widgets.

• Tap a story for its summary and full coverage from every outlet reporting it, then open the article in your PC's browser.

• Text stays readable at every widget size; adjust the interface scale, colours, corner radius, pictures, source logos, refresh interval and how long stories stay visible.

• Share your choices across several Edge News widgets, or give each one its own setup.

**WORKS BEST WITH EDGE DOCK HELPER**

Many news sites don't allow widgets to read their feeds directly. The Edge Dock Helper companion app reads every source for Edge News, finds feeds on websites you paste, and opens articles in your browser. Without it, Edge News still works using a public feed service, with fewer stories from some sources.

Privacy: Edge News has no account and no tracking. Your choices are stored on your PC. Feeds are fetched directly from publishers and Google News; source logos are loaded from Google's favicon service and can be turned off.

Edge Weather turns your XENEON EDGE into a live window on the sky. It is a touch-first weather dashboard that shows not just the forecast, but what it actually looks like outside right now, for any place in the world.

**A LIVE SKY BEHIND EVERYTHING**

The whole background is an animated sky drawn from real data. The sun and moon sit exactly where they are in the sky, rising on the left and setting on the right, and the moon shows its true phase. The sky moves through clear blue day, golden hour, sunset glow, purple twilight and a starry night. Clouds match the real cloud cover, rain falls at the current intensity and slants with the wind, snow drifts, fog rolls past, and thunderstorms darken the sky with flashes of lightning.

**ACCURATE, NOT JUST ESTIMATED**

Most weather widgets show a model's guess for "now". Edge Weather uses the nearest airport's live weather report, within 35 km, for the current temperature, feels-like, humidity, wind and pressure, and corrects the next few hours of forecast to match. A small line under the temperature always tells you where the reading came from, and if no station is close enough, it says the value is a forecast estimate. The forecast itself is a Multi-Model Blend: the average of five leading weather models (ECMWF, NOAA GFS, the UK Met Office, Environment Canada's GEM and Open-Meteo's Best Match), which evens out the bias any single model has where you live.

**INTERACTIVE FROM EDGE TO EDGE**

Drag across the hourly chart to read any hour, and the sky previews that hour, so you can scrub to tonight and watch the stars come out, or to tomorrow afternoon and see the rain arrive. Switch the chart between temperature, rain, wind, humidity, UV, air quality and pressure, over 24 hours, 48 hours or 7 days. Tap any detail tile to chart it. Tap a day in the 10-day forecast for its full summary.

**EVERYTHING AT A GLANCE**

• Current conditions with an animated icon, feels-like, and today's high and low

• Local clock for the place shown: analog and digital time, date, time zone and how far ahead or behind you it is

• Wind compass with gusts, humidity and dew point, UV index, air quality (US or European scale), rain today and when it's next expected, pressure trend and visibility

• Sunrise, sunset and hours of daylight with the sun's position along its arc

• Moon phase and illumination, moonrise and moonset with their dates, and the next full or new moon

• 10-day forecast with colour-coded temperature bars

**FIND ANY PLACE**

Search any city, region or postcode worldwide. No commas needed: "Clinton NY", "Springfield Illinois" and "Paris, France" all work, including state and country abbreviations. Save up to 12 places and swipe between them. On first run, Edge Weather finds your approximate location automatically. A built-in on-screen keyboard makes searching easy on the touchscreen.

COMPARE THE MODELS

Tap the model badge to see the blend and eight individual weather models side by side for the week ahead, with an agreement rating for each day that shows how certain the forecast really is. Pick any model to use it instead.

**MADE FOR EVERY SIZE**

From a small tile to the full 2560×720 screen, the layout adapts by showing more or fewer panels, while text stays the same readable size. Even the smallest tile keeps the essentials: conditions, the clock and the hours ahead.

**MAKE IT YOURS**

Choose your colours, interface scale and corner radius, and pick the Live Sky Scene, a subtle sky tint or a solid background. Turn the sky animation off to save GPU. Set Celsius or Fahrenheit; km/h, mph, m/s or knots; millimetres or inches; 12- or 24-hour time; the clock style; the air-quality scale; and how often to refresh.

**PRIVATE BY DESIGN**

No account, sign-up or API key is needed. Your places and settings stay on your PC. Requires iCUE 5.52 or later and an internet connection.

Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (CC BY 4.0). Live readings from Iowa Environmental Mesonet, Iowa State University.
