widgets.description:
Real-time network latency, jitter, and packet loss monitor built specifically for the Corsair Xeneon Edge display.

PingWidget runs directly on your dashboard to provide continuous visibility into your internet connection and gaming server responsiveness without cluttering your main display.

Features

- **Live Latency Sparkline**: Real-time smoothing graph visualising latency trends and stability over time.

- **Core Telemetry Metrics**: Live readout of current latency, rolling average (Avg), jitter calculation, minimum/maximum extremes, and dropped packet tallies (Loss / Err).

- **One-Click Target Presets**: Quickly toggle between Cloudflare (1.1.1.1), Google, Steam, and Discord servers using the interactive on-widget menu.

- **Custom Endpoints**: Monitor your own router, game server, or web host via the native iCUE settings panel.

- **Chevron Activity Tracker**: Visual ping-heartbeat bar that sweeps as requests execute.

- **Pause / Resume Control**: Pause background network requests at any time with a single tap.

- **Native iCUE Customisation**: Toggle telemetry rows on or off and tune your ping polling interval from 500 ms to 10 seconds.

Technical Note: HTTP Ping vs ICMP

PingWidget operates inside iCUE's sandboxed web runtime. Because browser sandboxes cannot send raw Layer 3 OS ICMP echo packets, the widget measures application-layer HTTPS round-trip timing. Readings will sit slightly higher than terminal `ping` commands due to TLS encryption handshakes and socket scheduling, providing an accurate measure of real-world application responsiveness.

Free community utility created by Hall Solutions.

**CMDR Dashboard** puts an orange cockpit display for Elite Dangerous on your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE: pips, fuel, the status lights and your route at a glance, live while you fly. No mod, no companion app: it reads the files the game itself writes for tools like this.

**The cockpit**

- Flight mode in big type (supercruise, normal space, hyperspace, docked, landed, glide), the FSD (charging, cooling down, mass locked), fire group, the panel you have open, legal state and HUD mode
- Pips as three columns of four, in half pips, the way your distributor counts them
- Fuel: the main tanks against the most seen in them, the reservoir, low fuel and fuel scooping
- Sixteen status lights: landing gear, cargo scoop, hardpoints, lights, night vision, silent running, flight assist off, shields, mass lock, overheating, danger, interdiction, FSD charge, FSD cooldown, FSD jump and supercruise
- The destination and the next jump, with jumps left and the light years to go
- Near a planet: heading on a tape, latitude, longitude and altitude
- Cargo against the size of your racks, with limpets, stolen and mission cargo

**It follows you**

- Deploy the SRV and its own lights take over: handbrake, drive assist, turret, high beam and more.
- Step out and the suit shows oxygen, health, temperature, gravity and your weapon, with medkits, energy cells and grenades from your backpack.
- Board again and the cockpit comes back.

**The pages**

- **Route**: every system ahead with its star class, the stars you cannot scoop, neutron stars and white dwarfs marked
- **Cargo**: every line in the hold
- **Modules**: power drawn in total and by priority, and every module with its slot and power
- **On Foot**: the suit, where you are, the backpack and the ship locker

**On the Edge**

- Choose any size in iCUE, across or upright. Show the whole dashboard with page tabs, or one page per widget, and place several.
- Touch: tap a tab to turn the page; tap a long list to see its next rows.
- Hide your credit balance with one switch, and use your own text, accent and background colours.
- It says what is missing instead of going blank.

**What you need**

- Elite Dangerous on Windows (Horizons or Odyssey). No mod and no Stream Deck needed.
- iCUE 5.51 or later and a CORSAIR XENEON EDGE.
- Start the game once before you place the widget, so its folder in Saved Games exists. If you placed it first, remove and re-add it or restart iCUE.
- The route shows once you plot one; cargo rack sizes show once you open the Modules tab in the right-hand panel.

**What it does and does not do**

- It reads Status.json and the small companion files the game writes. 
- It shows what the game writes to those files. Your ship's name, hull and the current system's name are not in them, so they do not appear.

CMDR Dashboard is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Frontier Developments. Elite Dangerous is a trademark of Frontier Developments plc.

**The overview**

- Connections: each Proxmox VE server or cluster, Backup Server and Datacenter Manager with a status dot, its host, nodes up, guests running, and CPU and RAM bars
- Attention: what needs you, most urgent first: a connection failing, no quorum, a node or remote down, a locked guest, storage nearly full or filling soon, a failed garbage collection or verify, a backup over a week old. "All good" when nothing does.

**The pages**

- **Nodes**: CPU, RAM and disk bars, uptime, load, cores and version for every node, with the recent tasks beside them
- **Guests**: every VM and container, running first, with CPU, RAM, uptime, tags, HA state and locks, and a summary with the busiest guests

- **Backups**: every backup group oldest first, coloured by age, the guests with no backup at all, and the Backup Server's tasks

**On the Edge**

Sentinel transforms CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a polished real-time PC performance command centre. Monitor CPU and GPU temperatures, load, clocks and power alongside memory use, fan speed, storage capacity, disk activity, network traffic, Wi-Fi signal and system uptime—all in a clear iConCity interface built for at-a-glance readability.

Create custom monitor tabs, choose 8, 12 or 16 cards per page, reorder cards by dragging, and apply individual red, blue, yellow or green card tints. Switch between line and bar graphs, hide colour controls for a cleaner display, open any supported card for a large live-history view, and select one or multiple capacity drives for the Storage Used reading. Preferences, layouts, colours and history save automatically.

Sentinel combines selectable iCUE hardware sensors with the included Windows companion for broad Intel, AMD and NVIDIA system coverage. Available readings depend on the sensors exposed by each PC; unsupported measurements are clearly shown as N/A rather than estimated.

Requires Windows 10/11, iCUE 5.47 or newer, a compatible CORSAIR XENEON EDGE display and installation of the included iConCity Sentinel Companion with administrator approval.

**Feature highlights**

\- Live CPU temperature, total load, clock speed and package power
- Live GPU temperature, core load, VRAM load, board power, clock speed and encoder activity
- System memory use and uptime
- Fan-speed monitoring from available motherboard, controller or GPU sensors
- Selectable Storage Used capacity for one drive, multiple drives or all fixed drives
- Combined physical-disk read and write throughput
- Busiest-physical-disk activity monitoring
- Live download and upload rates across active network interfaces
- Native Windows Wi-Fi signal-strength monitoring
- Overview plus dedicated CPU, GPU, Memory, Storage and Network sections
- Unlimited named custom workspaces
- 8, 12 or 16 custom monitors per page with paging controls
- Drag-to-reorder cards and custom-workspace monitors
- Per-card default, red, blue, yellow or green colour themes
- Automatic white graphs on tinted cards for clear contrast
- Optional hidden colour swatches for a cleaner dashboard
- Line-graph and bar-graph display modes
- Large More Details view with live history, low, average and peak readings
- Automatic saving for layouts, custom tabs, colours, chart style, drive selection and history
- Built-in touch keyboard for naming custom tabs directly on the display
- Large, readable typography and adaptive layouts for both spacious and dense views
- Clear LIVE, N/A and offline states—no fabricated sensor values

 **Requirements**

\- Windows 10 or Windows 11
- CORSAIR iCUE 5.47 or newer
- Compatible CORSAIR XENEON EDGE dashboard display
- iConCity Sentinel Companion installed with administrator approval

**Installation summary**

1\. Close iCUE.
2. Extract and run `INSTALL SENTINEL COMPANION.cmd` from the companion package.
3. Approve the Windows administrator prompt.
4. Install the Sentinel `.icuewidget` file.
5. Reopen iCUE and select the preferred hardware sensors in Sentinel settings.

**Support note**

Sentinel reports only measurements exposed by iCUE, Windows or supported hardware sensors. A card displays N/A when the relevant system does not expose that reading. Wi-Fi Signal requires an active Wi-Fi connection; Ethernet-only systems will show N/A. Storage Used follows the Capacity Drives selector, while Total Read, Total Write and System Activity intentionally report physical-disk performance independently of the selected capacity volumes.

Put a live Microsoft Flight Simulator landing board on your CORSAIR VANGUARD 96 keyboard LCD. This free iCUE widget from BeatMyLand.ing shows real landings from the community as they are scored, updating on its own while you fly, with no clicks and nothing to configure.

Each row shows the time, the pilot, the airport and the touchdown rate in feet per minute — so your keyboard screen becomes a live arrivals board for the whole community. Only scored landings appear, so every line is a rate you can compare.

**WHAT’S INCLUDED**

• The Live Traffic widget, ready to import into CORSAIR iCUE

• One setting: choose 3 to 6 rows to suit your display

**HOW IT WORKS**

Import the widget in iCUE, select it for your device screen, and it does the rest. It reads the public BeatMyLand.ing landing feed and refreshes every 30 seconds. The dot beside the clock shows the connection is alive — amber while data is arriving, red if the feed goes quiet.

Your keyboard keeps everything it already does — the rotary dial, FN shortcuts, function icons and RGB lighting are untouched, because the widget only draws to the LCD.

**ALLOWING THE CONNECTION**

iCUE asks once for permission to reach beatmyland.ing. It appears as a notification for just a few seconds, so it is easy to miss.

If the board stays empty, quit iCUE completely from the system tray — not just closing the window — then start it again and watch the bottom-right corner for the permission notification. Allow it, and landings appear within half a minute.

**REQUIREMENTS**

• CORSAIR iCUE 5 on Windows

• A device with an LCD screen: VANGUARD 96, VANGUARD PRO 96, XENEON EDGE, or iCUE LINK XC7/XD5 ELITE LCD

• An internet connection

No account, no sign-in, no licence key. Free.

Cave Wonder Edge puts a living planet on your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE. A ringed world turns slowly in deep space, with hundreds of rocks in orbit, shooting stars and the odd meteor shower, while the weekday, date and time sit over it in their own lettering. Everything else waits behind six buttons and rises out of the bottom edge in smoked-glass panels, so the scene stays the star until you need something.

THE PLANET

Live, not a video loop. Choose how fast it turns, from 1.5 to 10 minutes per turn, or keep it still, and how many rocks orbit it (Full, Lower or Lowest for lighter PCs). The planet keeps turning behind open panels.

MUSIC

A visualizer under the clock moves with whatever your PC is playing, with the track, artist and player controls beneath it. The Music panel adds volume, mute, microphone mute and switching between your speakers and headphones.

TASKS AND FOCUS

Add tasks with a date, length and priority; past tasks are suggested as you type. Press play to start a focus session: it counts at the top left of the screen, with breaks and break reminders. History lists finished tasks and every session with the time worked, and CONTINUE picks one back up.

CALENDAR

A month view with the days that have tasks marked. Tap a day to see what is on.

SHORTCUTS

Up to 12 programs, folders or web pages, each with its own icon. Tap to open; rearrange or remove them right on the screen.

SYSTEM

CPU and GPU load and temperature from iCUE's own sensors, plus RAM and network speed. Lock, Task Manager, Restart and Shut Down are here too; Restart and Shut Down need a press-and-hold, so a stray tap never turns your PC off.

TIMER

Name a timer, set it, and it counts down at the top right. When time is up an alarm sounds, with postpone if you need a few more minutes.

MOVIE MODE

One tap dims the whole dashboard and stops the planet for film night. Tap anywhere to bring it back.

MAKE IT YOURS

Pick the accent colour in iCUE and every panel, button and highlight follows, alongside your other widgets. In Options: 12 or 24-hour clock, show or hide the date and weekday, a mic-on reminder, Movie Mode brightness, Open iCUE and Reset all data. Swipe left or right to change iCUE pages.

SETUP (ABOUT 2 MINUTES)

1\. Add Cave Wonder Edge to your XENEON EDGE in iCUE.

2\. Install the free Cave Wonder Edge Bridge from the link below. It starts with Windows and powers the visualizer, music and sound controls, shortcuts, RAM and network readings and the PC controls. The planet, clock, tasks, focus, calendar, timer, colours and CPU/GPU readings all work without it.

3\. On iCUE 5.52 or later, allow Cave Wonder Edge to use localhost and Speaker under Widget Access when iCUE asks.

4\. For swiping between pages, set Previous and Next Display Screen in iCUE Screen Setup.

REQUIREMENTS

Windows, iCUE 5.47 or later and a CORSAIR XENEON EDGE. The bridge talks only to your own PC. No account, no telemetry, no tracking.

Setup guide, support and the free bridge: https://github.com/Caveproduction-bot/cave-wonder-edge

A cyberpunk telemetry dashboard with a functional 5x3 Stream Deck command grid, built exclusively for XENEON EDGE XL landscape.

**BIO-GRID Command Array by Opulent Hardware** combines live hardware telemetry, Stream Deck controls, personal media, and an ornate Reactive Core interface designed exclusively for the XENEON EDGE Extra Large landscape layout.

\*\*\* **10/8 URGENT FINDING. WE ARE AWARE THAT NEW A NEW iCUE VERSION PREVENTS v1.1.5 STREAM DECK INTEGRATION IN WIDGETS.**
**\*\*\* 10/9 HOTFIX FOR ABOVE IMPLEMENTED in v1.1.8. Thanks Elgato and Corsair teams.**

> **New in v1.1.8**
>
> Added support for the 1688 × 696 Large landscape slot with selectable Sensor Bias and Stream Deck Bias layouts. Enjoy an expanded telemetry dashboard or a command-focused 5 × 3 Stream Deck surface—both featuring the complete Reactive Core visual treatment. The original Extra Large layout remains fully supported.
>
> Large support also lays the groundwork for additional BIO-GRID series widgets designed for side-by-side use, including the shown BIO-GRID Volume Mixer at Medium size. This modular approach will let you combine specialized BIO-GRID displays into a unified control system.

**Getting Started**

Install BIO-GRID Command Array by dragging the widget into the iCUE installation area or selecting it through the file explorer.

1. Install and open the Elgato Stream Deck desktop app.

2. Add the widget to your XENEON EDGE using the Extra Large landscape layout at 2536 × 696.

3. On first BIO-GRID Command Array load, press **RETRY LINK** beneath the Command Array and approve the connection if prompted.

**FEATURES**

• Four customizable hardware-monitoring graphs
• Configurable labels and sensor assignments
• Central Reactive Core primary-sensor display
• Functional 5 × 3 Stream Deck command array
• FPS
• Personality Bay for your own image, animated GIF, or video
• Unified accent-color control for recoloring the complete interface

**STREAM DECK REQUIREMENT**

The Elgato Stream Deck desktop app must be installed and running to use the command array.

On the widget’s first load, press the RETRY LINK button located directly beneath the Command Array. Approve the connection if the Stream Deck app requests permission. A new BIO-GRID virtual device will then appear inside the Stream Deck app.

Assign actions to its 15 keys just as you would on a physical Stream Deck. Button icons will automatically appear on the XENEON EDGE, and the display’s touchscreen can be used to activate those actions.

**COMPATIBILITY**

• Windows
• iCUE 5.47 or newer
• Elgato Stream Deck desktop app required for command controls

BIO-GRID Command Array is purpose-built for the XENEON EDGE XL landscape canvas. Smaller and portrait layouts are intentionally unsupported.

**Troubleshooting**

If a sensor displays dashes or no data, reopen the widget settings and assign the affected sensor again. Confirm that the iCUE Sensors data provider is available.

If a graph trace is missing or flat, verify that its selected sensor is returning data. Some readings may remain flat while the associated hardware is idle.

If Stream Deck keys remain blank, confirm that the Elgato Stream Deck app is installed and running. In **iCUE Settings → Widget Access**, enable and approve app access for the widget. Return to BIO-GRID and press **RETRY LINK** beneath the Command Array, then assign actions to the BIO-GRID virtual device in Stream Deck.

GPU use. Cinematic mode is for when you want the ultimate vibe with glow and more animation but can sacrifice GPU utilization. **Off by default**

**PRIVACY**

The widget makes no network requests and does not collect or transmit personal data. Hardware telemetry, media information, FPS data, and Stream Deck communication remain within the local iCUE widget environment.

**What's Included**

The live GPS displays your active route, nearby roads, highway numbers, destinations, services, speed limits, and other available map information.

Choose from four dashboard designs inspired by the in-game Mack Pinnacle, Kenworth W900, International LT, and Volvo VNL. Instruments respond to live telemetry, including speed, RPM, fuel, temperature, air pressure, indicators, lights, warning states, and additional vehicle information where supported.

Five header metrics provide quick access to truck damage, trailer damage, cargo damage, remaining rest time, and the current delivery deadline. Rest time includes both real-time and in-game estimates. Overdue deliveries and important vehicle conditions are clearly highlighted.

Route information includes your destination, estimated arrival time, remaining journey time, and distance.

Supports all languages on the widget.

**Customization**

Personalize the widget through Respawn Companion with selectable dashboards, header designs, GPS themes, widget languages, and custom accent colors.

Choose from perspective, top-down, zoomed, and complete-route GPS views. GPS themes include dark, daylight, high-contrast, automatic time-based styles, and wood finishes with coordinated map colors.

The dashboard and GPS positions can be reversed to match your preferred layout. Measurement options allow truck telemetry and speed-limit signs to use Metric or Imperial units independently. Time can be displayed using either a 12-hour or 24-hour clock.

**Requirements & Setup**

The American Truck Simulator Widget requires our **Respawn Companion** app, a lightweight companion app included in your purchase. It will be sent to your email along with the widget itself.

An internet connection is required to download the module and check for available updates. Module updates can be installed through Respawn Companion.

Designed for XENEON EDGE and iCUE. Compatible with American Truck Simulator on Windows. Custom map support may vary as the widget was designed on the standard map, and GPS routing or road alignment may differ depending on the map’s road data and design.

Available telemetry and dashboard behavior may vary between truck models, game versions, modifications, and installed map content.

American Truck Simulator, manufacturer names, trademarks, logos, and other referenced properties belong to their respective owners. Telemetry and navigation information are provided for convenience and may occasionally differ from information displayed within the game.

*Keep everyday notes, lists and reminders within easy reach on your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE.*

Whimsy Notes gives you a colourful, touch-friendly place for shopping lists, quick reminders, project ideas, family notes and anything else you want to keep visible. Type a note, turn a photo into a checklist, add a picture or write by hand directly on the display.

**See what matters**

Choose a colour and category for each note, pin important cards to the top and use search or filters when your board starts filling up. Long notes and checklists scroll inside their cards, so you can read everything without leaving the board. Tap a card whenever you want to open the full editor.

**Turn photos into checklists**

Have a list in another app, on paper or inside a PDF? Choose a screenshot, photograph or PDF and Whimsy Notes will turn the words into an editable checklist. It recognises common checkboxes, bullets and numbered lists, and keeps wrapped sentences together. Results remain editable, so you can make any final corrections before using the list.

**Bring your notes with you**

Import notes from common text files and exports from services including Google Keep and Evernote. Compatible Notion and Google Takeout archives are also supported. You can export a backup whenever you want an extra copy of everything on your board.

**Make it yours**

Choose from three complete looks. Original is bright and fresh, Romantic uses soft pastels, and Gothic combines deep blacks with dramatic reds. Every interface and note colour can be adjusted, and you can change the background transparency to suit your setup.

**Helpful reminders**

Add a date and time to any note. When it is due, dismiss it or snooze it for five minutes. Reminders stay on your local computer and require iCUE and the widget to be running.

**Private by design**

Your notes and selected files stay on your computer. Whimsy Notes requires no account, subscription or internet connection. Photo and PDF reading happens locally and nothing is sent to Wicked Whimsy Workshop or another service.

**What is included**

- Notes and checklists designed for touch
- Pictures and handwriting with selectable ink colours
- Photo, screenshot and PDF to checklist conversion
- Categories, pins, search and filters
- Scrollable cards and a full note editor
- Local reminders with quick options and snooze
- Import from common note and text formats
- Backup and restore
- Checklist image export for sharing
- Original, Romantic and Gothic looks
- Complete colour controls and background transparency
- Protected two-tap deletion
- Local storage with no account or subscription

widgets.description:
**Palworld Dashboard** puts your Palworld game on the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE: your party, your bases and the Pal in your sights, live while you play.

**The dashboard**

- You: your level, HP, hunger, EXP and the stat points waiting to be spent
- The time of day with the day count, a day-and-night bar and the next sunrise or sunset
- The weapon in your hands
- Your party of five: each Pal's name, level, HP and hunger, with a warning when one is starving, sick or low on sanity
- Looking at: the Pal you aim at, wild or yours, with its level, gender, HP, distance, its HP, Attack and Defense talents and its passive skills
- Every base: how many Pals work there, and how many are sick, hungry or low on sanity

**The pages**

- **Party**: each slot in full, with hunger and sanity bars, talents, passive skills, condenser stars and trust
- **Bases**: every base summed, each base on a line, and the workers that need you first (sick, then hungry, then low sanity), with their base
- **You**: your character, the stat points you have put into each stat, the time of day and the weapon in hand
- **Looking At**: the Pal in your sights on its own page: talents large, every passive skill, condenser stars, soul upgrades and trust

**On the Edge**

- Choose any size in iCUE, across or upright. Show the whole dashboard with page tabs, or one page per widget, and place several.
- Touch: tap a tab to turn the page; tap a long list to see its next rows.
- Tabs carry a dot when a Pal is in your sights, or when a Pal in your party or at a base is sick or starving.
- A 12- or 24-hour clock, and your own text, accent and background colours.
- It says what is missing instead of going blank.

**What you need**

- Palworld on Windows (Steam) with UE4SS, and the **Pal Deck mod**, version 1.1.0 or later (from teatimeservers.ca/plugins/pal-deck), the client-side companion mod of Pal Deck for Stream Deck; no Stream Deck needed.
- iCUE 5.51 or later and a CORSAIR XENEON EDGE.
- Start Palworld once with the mod before you place the widget: the mod makes the folder the widget reads. If you placed it first, add it again or restart iCUE.
- UE4SS is tied to the game's version: after a Palworld update, the mod waits until UE4SS catches up.

**What it does and does not do**

- It only reads the one file the mod writes. It sends nothing, stores nothing and cannot change your game or save.
- The mod only reads the game and writes its state files; it never changes your game or save, and it does not touch dedicated servers.

Palworld Dashboard is an unofficial fan project, not affiliated with or endorsed by Pocketpair. Palworld is a trademark of Pocketpair, Inc.

widgets.description:
Zomboid Dashboard

**Your Project Zomboid survivor, live on the XENEON EDGE.** Built for Build 42.

> **Needs the Stream Deck Bridge mod** (1.4.0 or later for Inventory), a small open-source client-side mod. Get it from teatimeservers.ca or GitHub (AussieH/zomboid-deck-bridge), or let Zomboid Deck for Stream Deck install it, then switch it on in the game's Mods menu. Needs iCUE 5.51 or later.

The dashboard

- **Health**: the health number, a body map coloured by each part's wounds (bleeding parts pulse, treated parts outlined in green), the Overall Body Status and the hurt parts worst first: Bitten, Laceration, Fracture, Bandaged and the rest.
- **Moodles**: worst first, as the game's round discs with their level.
- **Time and weather**: the HUD clock, date, day survived, weather and temperature.
- **Utilities countdown**: in single player, the time left before the power and water go off. On a server it shows only on or off.
- **Hands**: your weapon's condition, edge or rounds, your off hand, and the weight you carry.

In a car

The dashboard becomes the car's own: a big speedometer with its red needle and digital speed, the fuel gauge from E to F, the engine's condition, the engine, headlight and battery lights, and the gear. On larger sizes the Mechanics window sits beside it. Get out and it turns back by itself.

The pages

- **Health**: every hurt part with all its lines.
- **Moodles**: every moodle, with food, water, rest and endurance.
- **Mechanics**: the car outline coloured by part, the Overall Condition, and every part by category, worst first.
- **Character**: profession, traits, body weight, favourite weapon, kills and time survived.
- **Skills**: every skill in its boost colour, the ten squares, the skill book's arrows, and a skill lit up as it gains XP.
- **Protection**: bite and scratch defence for each body part.
- **Temperature**: the core temperature and body heat bars, and the body views.
- **Inventory**: your main inventory and every bag, each with its weight and capacity; every stack with its count, category, weight and condition, sorted like the game's inventory window.

Sizes and touch

- **Choose the size in iCUE**: Small to Extra Large, across or upright. Smaller sizes drop what has no room instead of shrinking the text.
- **Show** sets a widget to the whole dashboard or one page, so a big dashboard can sit beside smaller page widgets.
- **Touch**: tap the page tabs, and tap a long list for its next rows.
- **Follows the game**: get hurt and it turns to Health; damage the car and it turns to Mechanics; then it turns back once it's quiet.

Settings

The page shown, tabs, car dashboard and following, the dashboard's panels, units and clock, and colours.

- It reads two files the mod writes in your Zomboid folder
- It shows only what the game shows you: never a hidden infection.
- No cheats: the widget only reads, and the mod changes no stats.

Unofficial: Zomboid Dashboard is made by TeaTime and is not affiliated with or endorsed by The Indie Stone. Project Zomboid is a trademark of The Indie Stone. No game art is used.

widgets.description:
Silent Mode Coach tells you how hard your fans are working and why. It ranks every fan iCUE can read by how close it is to its top speed, gives an overall level (Quiet, Moderate or Loud), and explains the cause in plain words: your graphics card is busy, your processor is busy, things are warm, or your fans are loud while your PC is barely working.

That last one is the useful one. Loud at idle usually means a fan curve that's too aggressive. The coach also counts how often your fans spin up in an hour, because constant ramping usually means the curve needs a longer delay.

Features

- Every fan ranked by how hard it's working
- One overall level: Quiet, Moderate or Loud
- A plain-words reason for the noise
- Flags fans that are loud while your PC is idle
- Spots fans stuck at one speed whatever your PC is doing
- Spin-ups counted over the last hour, with a chart
- Pumps listed separately and left out of the score; tap a fan twice to mark it as a pump

Requires Windows, iCUE 5.47 or later and a CORSAIR XENEON EDGE, with fans or a cooler that report their speed to iCUE. It learns each fan's top speed over time, so the first readings are estimates. An AIO pump plugged into a motherboard fan header reports like a fan; if one runs at one steady speed, the coach says so and asks, and a pump you mark is remembered.

widgets.description:
**Taskbar — Your Windows At A Tap on the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE**

Every open window on your XENEON EDGE, with your pinned apps beside them. Switch, minimize, snap and move windows from the touchscreen next to your keyboard.

No alt-tabbing, no hunting through the taskbar, no Stream Deck required.

**Key Features:**

**Every Window, One Tap Away**

- **Window Cards:** The app's icon and name, the window's title and the monitor it's on.
- **Tap To Switch:** Tap a window to switch to it. Tap the one in front to minimize it.
- **Hold For More:** Minimize, Maximize or Restore, Snap left, Snap right, Move to another monitor, New window, Pin, Hide app and Close.
- **Attention:** Windows that ask for attention are marked, the way the Windows taskbar flashes them.

**Pinned Apps**

- **Pins Beside Your Windows:** Tap one to switch to it, or to open it when it isn't running.
- **Grouping:** Apps with several windows can be grouped, with a list of their windows one tap away.
- **Real Names And Icons:** Store apps, File Explorer and browser profiles show with their real names and icons.

**One Widget, Several Jobs**

- **Widget Types:** Add Taskbar more than once and give each copy a job in iCUE's widget settings: Everything (with a filter by monitor), One monitor (place one copy per monitor), Pinned apps, or Window in front (large buttons for the window you're using).
- **Shared Pins:** Pins and hidden apps are shared by every copy. Each copy keeps its own type, monitor, grouping, text size and colours in iCUE's widget settings.
- **Every Size:** Designed for every XENEON EDGE tile, wide or vertical. Small tiles become an icon dock like the Windows taskbar.

**Requires Qaem Hub (Free Companion App)**

- **Qaem Hub:** Taskbar needs Qaem Hub, QaemDev's free companion app for Windows: qaemdev.com/products/qaem-hub. An iCUE widget can't see or move windows on its own, so Qaem Hub's Taskbar module does, only while the widget is showing them. Nothing leaves your PC.
- **Just This Module:** Rather not install Qaem Hub? Get the Taskbar Module, a small app with only this module inside: qaemdev.com/downloads/taskbar-module-setup.exe. Qaem Hub takes it over, settings kept, if you install it later.
- **Looks After Itself:** Qaem Hub runs quietly in the tray, starts with Windows and keeps itself up to date. If it isn't running, the widget says so and starts it with one tap.

**Requirements**

- CORSAIR iCUE 5.45 or newer with a XENEON EDGE.
- Windows 10 or 11.

**Notes**

- Windows lets Qaem Hub close or move a window that runs as administrator only when Qaem Hub runs as administrator too.
- On iCUE 5.51 and newer, allow 127.0.0.1 in iCUE Settings, Widget Access, if iCUE asks.

**SETUP TAKES TWO MINUTES**

Install Qaem Hub, add its Taskbar module, and import the widget in iCUE. Your windows are there.

SETUP GUIDE: https://qaemdev.com/guides/qaem-hub-setup

Every game installed on your PC, from every launcher, with its cover art, on your XENEON EDGE. Tap a game to play it.

Steam, Epic Games, GOG, Battle.net, the EA app, Ubisoft Connect, Xbox and Riot Games in one library, without opening a single launcher. No Stream Deck required.

**Key Features:**

**One Library For Every Launcher**

- **Every Installed Game:** With its cover, backdrop and logo.
- **Your Launchers, Your Way:** Filter by launcher, or give a copy one launcher only.
- **Sort:** By recently played, name, most played or recently added.
- **Organize:** Star favorites, make your own categories and hide what you don't play.
- **Playtime:** When you last played each game and for how long. Where a launcher doesn't keep playtime on your PC, Qaem Hub times your sessions itself.
- **Steam Extras:** Achievements and update progress.

**One Tap To Play**

- **Play:** Tap a game to start it through its own launcher.
- **Now Playing:** The game you're playing shows its session time and can be closed from the widget. Closing asks twice.

**One Widget, Several Jobs**

- **Widget Types:** Add GameShelf more than once and give each copy a job in iCUE's widget settings: Everything, Recently played, Favorites or one of your categories, Now playing, or Continue with the last game you played.
- **Layouts:** The whole library as a spotlight on your latest game, a showcase, a shelf of covers or a list.
- **Shared Library:** Copies share favorites, categories and hidden games. Each copy has its own launcher, layout, colours and text size, in iCUE's widget settings or in the widget.

**Requires Qaem Hub (Free Companion App)**

- **Qaem Hub:** GameShelf needs Qaem Hub, QaemDev's free companion app for Windows: qaemdev.com/products/qaem-hub. Its Games module reads each launcher's own files and starts games through the launcher they belong to. It never changes the launchers' files.
- **Just This Module:** Rather not install Qaem Hub? Get the Games Module, a small app with only this module inside: qaemdev.com/downloads/games-module-setup.exe. Qaem Hub takes it over, settings kept, if you install it later.
- **Looks After Itself:** Qaem Hub runs quietly in the tray, starts with Windows and keeps itself up to date.

**Requirements**

- CORSAIR iCUE 5.45 or newer with a XENEON EDGE, on Windows.
- **At least one of:** Steam, Epic Games Launcher, GOG (with or without GOG Galaxy), Battle.net, the EA app, Ubisoft Connect, the Xbox app, the Riot Client.

**Notes**

- Cover art comes from each launcher and from public game databases, fetched to your PC for your own games.
- Battle.net starts a game in one tap once its app is signed in. If it's closed, Qaem Hub opens it first.
- Games whose anti-cheat forbids it (VALORANT, League of Legends) close from inside the game only.
- On iCUE 5.51 and newer, allow the widget to reach 127.0.0.1 in iCUE Settings, Widget Access, if iCUE asks.

GameShelf is not affiliated with or endorsed by Valve, Epic Games, GOG, Blizzard, Electronic Arts, Ubisoft, Microsoft or Riot Games.

**SETUP TAKES TWO MINUTES**

Install Qaem Hub, add its Games module, and import the widget in iCUE. Your games are there.

SETUP GUIDE: https://qaemdev.com/guides/qaem-hub-setup

- Finds dips against your own recent frame rate, not a fixed number
- Names the likely cause of each dip and gives one plain suggestion
- A frame-rate graph of the session with every dip marked
- Keeps your last 20 sessions on your PC
- Three sensitivity levels in settings
- Ignores desktop apps, browsers and launchers

**Labify — Streamlabs Desktop Control for the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE**

Run your stream from the touchscreen next to your keyboard. Labify puts Streamlabs Desktop on your XENEON EDGE: your scenes at a tap, the audio mixer, buttons for going live, recording and the replay buffer, your stream's health at a glance, and a live preview of your stream.

No alt-tabbing, no covering your game, no Stream Deck required. Labify talks to Streamlabs Desktop through its own remote-control API.

**Key Features:**

**Live Preview**

- **Your Stream's Picture:** Edge to edge, from a Streamlabs projector window, at the frame rate you pick. It pauses when nobody is looking. Needs Qaem Hub.

**Scenes At A Tap**

- **Big Scene Buttons:** Every scene as a button. In studio mode, tap once to line a scene up and again to take it live.

**Buttons For Everything**

- **Go Live And Record:** Start and stop streaming or recording, the replay buffer and saving a replay.
- **And The Rest:** Scenes, studio mode and transitions, mute, volume, and showing or hiding a source. Add, remove, reorder and recolour them.
- **Safe By Design:** Going live, ending a stream and starting or stopping a recording need a hold or a second tap, so a stray touch never ends your stream.

**The Mixer**

- **Mixer:** The sources Streamlabs' own mixer shows, with mute buttons and volume faders on Streamlabs' own curve.

**Stream Health**

- **Status:** Live and recording timers, bitrate with its last minute, dropped frames, CPU and frame rate, turning amber and red as problems grow.

**One Widget, Several Jobs**

- **Widget Types:** Add Labify more than once and give each copy a job in iCUE's widget settings: Everything, Preview, Scenes, Buttons, Mixer or Status.
- **Shared Connection:** Copies share one connection. Each copy keeps its own settings, colours and text size, in iCUE's settings or on the touchscreen.
- **Clear States:** Streamlabs closed or not installed, third party connections off, a wrong token or Qaem Hub not running: each one shows the fix.

**Qaem Hub (Free Companion App, Recommended)**

- **No Setup:** With Qaem Hub, QaemDev's free companion app for Windows (qaemdev.com/products/qaem-hub), Labify connects to Streamlabs with no token to copy and nothing to turn on in Streamlabs. Qaem Hub can also open Streamlabs for you, and it adds the live preview.
- **Without It:** Turn on third party connections in Streamlabs and paste its API token once.
- **Just This Module:** Rather not install Qaem Hub? Get the Streamlabs Desktop Module, a small app with only this module inside: qaemdev.com/downloads/streamlabs-module-setup.exe. Qaem Hub takes it over, settings kept, if you install it later.
- **Looks After Itself:** Qaem Hub runs quietly in the tray, starts with Windows and keeps itself up to date.

**Requirements**

- Streamlabs Desktop on Windows.
- CORSAIR iCUE 5.49 or newer with a XENEON EDGE. On iCUE 5.51 and newer, Labify may reach Qaem Hub and Streamlabs on this PC; for Streamlabs on another PC or a changed port, allow it in iCUE Settings, Widget Access.

**Privacy**

- Labify talks only to Qaem Hub and Streamlabs on your own PC, or to the address you enter. Nothing is sent anywhere else, and it never reads your stream key.

Streamlabs and Streamlabs Desktop are trademarks of their owner. Labify is an independent product, not affiliated with or endorsed by Streamlabs.

**SOME STEPS ARE REQUIRED FOR THE SETUP**

SETUP GUIDE: https://qaemdev.com/guides/qaem-hub-setup

widgets.description:
Cave Redline Edge turns your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a red-lit sci-fi command deck: your current focus, your tasks, what is playing, your PC and audio controls and live system performance, on one 2560x720 touch screen in a rendered HUD shell.

CURRENT FOCUS

Press play on any task and it becomes your focus: a big timer, a segmented bar towards its goal, elapsed, remaining and goal time. Pause, take a Break Time, and End Task (or tick the task off) to save it. Press play on it again later and it picks up where it left off. Tap Goal to change the goal and break length, or Sessions for every session, with CONTINUE to pick one back up. A silent window offers a ten-minute break every hour, and says when it is over.

TASK OPERATIONS

Up Next lists your tasks with due date, duration and priority. Add Task suggests past tasks as you type. The calendar shows which days have work and filters the list to one day. Tap Completed to hide finished tasks from Up Next without losing them. Deleting asks first, takes the task's sessions with it, and offers Undo. Task stats show open and completed tasks, sessions and time worked, and open Work sessions at a tap.

MEDIA

Artwork, title, artist and app, a progress bar you can drag, transport and volume. With two apps playing, switch which one the controls follow.

PC & AUDIO CONTROLS

Mute, mic mute, Switch Sound, Sound Source, Movie Mode, Lock, and Shut Down and Restart. Shut Down and Restart only work with a deliberate press and hold while a bar fills, so a stray tap can never turn your PC off, and Windows can still cancel.

SYSTEM PERFORMANCE

Live CPU, GPU, RAM and network graphs along the bottom. CPU and GPU work as soon as the widget is added, from iCUE's own sensors, multi-GPU included. Each reading has a source setting in iCUE, starting on Automatic. A status line reads Everything looks good, warns when CPU, GPU or RAM runs high, and says which reading to set up if one is missing.

TOP BAR

Your current sound output (tap to change it), Show desktop, a button that switches your XENEON EDGE display mode, Windows Task Manager, Options, and swiping left or right to change iCUE pages with the shortcuts you set in iCUE Screen Setup. The bell above the clock opens and closes Windows notifications, with a count.

MAKE IT YOURS

Colours are set in iCUE, alongside every other widget. Pick any accent colour and the whole shell follows, its neon, buttons, progress bar and graphs. Two text colours: one for headings and readings, one for labels, captions and due dates. Set your own background too; every change shows straight away. A background colour paints the whole dashboard in that colour, deep or pale, and the accent keeps the colour you picked. Background transparency fades the background and panels, never the text. Every choice is checked for readability before it is applied. In Options: clock format, Movie Mode brightness, break length and reminders, Open iCUE, and Reset all data.

SETUP (ABOUT 2 MINUTES)

Step 1: Add Cave Redline Edge to your XENEON EDGE in iCUE, at the largest size.

Step 2: Install the free Cave Redline Edge Bridge from the link below. It starts with Windows and powers audio, media details, RAM and network readings, notifications, the screen controls and Lock, Shut Down and Restart. Tasks, the focus timer, the clock, colours and the CPU and GPU readings all work without it.

Step 3: For page swiping and the display-mode button, set Switch Display Mode, Previous Display Screen and Next Display Screen in iCUE Screen Setup.

REQUIREMENTS

Windows, iCUE 5.47 or later and a CORSAIR XENEON EDGE. The bridge talks only to your own PC (127.0.0.1). No account, no telemetry, no tracking.

GOOD TO KNOW

Browsers report all their tabs to Windows as one media source, so two tabs in the same browser count once.

Setup guide, support and the free bridge: https://github.com/Caveproduction-bot/cave-redline-edge

widgets.description:
LONG DESCRIPTION

PE Advanced // Orbital Command turns compatible CORSAIR iCUE LCD hardware into a futuristic orbital systems console built around real PC telemetry.

A cinematic planet-and-station command display anchors the interface while live CPU and GPU telemetry, memory temperatures, cooling data, optional system RAM load, optional power/voltage data, session peaks, local time, and widget uptime remain visible at a glance.

Orbital Command automatically reorganizes its interface for portrait, tall-portrait, landscape, and ultrawide LCD aspect ratios instead of simply stretching one fixed canvas. The design is optimized for clear system awareness while preserving the full PE Advanced sci-fi visual identity.

CPU and GPU temperatures drive the core Ship Condition state. Optional telemetry may remain unassigned and displays N/A without creating false faults. Every sensor selector includes an adjacent Use switch so an accidental or no-longer-needed assignment can be cleared at any time. System RAM Load is explicitly user-selectable so GPU/VRAM memory-load sources are not mislabeled as system memory.

FEATURE HIGHLIGHTS

\- Responsive portrait, tall-portrait, landscape, and ultrawide layouts

\- Live CPU and GPU temperature/load telemetry

\- Optional System RAM Load

\- Every sensor assignment can be disabled/unassigned after selection

\- Dual optional DIMM temperatures with hottest-DIMM tracking

\- Optional CPU fan, GPU fan, and AIO pump RPM

\- Optional CPU/GPU power and voltage telemetry

\- Configurable CPU/GPU/memory thermal thresholds

\- Temperature-aware zero-RPM cooling behavior

\- Aggregate Ship Condition and data-link state

\- Session peaks, local time, and widget-session uptime

\- No external monitoring service or network connection required for core telemetry

COMPATIBILITY COPY

Requires CORSAIR iCUE 5.47 or later and compatible iCUE LCD hardware. Sensor availability varies by PC hardware and iCUE exposure. Optional unassigned sensors display N/A. The responsive interface includes dashboard-LCD support for XENEON EDGE-class ultrawide dimensions; the initial v1.0.0 real-hardware validation baseline was performed on a 5-inch portrait LCD.

**Feedback is welcome.** If you encounter a compatibility issue, have feedback about your hardware configuration, or have an idea for a future update or feature, use the support link on this Marketplace page to contact PilotErsatz Technologies. Real-world feedback helps guide future improvements and compatibility updates to Assault Systems.

Launch your apps with a tap using **App Launcher**, an interactive XENEON EDGE widget that brings your applications, games, and websites together. Build your canvas with favorites, custom categories, and shortcuts that launch multiple apps at once.

This is an actively maintained project, with more updates planned. Suggestions are always welcome.

**What’s Included**

Keep your everyday apps within reach.

- **Application Library:** Discover supported installed applications and organize them into categories.
- **Favorites:** Keep your most-used apps together for quick access.
- **Website Shortcuts:** Add URLs with custom images or website icons.
- **Multi-launch:** Open multiple apps from one tile and restore their saved window positions.
- **Gestures:** Choose what happens when you double tap, or press & hold for example.
- **Custom Categories:** Create, rename, reorder, and remove categories.

Add apps manually with a name and file path. Use the application’s icon or choose your own image.

**Touch Controls and Layouts**

Launch apps from your touchscreen and choose what happens when you tap an app that is already running.

Supports vertical orientation for XENEON EDGE.

Configure double-tap and press-and-hold gestures to bring apps forward, minimize or close them, or open their menus.

Adjust tile sizes, hide titles, and show or hide category labels. Assign multiple apps through the category manager or organize individual tiles from their menus.

**Customization**

Choose normal, light, or dark mode through iCUE, then override the appearance with your own settings.

Multiple supported languages.

Customize background, tile, and font colors with the built-in color wheel or hex values. Adjust transparency, liquid glass, corner shapes, and tile depth.

Rename apps, change their images, and show or hide the header. Expand the search button to find an app.

Your appearance, favorites, and categories are saved between restarts and updates.

**Multi-launch and Window Positions**

Choose the apps you use together, arrange their windows, and save their positions. Launch the shortcut to open those apps and restore the saved layout.

**Data and Connectivity**

Requires the **App Launcher module** in our **Respawn Companion** app, available through **Related Downloads** on this product page.

The module connects locally to your applications and windows. No Steam account connection is required. Update notices appear in the widget as a notification.

**Compatibility**

Designed for XENEON EDGE and iCUE on Windows.

App discovery, running indicators, and window controls depend on each application. Some apps may restrict closing, bringing windows forward, or restoring positions. Website shortcuts use your default browser.

widgets.description:
Five visual breathing styles and a calm, animation-led display, to guide you through breathing exercises.

Research suggests paced breathing can influence the body’s stress response so take a moment to meditate in your breath. Breathing Room widget turns your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a quiet place to pause. A soft field expands and contracts with each breath, while a simple count and cue guide you through the rhythm. Tap to begin a session; tap again to reveal the controls.

Choose from five visual breathing styles: Gentle, Physiological Sigh, Box Breathing, 4-7-8 Breathing, and Coherent Breathing. Set a session from 1 to 5 minutes, pause or reset when you need to, and add an optional reminder within the widget. The calm display keeps the animation in focus and lets the controls recede while you breathe.

Choose your breathing style, session length, and reminder on the XENEON EDGE or set them in iCUE. - Touch controls for starting, pausing, resuming, and resetting

- Adjustable 1–5 minute sessions

- Optional 30, 60, or 90 minute reminders within the widget

- Breathing controls on the touchscreen and in iCUE

- Silent operation with no account or internet connection required

COMPATIBILITY

Designed exclusively for CORSAIR XENEON EDGE. Supports horizontal and vertical layouts on Windows with iCUE 5.47 or newer.

Breathing Room runs entirely locally and makes no network requests. Its reminders appear within the widget while iCUE is running; they are not system notifications.

widgets.description:
Get National Weather Service weather data directly on your Corsair Xeneon Edge. This widget scales from a quick glance at the current conditions to a more in depth forecast view, giving you everything from immediate/forecast conditions to historical climate trends. By inserting your latitude and longitude coordinates, the widget automatically gathers the nearest station to gather data from.

**<u>Core Weather Data</u>**

- **Current Conditions:** This includes current and "feels like" temperatures, dew point, barometric pressure, visibility, and today's forecasted high and low temperature. It also tracks wind and gust speeds, sunrise/sunset times, and displays a current weather icon with a brief text description.

- **Current Alerts:** Shows alerts issued by the National Weather Service, using a yellow triangle for non-warnings, and a red triangle for warnings.

- **8-Hour Forecast:** Each block shows the projected temperature, dew point, wind speed and direction, rain chances, and an hourly weather icon.

- **5-Day Forecast:** Each block shows the date, day of the week, expected high and low temperatures, precipitation chances, and a primary weather icon for each day.

**<u>Dynamic Weather</u>**

- Weather effects show on the widget, changing as the current weather changes.
- Weather effects include sunny, night, cloudy, rain, storm, snow, wintry mix, and fog.
- Able to toggle dynamic weather on or off.
- Able to toggle the sun and moon effect.

**<u>Extra-Large Panel Options</u>**

If you want to have the widget maximized, changing the widget to the "Extra Large" size unlocks a customizable side panel. You can toggle between many different specialized views:

- **Time & History View:** Displays a digital clock and date. It also pulls today's 30-year historical average high and low so you can see if the current weather is actually normal. Below that, a 14-day chart graphs out the hourly, minimum, and maximum temperatures over the last two weeks to show recent trends.

- **Live Radar & Outlook View:** This view pulls a live, localized National Weather Service radar loop onto the screen. It also displays Climate Prediction Center (CPC) outlook maps.

- **Sidebar Options:** Last 14 Day Temperatures, Radar, 6-10 Day Temperature Outlook, 8-14 Day Temperature Outlook, Week 3-4 Temperature Outlook, Monthly Temperature Outlook, Seasonal Temperature Outlook, Days 8-14 U.S. Hazards Outlook, Risk of Hazardous Temperatures, Risk of Heavy Precipitation, Risk of Heavy Snow, 6-10 Day Precipitation Outlook, 8-14 Day Precipitation Outlook, Week 3-4 Precipitation Outlook, Monthly Precipitation Outlook, Seasonal Precipitation Outlook, U.S. Monthly Drought Outlook, and U.S. Seasonal Drought Outlook.

**<u>Appearance & Customization</u>**

- **Color Controls:** Personalize the widget by changing the primary text color and the accent color. The accent color automatically applies to the weather icons, the daily temperature bar, and section separator.

- **Chart Adjustments:** On the 14-day temperature graph, you can independently set the colors for the maximum, minimum, and hourly trend lines. To maintain a cohesive layout, the graph's X and Y borders are bound to your custom accent color, and the X and Y coordinate values are bound to your text color.

**<u>Disclaimers</u>**

- **<u>This widget can only be used for locations within the United States.</u>**
- Some weather data from the National Weather Service may not come back at times. This may make the widget display "..." if data is first loaded (ex: Re-loading the widget). Data will show the next time it is sent to the widget (usually a couple minutes if there is no outage).
- Weather data is sourced from the National Weather Service and is provided 'as is' without warranties of any kind.

**Please feel free to contact me if you find a bug with the widget.**

widgets.description:
Calendar Countdown puts your next appointment and your calendar on the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE. Subscribe to up to five iCalendar feeds, give each calendar a name and color, and keep your settings in iCUE.

FOUR VIEWS

• Small: Next event name and countdown.
• Medium: Today’s calendar with a current-time indicator and compact countdown.
• Large: Monday–Friday calendar with a countdown bar.
• XL: Full Monday–Sunday calendar with a countdown bar.

The countdown changes color as your event approaches: green above 10 minutes, yellow from 5–10 minutes, orange from 1–5 minutes, and solid red during the final minute. At the start, it flashes red until tapped to dismiss. A steady-red option is available.

Seconds appear only during the final 10 minutes. All-day events appear in calendar views without triggering countdown alerts. Adjust background transparency without fading the text and controls.

INSTALLATION

1. Install Calendar Countdown in iCUE and add it to your XENEON EDGE. Requires iCUE 5.47 or newer.

2. Grant the widget’s requested network permissions.

3. Open the widget’s Calendar settings card. Paste an HTTPS or webcal iCalendar subscription URL into a calendar slot, choose its name and color, and enable it. Repeat for up to five calendars.

4. Leave View set to “auto” for a layout that matches the widget size, or enter small, medium, large, or xl.

5. Tap Calendars to check sync status. Use “Refresh & check access” to retry a connection.

Use a calendar subscription/export link (not the provider’s normal calendar webpage or an embedded calendar link). Feeds refresh approximately every minute while the widget is running; provider publication delays may affect how quickly changes appear.

OPTIONAL WINDOWS HELPER

Some calendar providers block direct access from widgets through browser security restrictions (CORS). The optional helper makes those calendar requests locally on your PC. You still enter and manage your calendars in iCUE.

Download:
https://infosecchicago.com/files/icue/CalendarCountdown.Helper.exe

1. Save the helper in a permanent folder and run it. It is a standalone Windows x64 application.

2. Click “Copy connection key.”

3. In iCUE’s Calendar Countdown settings card, paste it into “Helper connection key.”

4. Enable “Use helper if direct access fails,” then refresh the widget’s calendars.

Keep the helper running when needed. Closing its window hides it to the system tray; Exit stops it. “Start with Windows (minimized to tray)” is enabled by default and can be switched off in the helper. When upgrading, exit the previous helper before replacing it.

BACKUP AND RESTORE

To save your configuration automatically, click “Choose backup file…” in the helper and select a JSON file. Enter the helper connection key in iCUE and enable “Automatic backups.” Settings changes are then saved automatically. Backups require the helper even when your calendars work through direct access.

To restore, choose “Restore backup…” in the helper, select a saved configuration, and save the generated widget file. Import that file into iCUE and add a fresh Calendar Countdown tile.

Keep subscription links, backup files, restored widgets, and the helper connection key private. Backups contain readable subscription URLs. Calendar access is read-only, and provider compatibility depends on access to a valid iCalendar subscription feed.

**🎚️ Every app on your PC gets its own fader, right there under your finger.**

✅ A touch fader for every app, right on your Xeneon Edge
✅ Perfect for live meetings, as well as gaming
✅ Mute Discord in clutch moments
✅ Adjust volume on your mic, music or browsers when the the Zoom or Teams meeting starts
✅ Live meters for apps show up and disappear on their own

\--

**🎙️ Stream, game, or work from home**

*Streaming:* ride your mic, your game, and your alert sounds on separate faders, and mute a noisy browser the second it starts without touching the rest of your mix.

*Working from home:* keep Slack and Teams up, pull the music down the moment a meeting starts, and one tap mutes your mic when the dog goes off. Your call is never the thing that's too quiet.

*Gaming:* game on one fader, Discord on the other, sorted in a second between rounds.

No alt-tab. No digging through the Windows volume mixer. No mouse. You reach over and slide it.

\--

**🔀 It keeps up with you**

Open an app and its fader appears on its own. Close it and it slides away. Nothing to set up, no list to maintain, it just follows whatever your PC is playing. Want a tidy panel? Turn on "Only apps that are playing" and the quiet ones tuck out of sight until they pipe up again.

\--

**🎛️ Every app gets a slider**

- One fader per app that's making sound: Spotify, Discord, Chrome, your game, all of it

Graphite, Light, Neon, Blush, Aurora, Brut, Terminal, Booth. Same faders, different feel. Lay them out in rows or columns, show or hide the names and numbers, and tint each fader its app's own color. It should look like your desk, not mine.

\--

**⚙️ Under the hood, for the curious**

- These are your real Windows volumes, the same sliders buried in the taskbar, so whatever you change here sticks after you close the widget

- One small companion app does the heavy lifting. Windows only lets a normal program reach per-app volume from the PC itself, so it is a one-time, one-minute install, and it starts with Windows from then on

**🖥️ What you need**

- A Corsair Xeneon Edge
- iCUE, on Windows

\--

I built this because I was tired of alt-tabbing out of a game to adjust my Spotify volume. Now it lives on the screen right next to me. Less thinking, more listening.

**📸 Cull and Edit in Adobe Lightroom Classic on the Xeneon Edge**

Flag, rate, then edit your photos with touch controls. Lightroom Classic Control widget puts that whole pass at your finger-tips on the Xeneon Edge ⚡

\--

✅ Culling, ratings, develop sliders, zoom and presets all reachable at once on a full-size slot.

✅ Two-way sync. Drag Exposure on the Edge and Lightroom moves. Move it in Lightroom and the widget follows.

✅ Undo and Redo on the panel, driven by Lightroom's own undo stack.

A full session, hands on the glass.

**<u>SETUP NOTE:</u>** This widget requires installation of a small companion app (setup guide has the details).

\--

**⚡ Why You'll Love It**

A cull is a thousand small decisions, each one costing a reach for the keyboard. So Pick and Reject are the biggest targets on the panel, stars carry their numeral, color labels sit beside them, and auto-advance moves you on the moment you flag a frame.

Toggle to Develop and the same panel becomes thirteen Basic sliders at a size your finger can land on.

\--

**🔄 It Follows the Module You're In**

Switch Lightroom to Library and the widget rearranges into the cull surface. Switch to Develop and the sliders come back. The module tabs work in reverse too, so you can move Lightroom itself from the Edge.

\--

**🎚️ Develop Sliders Built for Fingers**

Intuitively edit your slider values with your finger. Double-tap resets.

\--

**📦 What's Inside**

- Full Basic panel in Lightroom's own order, plus Tone Curve, HSL, Detail and Effects
- Cull surface with Pick, Reject, 1 to 5 stars, color labels, rotate and auto-advance
- Filename, resolution, file type, ISO, aperture, shutter and focal length up top
- Your real preset catalog, browsed by folder, favorites pinned to the top
- All eight Edge slot sizes, horizontal or vertical, with a six-slider pick for the small slot
- Idle dim with your own delay and depth

\--

**🔌 NOTE: The Companion Plug-in**

Lightroom Classic has no way to talk to iCUE on its own. A small FlowKits plug-in on the Lightroom side opens that connection. You add it once through Lightroom's Plug-in Manager and never think about it again.

Download it here: getflowkits.com/setup/lightroom-icue-companion/

\--

**🚀 Quick Install**

1. Install the widget in iCUE and place it on your Edge dashboard.

2. Download the companion plug-in: getflowkits.com/setup/lightroom-icue-companion/ and unzip it.

3. In Lightroom Classic go to File, then Plug-in Manager, click Add and pick the Xeneon-LrC-Companion.lrdevplugin folder.

4. That's it. The widget connects a couple of seconds later, no Lightroom restart needed.

\--

**⚙️ What You Need**

- Corsair Xeneon Edge with iCUE 5.47 or newer
- Windows 10 or 11, since iCUE widgets are Windows only
- Adobe Lightroom Classic (Version 15 or later)

\--

**🎯 Perfect For**

Hobbyists and professionals alike. A weekend of scenery shots, a wedding cull running into the thousands, an afternoon spent inside the slider panels. If you own a Xeneon Edge and want something tactile to edit with, this is it.

🎚️ Less Thinking, More Creating.

\--

***Disclaimer***

*This widget is an independent creation by FlowKits, not affiliated with, sponsored by, or endorsed by Adobe Inc. or Corsair. Adobe and Lightroom Classic are trademarks of Adobe Inc., used solely to identify compatibility. Photography by Saorsa Studio (saorsastudio.co.uk), with permission.*

widgets.description:
Cave Aurora Edge turns your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a calm control panel for the way you actually work: what you are doing, what you need to open, how your PC is doing and what is playing — on one 2560x720 touch screen you arrange yourself.

YOUR OWN SHORTCUTS

Up to eight shortcuts to any program, folder or website on your PC, four on screen at a time with arrows for the rest. Tap FIND A PROGRAM and pick it in a normal Windows file box, or paste a path or web address. Each tile shows the program's own icon and launches it with one tap. Tap REARRANGE and then two tiles to change their order.

PC CONTROLS

Lock in one tap, and Shut down or Restart by pressing and holding until the ring fills, so a stray touch cannot end your session. Task Manager is one tap too.

FOCUS AND TASKS

Add tasks with a due date, duration and priority. Start typing and past tasks are suggested. Press play to start its timer: the duration becomes your goal, and it flashes when time is up, then keeps counting. Pause, take timed breaks, and every session is saved with the time worked. A calendar shows which days have work, deleting asks first and offers Undo, and totals show tasks and hours worked.

A COUNTDOWN TIMER

Set a name and length under the clock. It sounds when it is up, with snooze and a box for any number of minutes. It is stored by its finishing time, so it survives restarts, sleep and iCUE reloads.

MEDIA AND SOUND

Title, artist and app, a progress bar you can drag, previous, play/pause, next, and a volume slider sized for a finger. If two apps are playing, switch which one the controls follow. Mute, mic mute, Switch Sound and a picker for any output on your PC.

SYSTEM

Live CPU, GPU, RAM and network speeds along the bottom with small history graphs. CPU and GPU work as soon as the widget is added, from iCUE's own sensors, on Intel or AMD processors and any graphics card. Every reading also has a source setting in iCUE if you would rather pick the sensor yourself. A reading with no source says so and points at the setting that fixes it.

ARRANGE IT YOURSELF

Tap LAYOUT and drag one panel onto another to swap them. Every panel keeps its own size wherever you put it, so the dashboard never ends up squeezed.

MAKE IT YOURS

Five backgrounds — Midnight Aurora, Ember Aurora, Total Eclipse, Violet Nebula, Graphite Slate — and any accent and text colour you like, all set in iCUE alongside your other widgets. Every change shows straight away and is checked for readability first. Background transparency fades the background, never the text. In the dashboard's own Options: 12 or 24-hour clock, Movie Mode brightness, alarm volume, and a reset that asks twice.

ALSO

Movie Mode dims the whole dashboard for film night. Show desktop, Windows notifications with a count, a button that switches your XENEON EDGE display mode, and swiping left or right to change iCUE screen.

SETUP (ABOUT 2 MINUTES)

Step 1: Add Cave Aurora Edge to your XENEON EDGE in iCUE.

Step 2: Install the free companion app from the link below. It starts with Windows, runs quietly, and powers the sound controls, media details, RAM and network, notifications, shortcuts and the PC controls. The clock, timer, tasks, work sessions, colours and the CPU and GPU readings all work without it.

Step 3: For swiping and the display-mode button, set Switch Display Mode, Previous Display Screen and Next Display Screen in iCUE Screen Setup.

REQUIREMENTS

Windows, iCUE 5.47 or later and a CORSAIR XENEON EDGE. The companion app talks only to your own PC (127.0.0.1). No account, no telemetry, no tracking.

GOOD TO KNOW

Browsers report all their tabs to Windows as one media source, so two tabs in the same browser count once.

Setup guide, support and the free companion app: https://github.com/Caveproduction-bot/cave-aurora-edge

See who's in your TeamSpeak channel — without ever leaving your game.

This widget puts your current TeamSpeak 6 channel right on your iCUE display: the channel name, everyone in it, who is talking and who is sharing their screen. Your own microphone, speaker and screen-share status sits in the top-right corner, so a quick glance tells you whether you're muted before you start talking.

What you see

- **Channel header** — the name of the channel you're in and the number of people in it. Spacer markup like \[cspacer\] is removed automatically
- **Server name** — optional line above the channel name
- **Your status** — microphone and speaker icons (red when muted), plus a screen-share icon while you are sharing
- **User list** — everyone in the channel, with your own name pinned to the top
- **Live speaking indicator** — a green dot and green name while someone is talking
- **Screen sharing** — a green icon for everyone sharing their screen, greyed out while the stream is paused
- **Away users** — dimmed with a clock icon when a user is AFK
- **Mute icons** — see at a glance who has their mic or sound turned off
- **Overflow counter** — a "+N more" line when the channel is bigger than the display

The layout scales itself to your display, from compact keyboard screens to large dashboards, and splits the user list into multiple columns on wider screens.

Make it yours

Adjust the size of text and icons (50–200 %) and the maximum number of names shown. Toggle the channel header, the server name, per-user status icons, speaking highlights, and whether your own name appears in the list. Background, text, accent, speaking, muted and screen-share colors are all configurable, so the widget matches the rest of your setup.

**How it works**

The widget connects to the official TeamSpeak Remote Apps interface on your own PC — no server plugin, no third-party service, no account. Enable Remote Apps in TeamSpeak under Settings → Remote Apps and approve the request once; after that it connects automatically and reconnects on its own if TeamSpeak restarts.

On iCUE 5.51 or newer, also allow the widget to reach TeamSpeak: iCUE → Settings → Widget Access → TeamSpeak 6 Channel → allow 127.0.0.1.

**Requirements**

- Windows
- iCUE 5.47 or newer (on iCUE 5.51, use 5.51.42 or newer)
- TeamSpeak 6 client running on the same PC, with Remote Apps enabled

Available in English and German — the widget follows your iCUE language setting.

widgets.description:
Cave Studio Edge turns your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a calm, creator-focused studio dashboard: your tasks, your work time, what is playing and how your PC is doing, all on one 2560x720 touch screen. It sits under your main monitor all day without shouting for attention.

TASKS

Add tasks with a due date, duration and priority. Start typing and your past tasks are suggested, so repeat jobs take one tap. Pick a duration from presets (15 min to 16h) or type your own. A calendar shows which days have work and filters the list. Saving a task that is already booked for that day warns you first. Deleting asks first, then offers Undo. Totals show open and completed tasks, hours worked and today.

WORK SESSIONS

Press play on any task to start its timer. The task's duration becomes your goal and its name shows under the timer. When time is up the timer flashes for a minute, then keeps counting until you stop. Pause, take timed breaks with optional reminders, and End Session (or tick the task off) to save it. Press play again later and it picks up where it left off. It keeps time through restarts, sleep and iCUE reloads.

SESSION HISTORY

Every session is saved with its date, start and end time, the task it was for, time worked and breaks, and CONTINUE picks one back up.

MEDIA

Title, artist, app and artwork, a progress bar you can drag, previous, play/pause, next and volume. If two apps are playing, switch which one the controls follow.

SYSTEM

Live CPU, GPU, RAM and network speeds with small history graphs. CPU and GPU work as soon as the widget is added, from iCUE's own sensors, on Intel or AMD processors and NVIDIA, AMD or Intel graphics, including multi-GPU PCs. Every reading also has a source setting in iCUE, starting on Automatic, if you would rather pick the sensor yourself. RAM and network speeds come from the free bridge below, because iCUE has no sensors for them. A reading with no source says so and points at the setting that fixes it, and Options names the source behind every figure.

QUICK CONTROLS

Mute, mic mute, Switch Sound (next output), Sound Source (pick an output), Movie Mode (dims the whole dashboard for film night, tap to restore), Windows notifications (tap to open or close, with a count), Show desktop, a button that switches your XENEON EDGE display mode, and swiping left or right to change iCUE pages. The display and page controls use the shortcuts you set in iCUE Screen Setup.

MAKE IT YOURS

Colours are set in iCUE, alongside every other widget. Pick any accent colour and the whole dashboard is tuned to match, or set your own text and background too, in iCUE's Widgets settings; every change shows straight away. Background transparency fades the background and panels, never the text. Whatever you choose is checked for readability and corrected before it is applied, so the dashboard stays legible. In the dashboard's own Options: 12 or 24-hour clock, adjustable Movie Mode brightness, Open iCUE, and Reset all data with a second confirmation.

SETUP (ABOUT 2 MINUTES)

Step 1: Add Cave Studio Edge to your XENEON EDGE in iCUE.

Step 2: Install the free Cave Studio Edge Bridge from the link below. It starts with Windows, runs quietly, and powers audio, media details, RAM and network readings, notifications and the screen controls. Tasks, work sessions, the clock, colours and the CPU and GPU readings all work without it.

Step 3: For page swiping and the display-mode button, set Switch Display Mode, Previous Display Screen and Next Display Screen in iCUE Screen Setup.

REQUIREMENTS

Windows, iCUE 5.47 or later and a CORSAIR XENEON EDGE. The bridge talks only to your own PC (127.0.0.1). No account, no telemetry, no tracking.

GOOD TO KNOW

Browsers report all their tabs to Windows as one media source, so two tabs in the same browser count once.

Setup guide, support and the free bridge: https://github.com/Caveproduction-bot/cave-studio-edge

**🪐 Star Citizen on the Corsair Xeneon Edge: a real MFD panel for your rig, one that follows your session**

**🪲 Known issue:** mouse cursor appearing in Star Citizen. This is a new issue in the latest version of SC.

Tapping the XENEON Edge can make your mouse cursor appear on your main screen in Star Citizen. This isn't caused by this widget. It happens with any widget on the Edge, and even when tapping an empty spot. Have reported the issue to RSI.

✅ Ship controls appear the moment you board, and switch when you get out
✅ Power, shields, modes and targeting, all under your fingers
✅ The Edge Control always displays what you are flying and doing - tracking session, contracts, location and actions.
✅ Always tested on the latest release.

\--

**🚀 WHAT IT DOES**

Star Citizen has more keybinds than anyone remembers. This puts the ones you actually reach for on the Xeneon Edge, laid out and labeled, and even changes them automatically for you while you play.

Board a ship and the panel switches to flight controls to give you your critical controls. Step out and it goes back to your suit, weapon and emotes.

\--
**<u>SETUP NOTE:</u>** This widget requires installation of a small companion app (setup guide has the details) to link with Star Citizen.

💺 **IN THE SHIP**

- Power: weapons, thrusters, shields and coolers, up and down on each
- Shields: front, rear, left, right, top, bottom, and a reset
- Flight: SCM and NAV master modes, space brake, gear, VTOL, auto land, landing request
- Assists: decoupled, cruise, G-safe, ESP, proximity, speed limit
- Systems: MFD cycling, mobiGlas, starmap, scan, ping, lights, light amp, head tracking
- Targeting: lock, cycle hostile, friendly and attacker, sub-component, pin, decoy, noise, missile arm
- Mining and salvage modes, plus eject and self destruct behind a deliberate hold

\--

**🥾 OUTSIDE / ON FOOT**

- Suit and view: mobiGlas, flashlight, inventory, helmet, visor wipe, free cam
- Weapons: primary, secondary, sidearm, melee, reload, weapon zeroing
- Emotes: yay

\--

**🎨 THE DETAILS MATTER**

- The panel wears the color of the manufacturer: Anvil, Drake, microTech, Origin, RSI
- Or pick your own color, and it sticks
- A live feed of your own session
- Anything you would regret pressing needs a hold, never a tap
- Keybinds are checked against each Star Citizen patch, currently 4.10

\--

**⚙️ SETUP: 3 steps**

This one asks a little of you up front. A screen cannot press keys on its own, so a small free companion app does that part, and reads the game's log so the panel knows what you are in.

1. Add the widget to a Large or XL slot in iCUE
2. Download the companion from the setup guide. Run it once. It installs and starts with Windows from then on
3. Optional: import the included keybind file for extra functionality (recommended)

I wrote a guide for every step: getflowkits.com/setup-companion/star-citizen

\--

**📋 Worth knowing before you buy**

- Windows 10 or 11 only
- The free companion has to be running. It is not optional, and it is what makes every control work
- Windows may show a warning the first time you run it. The guide explains what it means
- Built for the Large and XL slots
- Everything runs locally on your PC

\--

Disclaimer

This iCUE widget is an independent creation, not affiliated with or endorsed by Cloud Imperium Games or Roberts Space Industries. Star Citizen and related marks are trademarks of Cloud Imperium Games Corporation, used solely to identify compatibility. Background imagery in marketing images is made using screenshots by http://hasgaha.com
