widgets.description:
Keep everyday tasks and routines in view with Reminders, an interactive XENEON EDGE widget that turns your touchscreen into a customizable to-do list. Create reminders, organize repeating tasks, and receive on-screen alerts when it’s time to take action.

**What’s Included**

Create reminders with a title, optional notes, and a website link. Add a date and time when needed, or leave them blank for a simple to-do item.

Choose Never, Daily, Weekly, Biweekly, Monthly, or Yearly repetition. Custom schedules support hourly, daily, weekly, monthly, and yearly intervals.

Tap a reminder’s completion circle to mark it done. Repeating reminders track each occurrence separately, so completing today’s task leaves future occurrences ready to go.

Timed reminders display a large, tappable alert with a short chime when audio is enabled. Tap to dismiss the alert without marking the reminder complete.

Browse days using the navigation arrows or jump to a specific date with the year, month, and day picker. The widget automatically returns to the new day at midnight.

**Organization**

Open the filter controls to narrow your list by frequency or completion status. Sort timed reminders by Soonest first or Latest first, with untimed tasks placed last.

**Customization**

Choose up to four reminder columns and Small, Medium, or Large tiles. The layout adapts to the available space, reducing columns when needed to keep reminders readable.

Customize main text, notes text, and interface accent colors using a color wheel, brightness slider, or hex value. Set individual frequency colors to distinguish repeating schedules at a glance.

Adjust background opacity through iCUE for a translucent dark appearance.

Layout and color preferences save automatically for each widget instance.

**Disclaimer**

Reminders is independently developed by Respawn Icons.

widgets.description:
Cave Command Edge turns the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a control surface you actually use: what is playing, how long you have worked, and what your PC is playing through, all on one 2560x720 touch dashboard.

MEDIA

Track and artist from the official iCUE Media Data Provider, with previous, play/pause and next as full-height touch targets you can hit without looking.

WORK TIME

A timestamp-backed stopwatch built for an eight-hour day. Set your goal in 30-minute steps, watch elapsed, remaining and percent complete, and start a 15-minute break that pauses work and resumes on its own. Because it stores timestamps rather than ticks, your day survives a restart, a sleep, or an iCUE reload.

SESSIONS

Finished days are logged with duration and break count, newest first, with a running total. Delete any entry behind a confirm step.

CLOCK

24-hour time with seconds, day and full date, in a high-contrast readout you can read across the room.

AUDIO (companion bridge included)

Install the free Cave Command Edge Bridge and the audio panel goes live: switch between two Windows playback devices, mute, and drag the master volume. Without the bridge the widget still runs; the panel simply reports that it is offline.

REQUIREMENTS

iCUE 5.47 or later, Windows, and a XENEON EDGE dashboard LCD. The bridge is Windows-only and talks only to 127.0.0.1. No account, no telemetry, no network calls.

Support and free bridge download: https://github.com/Caveproduction-bot/cave-command-edge

widgets.description:
Window Manager for XENEON turns CORSAIR XENEON Edge into a dedicated touch strip for your Windows desktop.

See currently open top-level application windows with the native app icon, app name, useful window title, current state and monitor. Tap any card to bring that window forward, then use large touch controls to minimize, maximize or restore, snap left, snap right, move it to any detected monitor, or close it with an explicit confirmation step.

Pin favorite applications so the apps you care about stay at the edge of the strip even when they are closed. The active foreground window is highlighted clearly, while empty, disconnected, pairing and no-active-window states stay explicit instead of showing stale data.

The interface is designed separately for all eight XENEON Edge size and orientation combinations. Wide layouts behave like a visual desktop control strip rather than stretched Stream Deck keys, while vertical layouts become a compact scrollable window list with the same controls.

Windows does not expose arbitrary desktop-window enumeration and placement to a normal iCUE web widget, so this product uses the free PackRat Window Manager Lite Stream Deck plugin as its local Windows engine.

Install Window Manager Lite from the Elgato Marketplace: https://marketplace.elgato.com/product/window-manager-lite-a7693b4c-4afd-4dce-925a-262fd23b1f23. Window Manager Lite keeps the native Windows work local to your PC and provides the XENEON widget with window state and controls over localhost. Window titles, process metadata and commands are not sent to a PackRat cloud service.

Window Manager Lite remains the free Stream Deck edition. Its normal Lite action set and upgrade path to Window Manager Pro are separate from the XENEON interface.

Part of the PackRat Ecosystem.

Turn your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a dedicated color workstation for design, branding, UI work, illustration, and everyday color exploration.

Color Lab Pro combines a responsive color wheel with designer-friendly color values, practical palette generation, contrast guidance, and a persistent library—all directly on the XENEON EDGE touchscreen. The core widget runs independently, while the included Color Lab Windows companion is recommended for the best and most complete experience.

The Custom workspace gives you precise control over five independent colors. Select any slot, adjust it live from the color wheel, refine its lightness, or enter an exact HEX, RGB, HSL, OKLCH, or estimated CMYK value. Reorder the colors, compare them together, and save the finished palette for later editing.

Generate palettes using Practical UI, Monochromatic, Analogous, Complementary, Split Complementary, Triadic, and Shades modes. Inspect every color through five useful representations, review white and black contrast performance, pin favorites, and maintain a reusable palette library.

Install the recommended Color Lab Windows companion from the related download link to connect the touchscreen workspace to the rest of your desktop. Sample a point from any connected monitor, follow colors continuously in Live mode, drag over a screen area to find its dominant colors, or extract a palette from an image directly into the five-slot Custom editor. The companion also enables configurable global shortcuts, reliable Windows clipboard copying.

The companion is included as a separate installer, but it is never required to open or use the widget’s core color wheel, harmony, inspection, Custom palette, and library tools. All companion processing stays local on your PC and communicates with the widget only through a private local connection. No account, API key, cloud processing, or image upload is required.

widgets.description:
**\*Stack it. Match it. Watch it flow.\*\***

**Turn your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a colourful puzzle playground. Pick a stack, place it beside matching colours and watch individual tiles lift, glide and settle into place. Bring together ten or more matching tiles to clear them, reveal the colours underneath and set off a chain reaction.**

**There’s no timer rushing your next move. Take a quick break, plan a clever connection or keep going for the next level. Your progress saves automatically after each completed move, ready for your next session.**

**>> Why you’ll love it**

**- A board you can explore: Rotate and tilt the whole 3D board, pinch or scroll to zoom, or switch to Top view.**

**- Satisfying moves: Flowing tile transfers, upward particle bursts and glowing merge effects bring every connection to life.**

**- Celebrate your progress: Gold achievement badges, colourful hexagon confetti and bold result screens mark each completed level.**

**- Made for touch: Large incoming stacks, bold stamped numbers and clear controls keep the action easy to follow.**

**- Play at your pace: No timer, a one-move Undo and the option to restart the current level.**

**- Pick up where you left off: Local saves retain your game and preferences on the same widget instance.**

**- Sound your way: Optional game sounds and victory chimes, with a simple sound toggle.**

**- Fully offline: No account or internet connection required for gameplay.**

**A little strategy. A burst of colour. One more level.**

**>>How to play**

**1. Tap a stack, then an empty hexagon—or drag the stack onto the board.**

**2. Matching colours on neighbouring stack tops pull together.**

**3. Clear a top run of ten or more matching tiles to score and uncover the colours below.**

**4. Reach the level target, celebrate and tap Next Level to continue.**


**Drag the board to rotate and tilt. Pinch or use the mouse wheel to zoom. Lock camera holds the view steady while you place tiles; Top view and Reset help you find your bearings.**

**## Requirements and compatibility**

**- Windows with CORSAIR iCUE 5.47 or later.**

**- CORSAIR XENEON EDGE in Large (L) or Extra Large (XL) layout.**

**- Designed for touchscreen and mouse interaction.**

**- Saved progress is local to the widget instance/device; no cloud sync or online multiplayer.**


**## Version and creator**

**Version: 1.0.15**

**Created by: iConCity**

widgets.description:
Give your XENEON EDGE a word challenge worth coming back to.

Pick up a card, move it into place and discover what connects four words. Each correct row locks into place as you work through seven associations per level. With no timer or swap limit, you can take a quick break or settle in and think it through.


Explore 100 puzzles featuring everyday objects, animals, places, food, science and word connections. Later levels introduce compound-word clues that invite you to look at familiar words differently.

 Features

\- **100 levels, 700 distinct groups:** Seven connections to discover in every puzzle.

\- **Touch and mouse controls:** Hold and drag cards, or tap two cards to swap them.

\- **Clear pickup feedback:** Lifted cards cast a shadow, and the destination card moves aside to preview the swap.

\- **Snap-back on invalid drops:** Release outside a playable slot or over a completed row to return the card.

\- **Easy-to-see hints:** Gold cards and a clear category panel help you find a connection.

\- **Play at your own pace:** No timer, lives or swap limit.

\- **Saved progress:** Resume your boards and revisit levels through the level selector. Best completed swap counts are recorded per level.

\- **Shuffle and restart:** Rearrange unsolved cards or restart the current puzzle with a fresh layout.

\- **Sound controls:** Optional move and completion sounds, with an on/off setting.

\- **A clean XL layout:** A large word board, local clock, Settings and built-in instructions.

\- **Fully offline:** No account, subscription or internet connection required to play.

\## Requirements

\- Windows with CORSAIR iCUE 5.47 or later.

\- CORSAIR XENEON EDGE, using the Extra Large (XL) landscape widget layout.

\- English-language puzzles.

Smaller layouts display an **ASSOCIATIONS / Select XL** notice. The game is designed for touch and mouse input; a physical keyboard is not required.

\## Useful information

**Are the puzzles randomly generated?**

There are 100 fixed puzzles. Their starting card positions are shuffled. Restarting reshuffles the current puzzle; choosing another level changes the words and associations.

**Do words repeat?**

Whole association groups never repeat, and no word appears twice within a level. Some words return in different contexts across levels. The collection contains 2,621 distinct words and phrases across 2,800 card placements.

**What happens after an incorrect move**

Mixed rows stay editable while you work out the connection. Correct rows lock automatically. Snap-back applies to drops outside playable slots or onto completed rows.

**Where is progress saved?**

Progress is stored locally. The widget includes a recovery save to help preserve progress when the widget instance ID changes. Clearing iCUE storage or removing its saved data can still reset progress. There is no cloud sync.

Retro Terminal Pro is the ultimate customizable version of the PackRat Retro Terminal for CORSAIR XENEON Edge.

Keep the terminal-first look that made the free version useful as an ambient display, then customize it into the CRT you actually want: green phosphor, amber, white monochrome, blue terminal, cyberpunk, or your own custom colors. Tune scanlines, glow, subtle flicker, vignette and CRT curvature from iCUE.

Choose from multiple startup sequences and five touch-switchable programs: PROMPT, SYSTEM, TRACE, DATA RAIN and CLOCK. PROMPT uses your own machine name, username, command and ambient script lines. TRACE and DATA RAIN are clearly labeled synthetic terminal visuals. CLOCK uses local device time.

SYSTEM is the one live telemetry program. It discovers CPU, GPU and memory sensors exposed by the native iCUE Sensors provider and shows only values iCUE actually returns. Missing sensors stay unavailable instead of being replaced with fake data. The uptime line is the widget session uptime and is labeled that way, not presented as PC uptime.

Enable automatic program rotation, automatic style rotation, or an idle screensaver that moves to Clock, Data Rain or Trace after a configurable period. Any touch wakes the terminal, and the five program keys let you jump between views instantly.

Settings and the last manually selected program are stored locally per widget instance. No PackRat account or external service is required.

Retro Terminal Pro is a separate paid product. The original free Retro Terminal remains unchanged.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for CORSAIR XENEON Edge.

Audio Control Center turns your CORSAIR XENEON Edge into a touch-first Windows sound control surface.

See the current Windows default output, switch between detected headphones, speakers, displays and other playback devices, and adjust real endpoint master volume or mute without opening Windows Settings.

The input side does the same job for microphones: see the active Windows default input, switch to another detected microphone, mute it, and adjust microphone endpoint volume when the hardware and driver expose that control reliably.

Clear ACTIVE status, friendly Windows device names, large touch controls and dedicated disconnected or no-device states keep the panel understandable at a glance. All eight XENEON Edge layouts are tuned separately.

Audio Control Center requires the free PackRat Audio Bridge companion on Windows. Download: https://packrat-site.pages.dev/downloads/audio-control-center\\n\\nExtract the ZIP and run INSTALL_STARTUP.cmd for a per-user startup install, or START_AUDIO_BRIDGE.cmd for portable/manual use. The bridge runs only on your PC, uses Windows Core Audio for endpoint discovery and volume control, and talks to the XENEON widget over loopback localhost. No administrator install, Windows service, PackRat cloud service, account, or telemetry is required.

Windows does not expose a documented public setter for the global default audio endpoint. PackRat Audio Bridge isolates the Windows policy interface behind a capability check and disables switching if Windows rejects it; volume and mute remain independent.

Part of the PackRat 🐀 collection for CORSAIR XENEON Edge.

TURN YOUR XENEON EDGE INTO A REAL MIDI INSTRUMENT

**iConCity MIDI Piano transforms the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a genuine touch-driven MIDI controller for your studio.**

This isn't a visual piano, novelty keyboard or soundboard.

Play the touchscreen and send **real MIDI note data** directly into your DAW and virtual instruments through the **iConCity MIDI Bridge**.

Sketch melodies. Build chords. Test synth patches. Trigger samples. Play software instruments. Explore sounds without reaching for another controller.

Your XENEON EDGE just became part of your music studio.

REAL MIDI OUTPUT

MIDI Piano sends genuine MIDI note-on and note-off messages into Windows.

Inside your compatible DAW or music software, simply select:

**iConCity MIDI**

…and start playing.

No keyboard emulation. No touchscreen-to-keystroke tricks. This is a purpose-built MIDI workflow designed specifically for XENEON EDGE.

BUILT FOR TOUCH

The ultra-wide piano interface has been designed around the XENEON EDGE touchscreen, with large playable keys, clear visual feedback and **multi-touch support**.

Play:

- Individual notes

- Chords

- Intervals

- Melodies

- Pads

- Bass lines

- Touch-based performances

Press multiple keys together and MIDI Piano sends them together — exactly as you'd expect from a MIDI controller.

CONTROL YOUR PERFORMANCE

**Adjustable Velocity**
Choose how softly or powerfully your instrument responds, with quick velocity controls and precision MIDI values when you need them.

**16 MIDI Channels**
Instantly switch between all 16 MIDI channels using a touch-friendly selector — perfect for routing different instruments and MIDI destinations.

**Octave Controls**
Move from deep bass to soaring leads without leaving the widget.

**Sustain**
Hold notes just like using a sustain pedal — ideal for pianos, strings, pads and atmospheric instruments.

**MIDI Panic**
Got a hanging note? One touch clears active notes and gets your session back under control.

**Optional Note Names**
Display note labels while learning or hide them for a cleaner performance layout.

MADE FOR YOUR DAW

MIDI Piano isn't locked to one instrument or music application.

Use it with compatible:

- Software pianos

- Synthesizers

- Samplers

- Drum instruments

- Orchestral libraries

**Wordle — Daily Word Puzzle Widget for the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE**
**Wordle** puts a daily five-letter puzzle on your Corsair XENEON EDGE, with a full touch keyboard, colour-coded tiles and a streak that grows every day you solve it. When one puzzle a day isn't enough, **Endless** deals a fresh word whenever you want one.

**Key Features & Capabilities**

**The Game You Know**

\- **Six Guesses, Five Letters**: Every guess has to be a real word. Tiles turn **green** for the right letter in the right spot, **yellow** for a letter that's in the word somewhere else, and **grey** for a miss.

\- **Real Word Lists**: 2,315 possible answers and nearly 13,000 accepted guesses, the same lists the original game shipped with, built into the widget.

\- **Smart Feedback**: Duplicate letters are scored the way the original does it. The on-screen keys colour themselves as you learn, so you always know what's left.

\- **Flips, Shakes and Bounces**: Tiles flip as they reveal, a bad word shakes, a solved row bounces. Turn the animations off if you prefer it calm.

**Daily and Endless**

\- **Daily Puzzle**: One word a day, the same for everyone. Numbered, with a live countdown to the next one right in the header. Miss a day and the streak resets, just like it should.

\- **Endless Practice**: Tap **New word** for another round, as many times as you like, with its own streak and statistics.

\- **Two Widgets, Two Jobs**: Add Wordle twice and pin one copy to Daily and the other to Endless from iCUE's own settings for the widget.

**Streaks and Statistics**

\- **Played, Win %, Streak, Best**: Tracked separately for Daily and Endless.

\- **Guess Distribution**: A bar for every number of tries, with today's result highlighted.

\- **Share Your Result**: The classic emoji grid, copied with one tap.

**Built for Touch**

\- **Big Keys**: A full QWERTY keyboard sized for fingers, with AZERTY and QWERTZ layouts too.

\- **Any Tile Size**: Board beside the keyboard on wide placements, stacked on tall ones, with a statistics panel when there's room. Everything scales to the space it's given.

\- **Physical Keyboard Too**: Type, Enter and Backspace work from a real keyboard if one is attached.

**Make It Yours**

\- **Hard Mode**: Every revealed hint must be used in your next guess.

\- **High Contrast**: Orange and blue tiles instead of green and yellow, for colour-blind players. The share grid follows.

\- **Keyboard Off**: Hide the on-screen keyboard to give the board the whole widget.

\- **Reset**: Clear your board and statistics with a two-tap confirm.

A configurable multi-dial dashboard for the iCUE LINK 5 Inch LCD Module and XENEON EDGE, featuring hardware sensors, live frame rate, session telemetry, thresholds, and a 60-second trend graph.

**ArcLine Modules by OPULENT HARDWARE**

How It Works

ArcLine Modules includes layouts optimized for the **iCUE LINK 5 Inch LCD Module and XENEON EDGE.**

Each dial can be configured independently. Select **Hardware Sensor** to display temperatures, fan speeds, system loads, or other supported readings. Select **Frame Rate** to monitor live game FPS. Labels, colors, ranges, sensor assignments, and FPS maximums can be customized for each dial.

The primary dial includes session minimum and maximum values and a 60-second historical trend graph. When Frame Rate is selected, the graph and session telemetry automatically follow FPS.

The wider XENEON EDGE layout displays additional configurable dials and system information while maintaining the same ArcLine design.

Getting Started

1. Install ArcLine Modules by dragging the `.icuewidget` package into the iCUE installation area or selecting it through the file explorer.

2. Add **ArcLine Modules** to an iCUE LINK 5 Inch LCD Module or XENEON EDGE layout.

3. Open the settings and select **Hardware Sensor** or **Frame Rate** for each dial.

4. Assign your preferred sensors, labels, colors, ranges, and thresholds.

What’s Included

- Device-optimized layouts for the 5 Inch LCD Module and XENEON EDGE

- Turbine-style configurable monitoring dials

- Independent Hardware Sensor or Frame Rate selection

- Temperature, load, fan-speed, and other supported readings

- Live game frame-rate monitoring

- Custom FPS maximums

- Session minimum and maximum telemetry

- A 60-second trend graph

- Custom labels, colors, ranges, and thresholds

- Additional display and behavior options

Supported Layouts

ArcLine Modules is designed and verified for:

- **iCUE LINK 5 Inch LCD Module**, including systems using the TITAN 2 cooler

- **XENEON EDGE**

Each layout is designed around the device’s native screen shape and available display area.

Customization

ArcLine Modules includes controls for:

- Source type and sensor assignment for each dial

- Per-dial FPS configuration

- Custom dial labels and colors

- Minimum and maximum gauge ranges

- Warning and critical temperature thresholds

- Automatic, Celsius, or Fahrenheit temperature display

- Additional display and behavior settings

Troubleshooting

If a hardware-sensor dial displays dashes or **SENSOR OFFLINE**, confirm that the iCUE Sensors data provider is available. Reopen the settings and assign the affected sensor again.

If an FPS dial displays **NO GAME ACTIVE**, confirm that a supported game is running and that the iCUE FPS data provider is available. The dial remains steady until iCUE reports an active frame-rate source.

If the primary graph is empty, confirm that Dial 1 has a live sensor or frame-rate source. The graph follows Dial 1 and begins building its history after valid readings are received.

If the widget does not display correctly on XENEON EDGE, confirm that it has been added to an XENEON EDGE layout and that the correct device layout is active in iCUE.

Privacy

ArcLine Modules reads locally available sensor and frame-rate values through iCUE’s bundled data providers. It does not collect, store, transmit, or analyze personal information.

The widget makes no network requests and includes no external accounts, analytics, advertisements, remote fonts, or API keys.

Note

**ArcLine Modules** is created by **OPULENT HARDWARE** for the iCUE LINK 5 Inch LCD Module and XENEON EDGE.

Each dial can be configured independently, allowing ArcLine Modules to function as a temperature dashboard, cooling monitor, performance display, frame-rate monitor, or a combination of all four.

**Top Clock**

A fully repositionable digital clock widget for your keyboard's LCD screen — that also tells you when your music changes.

Most built-in clock widgets are locked to the center of the screen, which is a problem if the top or bottom of your display is partially covered by keycaps. Top Clock solves that: place it anywhere on the screen with two simple sliders, and it stays exactly where you put it.

And when a new track starts, the clock briefly steps aside to show the title and artist, then comes straight back. No separate media screen to switch to, no screen left stuck on a paused player.

Clock

- Free positioning — horizontal and vertical sliders let you place the clock anywhere on the screen, not just dead-center
- 12h / 24h format toggle, synced to your system default
- Optional seconds display
- Full time zone support — pick any time zone from the system list
- Multiple date formats — long, short, or numeric (EU/US style), all rendered in your iCUE display language

Now playing

- Title and artist appear automatically whenever the track changes
- Returns to the clock on its own — set the display duration from 1 to 15 seconds
- Long titles are scaled down to fit instead of being cut off
- Adjustable media text size, independent from the clock
- Pausing, resuming or seeking never triggers it — only a genuine track change does
- Can be switched off entirely if you only want the clock

Appearance

- 7 font choices — including a bundled condensed display font, plus system fonts like Arial, Segoe UI, Impact, and Consolas
- Adjustable font size so you can fine-tune the clock to your screen and layout
- Custom text color
- Optional background color or background image
- Adjustable transparency

Works on any keyboard with an LCD screen. Fully translated into the 12 languages supported by iCUE — English, French, German, Spanish, Italian, Portuguese, Japanese, Korean, Russian, Ukrainian, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese — and the date format follows your iCUE display language automatically.

Free and open for anyone to use. Feedback and suggestions welcome!

Choose one primary power sensor for the authoritative session. See live watts, a rolling graph, time weighted session average, observed peak, integrated Wh or kWh, today's measured energy and estimated electricity cost. Cost is calculated from the primary sensor's measured energy and your own electricity rate.

Add additional iCUE power sensors as separate comparison traces. CPU package, GPU related and PSU sensors can sit beside each other without being silently added together. Comparison sensors never change the scope of the primary energy total.

Session energy uses the actual elapsed milliseconds between valid readings and trapezoidal integration. Irregular samples are supported. Missing, disconnected and stale intervals are not filled with guessed power. Short widget restarts can resume a stored session without integrating the offline gap.

Pro keeps local daily energy buckets and a rolling history of finalized sessions. Set a graph window from 60 seconds to 10 minutes, configure a high power threshold, choose per-sensor comparison colors through iCUE and customize the main meter appearance.

The measurement label always follows the actual iCUE sensor metadata. CPU package power is not called total PC power. PSU input and output remain distinct. A whole-system label is used only when iCUE exposes that scope.

Idle versus active is intentionally not claimed in V1 because iCUE does not expose a universal workload-state signal that would make the classification reliable across PCs.

No account, helper app or external service is required. All history stays local to the widget instance.

**Pet Plant by OPULENT HARDWARE**

Bring a little personality to your CORSAIR Xeneon Edge with Pet Plant, an animated desktop companion that reacts, encourages, reminds, and keeps an eye on your hardware.

Pet Plant feels more like a tiny digital friend than a traditional sensor widget. Its face changes throughout the day, it responds when you interact with it, offers words of encouragement, shares plant jokes, and gently reminds you to hydrate, stretch, rest your eyes, walk around, check your posture, or take a breath.

Underneath that playful personality is a capable hardware monitor. Connect Pet Plant to a supported iCUE sensor and it can react to temperatures, hardware utilization, fan speeds, and other readings. Its expressions and messages become increasingly concerned as a selected sensor approaches your advisory, warning, and critical thresholds.

Choose a plant, pot color, personality, movement level, and background that fits your setup. Let your companion stay cheerful and expressive throughout the day, restrict its reactions to sensor thresholds, or hide the persistent sensor card for a clean character-focused display.

Pet Plant combines useful monitoring with the charm of a virtual desk companion—giving important hardware information a face, a voice, and a little bit of heart.

**Getting Started**

1. Install Pet Plant by dragging the widget into the installation area or selecting it through the file explorer.

2. Add Pet Plant to your CORSAIR Xeneon Edge layout.

**How It Works**

Pet Plant reads real-time hardware information through the iCUE Sensors data provider plugin. Select a supported sensor, choose the appropriate monitoring profile, and enter advisory, warning, and critical thresholds.

As the reading changes, Pet Plant responds with animated expressions and contextual messages. It can monitor values that rise above your thresholds, such as GPU temperature or utilization, or values that fall below them, such as fan speed.

The optional sensor card keeps the current reading visible in supported layouts. Hide it for a cleaner appearance, and it will return automatically when a threshold alert or companion message needs your attention.

**Organized Settings**

Pet Plant’s controls are arranged into three straightforward sections:

- Companion Behavior

- Sensor, Alerts and Reminders

- Character and Appearanc

**Privacy**

Pet Plant makes no external network requests and contains no advertising, telemetry, account login, or credential storage. Sensor information remains within the local iCUE widget environment.

**Note**

Pet Plant is an expressive monitoring companion and is not a replacement for dedicated thermal protection, fan control, or hardware safety systems.

Pet Plant is created by OPULENT HARDWARE. Visit the profile for additional widgets designed to complement your CORSAIR Xeneon Edge layout.

Overview

Album is a real-time media display widget for iCUE LCD devices. It automatically showcases your currently playing track, artist name, and high-resolution album artwork, complete with animated equalizer bars and scrolling marquee text.

iCUE Mode Required: These iCUE widgets are only available when the keyboard is running in iCUE mode with iCUE open. Widgets can not be saved to or used in Device Memory Mode (hardware mode).

iCUE Version Requirement for Widget Availability: iCUE version 5.47 or later is required to use the widgets. We recommend always updating to the latest version of iCUE for the best experience.

Wired Connection Required: To use iCUE widgets, connect the keyboard to your PC with a USB cable and use the keyboard in wired mode.

Enable Screen Widgets for Dial Control for Vanguard 96 series: In iCUE, go to the Rotary Dial tab, enable Screen Widget, and select it as the dial function. Once enabled, you can use the rotary dial to switch between widgets and interact with supported widget functions.

Switching Between Widgets

You can switch between widgets using the following controls:

- Vanguard 96 / Vanguard 96 Wireless / Vanguard PRO 96: Press FN + Left/Right Arrow, or turn the dial.
- Vanguard AIR 99 WL: Press FN + Left/Right Arrow.

How It Works

The widget connects directly to iCUE's media provider API to detect active track metadata and play state. If native OS artwork is unavailable, it automatically queries Apple's iTunes Search API using a multi-tiered search algorithm that filters out clutter in track titles, matches artist aliases, and checks region-specific storefronts. Artwork is retrieved in high resolution (600 × 600 px) and cached locally to minimize network traffic and enable fast reloads.

Getting Started

No API key is required. Open the widget settings in iCUE to customize your display. Open Personalization to choose a custom background color.

Attribution

Media artwork is sourced from the Apple iTunes Search API. iTunes is a registered trademark of Apple Inc. API usage is subject to Apple's terms and conditions.

iCUE Mode Required: These iCUE widgets are only available when the keyboard is running in iCUE mode with iCUE open. Widgets can not be saved to or used in Device Memory Mode (hardware mode).

Wired Connection Required: To use iCUE widgets, connect the keyboard to your PC with a USB cable and use the keyboard in wired mode.

- Vanguard 96 / Vanguard 96 Wireless / Vanguard PRO 96: Press FN + Left/Right Arrow, or turn the dial.

The widget fetches live 24-hour ticker data from the Binance API every 10 seconds, then calculates current USD prices and percentage changes. Gains and losses are color-coded (green for positive, red for negative). Coin logos load through a fallback hierarchy: scalable SVGs or high-resolution PNGs from a multi-coin CDN, with an automatic Wikipedia REST API fallback for less common coins. If the network is disrupted, built-in backoff logic automatically slows the refresh rate to keep the widget stable.

Getting Started

No API key is required. Open the widget settings in iCUE to set up your display. Under Crypto Settings, select up to three cryptocurrencies from a catalog of over 90 tokens (including BTC, ETH, SOL, DOGE, and popular DeFi and meme coins). Open Personalization to match the background color to your setup.

Attribution

Cryptocurrency market data is sourced from the Binance Public API. Coin icons and thumbnails are retrieved via the Crypto Icons CDN and Wikipedia API. Binance is a registered trademark of Binance Holdings Ltd.

- Vanguard 96 / Vanguard 96 Wireless / Vanguard PRO 96: Press FN + Left/Right Arrow, or turn the dial.
- Vanguard AIR 99 WL: Press FN + Left/Right Arrow.

How It Works

The widget polls ESPN's public scoreboard API every 30 seconds to fetch up-to-date game data across the league. A 5-segment progress bar on top that tracks pagination as the display automatically cycles through all scheduled games for the day every 6 seconds.

Each matchup displays side-by-side cards with team logos, abbreviations, current scores, and game status indicators (such as live period details, scheduled tip-off times, or final markers). During active or completed games, the leading team's score is highlighted in white, and the bottom section of each card dynamically reveals the team's top point scorer alongside their current point total. If a remote team logo fails to load, an embedded SVG basketball emblem automatically takes its place as a fallback.

Getting Started

The widget is fully automatic and requires no API keys or configuration:

- Load the widget in iCUE, and it will immediately retrieve today's NBA slate.

- If no games are scheduled for the day or connection issues occur, the status indicator cleanly reports "NO GAMES" or "OFFLINE".

Attribution

NBA game scores, scheduling details, and player stats are retrieved using ESPN's public Scoreboard API.

YOUR NOTES. RIGHT AT THE EDGE.

Turn your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE into a dedicated space for ideas, tasks and reminders with NOTE//EDGE by iConCity.

NOTE//EDGE is a purpose-built sticky-note workspace for the full 2560 × 720 XENEON EDGE display. It combines the immediacy of a paper note with the organisation of a digital dashboard—all inside a clean, tactile interface designed for fingers as well as a mouse.

Create a note and the workspace gives it priority. The note enlarges for comfortable editing, sample text clears automatically and the rest of the interface fades back so you can concentrate. Choose a colour, adjust the text size, assign a stack and tap DONE. Your new note returns to the board and remains above the pile until you decide where it belongs.

\#### Organise without the clutter

Use built-in stacks for WORK, HOME, TO DO, SHOPPING and URGENT, or create custom stack names of your own. The compact stack manager shows live note counts and remains easy to navigate as your collection grows. Large triangle controls support touch scrolling, while custom stacks can be swiped left and deleted with a clear confirmation step. Any notes inside a deleted custom stack move safely to HOME.

\#### To Do, done properly

Turn a note into a To Do list and every task receives its own checkbox. Press Enter to add the next item, tap to complete a task and follow progress directly on the note. Wrapped tasks grow downward cleanly, completed ticks stay inside their boxes and longer lists receive simple up/down navigation.

\#### Reminders that get your attention

Every note includes a bell control. Set an alert for today, tomorrow or a quick number of minutes. An armed reminder displays a red indicator on the bell and can be cancelled at any time.

When the reminder arrives, NOTE//EDGE brings that note to the front, dims the background and gives the note a gentle wiggle and pulse. A warm three-note chime repeats until you dismiss or snooze the reminder. If multiple alarms fire, the notes arrange themselves side by side so each one remains visible and actionable.

\#### Built for touch

NOTE//EDGE does not shrink a desktop interface onto a small screen. Buttons, labels, editors and navigation controls are sized specifically for XENEON EDGE. Long text wraps downward, overflow arrows appear only when needed, and every editing surface reserves clear space around its touch controls.

\### Complete feature list

\- Shift-select group movement with keyboard and mouse

\- Round pin button on every note

\- Dedicated All Notes, Pinned and Stacks views

\- Built-in and custom named stacks

\- Live note counts in the stack selector

\- Downward text wrapping with no horizontal overflow

\- One-line-at-a-time navigation for long notes and lists

\- Five paper colours

\- Small, medium and large note text

\- Enlarged centred editing workspace

\- Focused editing from the main board or inside a stack

\- Per-note alert bell and armed-alert indicator

\- Today, tomorrow and quick-minute alert options

\- Cancel, dismiss and five-minute snooze controls

\- Soft repeating three-note alarm chime

\- Interface accent-colour settings

\- Touch-readable settings controls

\### Compatibility

\- CORSAIR XENEON EDGE / dashboard LCD

\- Windows

\- CORSAIR iCUE 5.47 or newer

\- Requires XL widget size

Classic Solitaire. Reimagined for the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE.

Bring one of the world’s most iconic card games directly to your XENEON EDGE touchscreen with SOL//ITAIRE by iConCity — a premium, purpose-built Klondike Solitaire game designed specifically for the ultra-wide display.

SOL//ITAIRE combines familiar classic Solitaire gameplay with a sleek, modern interface created to feel completely at home on the XENEON EDGE. Its dark green playing surface, crisp cards, mint accents and custom iConCity card backs create a clean, premium experience without wasting valuable screen space.

Designed around touch from the beginning, SOL//ITAIRE doesn't rely on fiddly drag-and-drop controls. Simply tap a card or stack to select it, then tap its destination. Mouse controls are supported too, making it just as easy to play from your desktop.

\## CLASSIC KLONDIKE SOLITAIRE

Play traditional Klondike Solitaire with a full 52-card deck and properly shuffled games.

Build the seven tableau columns in descending order while alternating red and black cards. Move Aces through Kings to their matching foundations, reveal hidden cards as you clear the tableau, and work your way toward completing all four suits.

Every new game gives you a freshly shuffled challenge.

SOL//ITAIRE isn't a standard desktop Solitaire game squeezed onto a smaller display.

The entire interface has been designed around the ultra-wide XENEON EDGE touchscreen, with large touch targets, an efficient seven-column layout and a dynamic card-spacing system that keeps long tableau sequences visible as your game develops.

\## TOUCH-FIRST CONTROLS

Playing is simple:

Tap a card → Tap its destination

Select individual cards or complete legal sequences and move them around the tableau naturally.

Double-tap an exposed card and SOL//ITAIRE will attempt to send it directly to the correct foundation whenever the move is legal.

The stock is just as simple — tap it to draw the next card.

\## DRAW 1 GAMEPLAY

SOL//ITAIRE uses Draw 1 Klondike, allowing you to cycle through the stock one card at a time.

Work between the stock, waste, tableau and four foundation piles to uncover the cards you need and solve the deal.

\## UNDO

Made the wrong move?

Tap UNDO to step back and reconsider your strategy.

\## HINT SYSTEM

Need a little help?

Tap HINT and SOL//ITAIRE will analyse the current board for useful available moves, including opportunities between the tableau, waste and foundations.

\## MOVE COUNTER & GAME TIMER

Challenge yourself to become more efficient.

SOL//ITAIRE tracks your move count throughout the game while an integrated game timerrecords how long you've been playing.

Can you complete the next deal faster — and with fewer moves?

\## AUTOMATIC CARD REVEALS

Clear the exposed cards covering a face-down tableau card and it will automatically turn over, keeping gameplay quick and natural on the touchscreen.

\## AUTOMATIC WIN DETECTION

Complete all four foundations from Ace through King and SOL//ITAIRE automatically recognises the completed game and presents your final move count and completion time.

The result is a Solitaire game that feels modern and distinctive while remaining instantly familiar to play.

\## FEATURES

\* Classic Klondike Solitaire

\* Full 52-card deck

\* Freshly shuffled games

\* Draw 1 stock

\* Seven tableau columns

\* Four suit foundations

\* Correct alternating red/black tableau building

\* Ace-to-King foundation building

\* Kings required for empty tableau columns

\* Movable card sequences

\* Hidden tableau cards

\* Automatic card revealing

\* Touch-first tap-to-move controls

\* Mouse support

\* Double-tap to send legal cards to foundations

\* Undo

\* Hint system

\* Move counter

\* Game timer

\* Automatic win detection

\* Adaptive spacing for long card columns

Track your Valorant rank, RR, session win/loss, and match stats live on your Xeneon Edge — plus a quick 45-second tap-to-start timer and manual win/loss logging for your competitive sessions.

Setup — required before the widget will show data

**1. Get a free HenrikDev API key**
This widget pulls your stats from the HenrikDev Valorant API, a free community service.

- Join the HenrikDev Discord
- Go to the `#get-a-key` channel and request a **Basic** key (free, takes a minute)
- Copy the key you receive (starts with `HDEV-...`)

**2. Add the widget to your Xeneon Edge**
Drag "Valorant Tracker" onto your screen from the widget picker.

**3. Open the widget's settings panel and fill in:**

Riot ID e.g. Name#TAG (Your exact Riot ID, including the tag after the `#` (e.g. `Phoenix#1337`))
HenrikDev API Key (the key from Step 1)
Region e.g. eu, na, ap, kr (Your Valorant region shard — just the short code, lowercase)
Act End Date (YYYY-MM-DD)*(Optional, Large size only)* Type the date the current act ends, e.g. `2026-09-30`, to show a countdown

Data appears within a few seconds of saving. It refreshes automatically and is cached for 5 minutes to stay within API rate limits.

What you'll see, by widget size

- **Medium**: Rank tier, current RR, session win/loss, last match RR change, headshot %, top agent (name + K/D), win/loss buttons
- **Large / XL**: + damage dealt, top 3 maps, top 3 agents with win rate, act countdown, 45-second tap-to-start timer, full manual win/loss controls with RR entry

Notes

- Your API key and Riot ID are stored locally in iCUE's settings — never sent anywhere except HenrikDev's API.
- Session win/loss and Net RR track from when the widget loads; use the reset (↺) button to clear them anytime.
- If nothing loads, double check your Riot ID includes the `#TAG` and your region code is correct (`eu`, `na`, `ap`, or `kr`).

widgets.description:
Keep your Rainbow Six Siege progress visible while you play. R6 Siege Tracker displays your current rank and RP, recent session wins and losses, best operators, season highlights, and an interactive round timer directly on your CORSAIR XENEON EDGE.

WHAT YOU NEED

• A CORSAIR XENEON EDGE running iCUE 5.46 or newer

• An internet connection

• Your Ubisoft username

• A valid R6Data/Arenyze API key

BEGINNER SETUP

1\. Install R6 Siege Tracker from Elgato Marketplace.

2\. Go to https://r6data.com, create an account, open the Account Dashboard, and generate your API key.

3\. Open iCUE and select your XENEON EDGE.

4\. Open the dashboard where you want the tracker, then add R6 Siege Tracker to an empty area.

5\. Open the widget settings by selecting the widget and choosing its settings/gear control.

6\. In Ubisoft Username, enter your Ubisoft display name exactly as it appears on your account.

7\. Paste your R6Data/Arenyze API key into Arenyze API Key.

8\. Enter your platform:

• uplay for PC

• psn for PlayStation

• xbl for Xbox

9\. Close the settings and allow a few seconds for your statistics to load.

HOW TO USE IT

• View your current competitive rank and Rank Points (RP).

• See your manually tracked session wins, losses, and record.

• Review your best operators and season highlights.

• Tap WIN or LOSS after a match to update the session counter.

• Tap the timer to start a 45-second countdown.

• Use the refresh control if you want to request updated statistics.

TROUBLESHOOTING

• Player not found: Check that the username is spelled exactly and that the correct platform code is entered.

• API key rejected: Re-enter your R6Data/Arenyze API key and make sure it is still valid.

• Service temporarily overloaded: Wait a short time, then tap refresh. The statistics provider may be receiving too many requests.

• No data appears: Confirm that the XENEON EDGE has internet access, then reopen the widget settings and verify all three account fields.

CLOUDFLARE RELAY

No Cloudflare setup is required. Statistics requests pass through the maker's stateless Cloudflare relay to reach R6Data/Arenyze. The relay forwards the API key for each request and does not intentionally log or store it.

This is an unofficial community widget. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Ubisoft. Rainbow Six Siege and related marks belong to their respective owners. Statistics are provided through the R6Data/Arenyze API.

widgets.description:
Activity Stats is a real time mouse and keyboard activity tracker for the CORSAIR XENEON EDGE. It displays live click counts, clicks per second, key presses, keys-per-minute, your most used keys, and an animated trail of recent mouse movement, all on your XENEON EDGE's dashboard display.

**How it works?**

A lightweight background tool reads your mouse and keyboard input and writes live stats to a file on your own PC. The widget reads that file and updates in real time. Sections, mouse trail duration, product artwork, and colors/background can all be customized from the widget's settings panel in iCUE.

Privacy: All activity data stays on your PC. It's written to a single local file (C:\\Users\\Public\\xeneon_stats.json) and read directly by the widget — nothing is sent over the internet, and there is no account, cloud sync, or telemetry involved. When you hit pause (from the widget or the app), input capture stops completely at the source: no keystrokes or clicks are read, processed, or logged until you resume.

What is included?

• Live keyboard stats: total key presses, keys-per-minute (live and average), top 5 most used keys

• Live mouse stats: total clicks, clicks per second (live and average), estimated distance traveled

• Animated mouse movement trail with adjustable duration (live view, or a fixed 1 to 30 minute window)

• Adjustable Mouse DPI setting for more accurate distance calculation

• Pause/resume tracking and one click session reset directly from the widget

• Toggle mouse and keyboard sections independently, on any slot size

• Toggleable keyboard and mouse product artwork backgrounds

• Full personalization: text, accent, and background color, background image or video, transparency

Note: Distance traveled is an approximation, not an exact measurement. It's calculated from an assumed mouse DPI (800 by default, a common gaming mouse value) since your mouse's actual DPI can't be read directly. Enter your mouse's real DPI in the widget's settings for a more accurate reading.

**Setup**

1\. Run ActivityCapture.exe once. Since it's unsigned, Windows SmartScreen may show "Windows protected your PC" — click More info, then Run anyway.

2\. To make it start automatically at every login: Press Win+R, type shell:startup, and press Enter. Copy ActivityCapture.exe into the folder that opens. Windows will launch it silently in the background every time you log in.

3\. In iCUE, go to Devices → XENEON EDGE → Widgets → + → Import Widget, select activity-stats.icuewidget, and drop it onto a slot.

To remove auto-start: Press Win+R, type shell:startup, and delete ActivityCapture.exe from that folder.

Your stats file (C:\\Users\\Public\\xeneon_stats.json) is left in place when you remove it — delete it manually if you want it gone too.

**Why isn't it working?**

ActivityCapture.exe disappeared after extracting the folder

Some antivirus software automatically quarantines or deletes unsigned executables. Check your antivirus's quarantine list and restore/allow the file if it's there.

The widget shows no data at all

Make sure ActivityCapture.exe is running — the widget only has data to display after C:\\Users\\Public\\xeneon_stats.json has been created. You can confirm it's running by checking Task Manager for ActivityCapture.exe.

**How to tell if the app itself is working**

Check whether C:\\Users\\Public\\xeneon_stats.json exists and is being updated while ActivityCapture.exe is running. If it is, the app is working correctly and the issue is with the widget or iCUE setup.

RSS Feed Reader puts a tabbed, multi-source news reader on your iCUE Xeneon Edge LCD. Follow up to five RSS or Atom feeds at once: news, blogs, tech, sports, gaming, or anything else with a feed. It starts with NYT World, CNBC, and WIRED, and you can swap in your own feeds anytime. Tap a headline to open the full story in your browser.

How It Works
The widget reads feed links and turns them into a clean, tabbed headline view on your screen. Switch between feeds with the tabs, scan titles and summaries, and tap a story to open the full article in your browser. If a feed includes artwork, the widget shows thumbnails automatically.

Some websites are friendly to apps and load right away. Others may open fine in a browser but still block apps from reading the feed directly. If that happens, the feed URL is not always wrong. The site may simply be restrictive. Feeds that allow `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` are the most reliable, because they avoid common browser CORS errors inside the widget.

Getting Started
Works immediately with the default NYT World, CNBC, and WIRED feeds. To customize, open widget settings and paste in your own RSS or Atom links. If a feed refuses to load, try the site's official feed first. Feeds that expose `Access-Control-Allow-Origin` tend to work best in the widget.

What's Included
- RSS Feed Reader widget (sensor-screen/dashboard LCD)
- Support for up to 5 simultaneous RSS/Atom feeds
- Tabbed feed navigation
- Thumbnail image display
- Article headline and description
- Tap-to-open-in-browser

widgets.description:
Lunch Roulette solves the daily "where should we eat?" problem. Spin to get a random restaurant recommendation near you from Google Maps, powered by real ratings and proximity. Not feeling it? Skip. Already been there? Blacklist it. The widget remembers your history so it never repeats suggestions.

How It Works
The widget uses Google Maps Platform to search for restaurants near a location you set. It loads the Maps JavaScript API with the Places library, uses Geocoding to turn your saved address into a search center, and picks from nearby restaurant results. Tap to mark a place as visited (history) or excluded (blacklist). Tap the restaurant name to open it in Google Maps in your browser.

Getting Started
1. Create or sign in to a Google Cloud account at https://cloud.google.com/free
2. In your Google Cloud project, enable Maps JavaScript API, Places API, and Geocoding API
3. Create an API key for the widget
4. Restrict the key under API restrictions to Maps JavaScript API, Places API, and Geocoding API
5. Open Lunch Roulette settings in iCUE
6. Enter the API key in Google API Key
7. Enter a center point in Default Address, such as your office, campus, or downtown area

Notes
- Google Maps Platform may require billing to be enabled in your Google Cloud project.
- The widget's Get Key button opens the same Google Cloud signup page in your system browser.
- The cuisine box and radius slider are adjusted inside the widget after setup.

What's Included
- Lunch Roulette widget 
- Random nearby restaurant suggestions
- History tracking (previously shown restaurants)
- Blacklist support (permanently excluded restaurants)
- Google Maps tap-to-open integration
